hotels.descriptionZh: 上海浦东福朋喜来登由由酒店位于陆家嘴金贸区中心地带，俯瞰风景迷人黄浦江。南浦大桥和复兴东路隧道亦相隔不远，驱车数分钟即可抵达外滩及其他热门景点。酒店距上海浦东国际博览中心仅约 10 分钟车程，距新天地娱乐中心仅约 15 分钟车程。酒店门前即有地铁 4 号线车站，周边遍布商务写字楼、购物中心、餐厅及酒吧。下榻我们宽敞的客房，体验温馨舒适的住宿，黄浦江和城市美景可一览无余。您可在我们的健身俱乐部和休闲娱乐场所放松身心。在忙碌一天之后，您可以尽情品尝我们的国际美食或小酌一杯喜爱的鸡尾酒。在我们 1,000 多平米的会议和多功能空间内发挥创意灵感。本酒店是您举办各种规模的会议、婚礼及社交活动的理想选择。
hotels.descriptionEn: Overlooking the Huangpu River, Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Pudong is in the heart of the Lujiazui finance and trade district. The hotel is conveniently close to both Nanpu Bridge and Fuxing Road East Tunnel, and the Bund and other major attractions can be reached in a few minutes by car. We're just 10 minutes from the Shanghai International Expo Center and 15 minutes from the famous Xintiandi recreation center. A Metro Line 4 stop sits directly in front of the hotel, which is surrounded by office buildings, a shopping mall, restaurants and bars. Enjoy a friendly & comfortable stay is one of our spacious guest rooms, which feature views of Huangpu River or the beautiful city.  Kick back and relax in our health club and recreation facilities. After a busy day, feast on international cuisine or wind down with your favorite cocktail. Get inspired by our over 1,000 square meters of meeting and function space. Our hotel is an ideal choice for meetings, conferences, weddings and social events of all sizes.

hotels.descriptionZh: 宝格丽酒店及度假村桂冠上第六颗宝石—上海宝格丽酒店，坐落于拥有丰厚历史人文背景的苏河湾，它将惬意的自然景观、当代的设计风格以及经典的历史建筑精妙平衡。精心保护及修缮后的上海历史保护建筑—上海总商会大楼，与环绕着盎然自然景观的48层宝格丽大楼巧妙融合，共同组成了上海宝格丽酒店。酒店的室内设计，一如曩昔的选择了意大利建筑事务所ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel 来共同打造。置于宝格丽大楼顶端8层的上海宝格丽酒店，可俯瞰外滩美景和观赏壮观的上海天际线、传奇浦江和蜿蜒苏河。拥有82间典雅的客房及套房，其中包括19间酒店甄选套房，房间面积均逾60平方米，为宾客打造沪上罕见的宽敞空间。酒店提供多处餐饮选择，包含47层 Il Ristorante – Niko Romito 由当代知名的烹饪大师之一Niko Romito主理；宝格丽酒吧标志性的椭圆形吧台，是精英人士聚会的理想之地。宝格丽水疗与健身中心拥有25米室内恒温泳池，更有美甲美发沙龙及男士理容室，为您打造美好体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai is located just 3 minutes from the iconic Bund, yet enjoys a tranquil and exclusive setting amongst private gardens, historic buildings and art galleries. Occupying the uppermost 8 floors of a 48-storey tower, the hotel offers stunning views of The Bund and Shanghai's dramatic skyline. With just 82 rooms and suites, guests can look forward to an intimate ambience and highly personalized service, yet the hotel provides some of the most extensive facilities in the city, including 6 restaurants and bars, a 2,000 square meter spa and fitness center, and state-of-the-art meeting facilities. The hotel rooms will be contemporary, glamorous and exceptionally spacious, with panoramic views from every window. Magnificent suites will include the extraordinary 570 square meter BVLGARI Suite. Adjoining the hotel tower is the historic former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai, originally built in 1916 and now completely restored to evoke memories of its glorious past.

hotels.descriptionEn: Situated next to the Shanghai Multimedia Valley, neighboring the Daning Park, the largest central greens in downtown provides a tranquil environment surrounded by nature trails. Our 317 contemporary-designed guest rooms combine style with elegance, offering you a comfortable and memorable stay.  Each sophisticated room is sure to exceed your expectations featuring available high-speed internet, multi-media player, plush Simmons® Mattresses, and tasteful decor. The impressive 2,800 sqm of meeting space including 2 pillarless ballrooms, one 1,400 sqm grand ballroom and another 1,000 sqm ballroom are catering to a variety of conferences, meetings, social events, and weddings.Guests looking for delectable dining can experience the unique flavors at our restaurants, the signature Man Ho Chinese Restaurant, Tatsumi Japanese Restaurant and all day dining Shanghai City Bistro. Or, drop-by for afternoon tea or a late-night drinks at The Lounge.

hotels.descriptionEn: Relaxing beaches and a quaint charm are hallmarks of the neighborhood surrounding the Sheraton Shanghai Fengxian, where guests will find amenities to balance the demands of work and the need for relaxation. Our hotel's accommodations feature cozy beds, desired technology and spacious bathrooms with a separate tub and aromatic amenities from Le Grand Bain. Select guests enjoy access to the Executive Lounge and its relaxing spaces and complimentary services. Dining includes elegant private dining rooms and Huaiyang cuisine at Yu Chinese Restaurant and interactive cooking and a breakfast buffet at S Kitchen.  The hotel’s Ballroom is among the largest in the area at more than 11,600 sq. ft. and is outfitted with state-of-the-art audiovisual features and the flexibility to offer two separate spaces. The area near Shanghai, China offers an array of attractions and activities, including ancient villages and green parks, but guests may choose to relax at the hotel’s indoor heated swimming pool or fitness center.

hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel started trial opening on Feb 1,2018 and officially opened on Aug 1,2018. Nestled in Northern Shanghai, just minutes away from Wusongkou International Cruise Terminal, Delta Hotels Shanghai Baoshan is the first Delta hotel in Asia Pacific and  provides guests with everything they need to enjoy a compelling urban escape. Relax in our sophisticated guest rooms and suites, boasting 55-inch LCD TVs, organic bath amenities, comfortable bedding and high-speed Wi-Fi; book one of our Club Lounge accommodations for access to our hotel's modern Club. Savor outstanding dining at our hotel, which showcases several restaurants, including authentic specialties at TRU Chinese Restaurant and buffet-style fare at The Lotus All Day Dining Restaurant. Work out in our 24-hour fitness center or make a splash in our indoor pool. Boasting comprehensive meeting and event facilities, including an expansive pillar-less Grand Ballroom, our hotel is also a desirable venue for meetings, weddings and special events in Shanghai.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海漕河泾万丽酒店隶属于万豪国际集团，酒店位于上海漕河泾新兴技术开发区，毗邻徐家汇和虹桥商业区。从酒店出发，步行约五分钟可至地铁9号线‘漕河泾开发区站“或地铁12号线”虹梅路站“，驱车约40分钟可至上海浦东国际机场，约20分钟可至虹桥枢纽。上海漕河泾万丽酒店地理位置优越，打造精彩的出行之旅。别具格调的灯光布局和简约而华美的客房层次，演绎出别具一格的温馨感，为酒店的商务旅行客人带来丰富多彩的不同感受。在客房内，各类优质商务休闲设施供您使用，您可在万豪特选的舒适大床上观看液晶电视和独立的影碟播放机所播放的精彩节目。行政楼层酒廊位于第26层，优美全景尽收眼底，堪称闲暇之余的理想去处。
hotels.descriptionEn: Renaissance Shanghai Caohejing Hotel welcomes you to China with sophisticated style and award-winning service. You will find our hotel in the vibrant Xuhui district within the Caohejing New Technology Development Zone, the National Exhibition and Convention Center NECC is close by as is the Hongqiao business district and the ancient town of Qibao. Eclectically designed yet functional rooms and suites offer touches of whimsy and perks like complimentary high speed WiFi and marble bathrooms as well as views of Shanghai. Elsewhere at the hotel you can enjoy local and global cuisine at one of our several restaurants, work out in the fitness center, swim in the indoor pool or indulge in a treatment at Touch Spa. If you are planning an event in Xuhui district our hotel boasts a range of adaptable venues including a pillarless ballroom and a modern boardroom. We hope you will discover the city while you are here too, our Navigator is on hand with tips to help you experience Shanghai like a true local.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海崇明由由喜来登酒店是远离城市喧嚣和匆碌的精致休闲之所，酒店设施配备齐全，于此休闲放松、专注工作或社交聚会皆宜。我们的288 间宽敞的客房、套房和2座别墅均配备有LED 电视、私人浴室、免费 Wi-Fi 等丰富设施。我们提供多种多样的活动，让您的入住体验丰富多彩，同时还有非凡的设施让您尽享舒适。前往配备室内恒温泳池的喜来登健身中心尽情锻炼，或体验酒店内设的游戏房，抑或租辆单车畅游周边地区。如果休闲体验太美，不想离开客房，您可以拿起电话呼叫我们的 24小时客房送餐服务。酒店内的两间餐厅供应国际美食，或者您还可前往附近的市中心寻觅其他美食，满足用餐需求。酒店拥有的室内儿童俱乐部，备受孩子们青睐，是家庭出游的理想之选。酒店拥有约 1,000 平米的多功能会议空间，是举办各类商务活动的理想之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: A sophisticated retreat from the crowed and hectic pace of Shanghai city, Sheraton Shanghai Chongming Hotel is well equipped to keep you relaxed, focused and in touch. Each of our 288 spacious guest rooms, suites and 2 villas features an LED TV, private bathroom, free WiFi and more. We offer many activities to help you stay busy during your stay, as well as quality amenities for your comfort. Make use of our Sheraton Fitness Center with an indoor heated swimming pool or on-site game room, or rent a bike and tour the surrounding area. If it is relaxation you seek, stay in and call our 24-hour room service. When you're hungry, stop by one of our 2 restaurants with international cuisines, or venture out to the nearby city center. For those traveling with family, know your kids will have fun in our indoor Kids Club. Our versatile function space is perfect to accommodate any of your business needs; with 1,000 square-meters of meeting space.

hotels.descriptionEn: Curated for the adventurous who see every journey as a chance to be inspired, the 5 star Renaissance Shanghai Pudong Hotel offers contemporary accommodation styled with indigenous design accents. Located near the Shanghai New International Expo Centre, Century Park and Shanghai Science and Technology Museum, the hotel is an ideal choice for both business and leisure. Discover the neighborhood with easy access to the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower, Luijiazui financial district and People Square via the nearest Metro rail, Line 2.  Our hotel features a full array of amenities and services comprising of culinary, entertainment, and wellness experiences. Celebrate and socialize in our dedicated event space with exquisite catering offerings and state-of-the-art technology.

hotels.descriptionEn: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai, Daning. Set in Jing’an District, downtown Shanghai, our modern hotel is located within the Life Hub complex at Daning. Walk to Metro Line 1, Yanchang Road Station, People’s Square and Shanghai Railway Station from our hotel. Make yourself at home in our spacious guestrooms featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, plush bedding, city views and deluxe amenities. Join us for our delicious international buffet at The Eatery. Gather with friends or colleagues for cocktails in our sophisticated lobby lounge. Go for a swim in our indoor pool. Our hotel also offers a 24-hour Fitness Center with a Yoga room for your convenience. Elsewhere in the hotel, discover our 1,735 square meters of meeting and banquet space, ideal for your business event or celebration. Walk to shopping, dining and entertainment, or visit Shanghai Circus World, the Bund and East Nanjing Road nearby. We look forward to making you feel welcome at our hotel in Jing'an District, downtown Shanghai.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海枫泾福朋喜来登酒店坐落于被誉为“中国历史文化名镇”的枫泾镇，为枫泾镇首家国际品牌酒店。枫泾镇位于上海西南、金山区西北部，与沪浙接壤。枫泾为典型的江南水乡古镇，成市于宋，元朝至元十二年（1275年）正式建镇，距今已有1500逾年历史，地灵人杰、名人荟萃，史料记载曾有3个状元、56个进士和125个举人。建筑多为明、清风格， 传统江南粉墙黛瓦。古镇水网遍布，镇区内河道纵横，桥梁众多，素有“三步两座桥，一望十条港”之称。沿河古街绿树成荫，古镇水巷幽静；39座古石桥横跨河上，其中元代建1座，明代建11座，清代建21座，现存最古的为元代致和桥，据今有近700年历史。
hotels.descriptionEn: The first international hotel in cultural Fengjing Town. With over 1500 years of history dated back to Southern and Northern Dynasties abounded many distinguished scholars, Fengjing is a quaint water town located in Southwest Shanghai and neighbors Zhejiang Province. Explore interlacing lanes, centuries-old houses, carved stone-arch bridges from the Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties, especially the Zhihe Bridge, which can be dated back to the Yuan Dynasty with a history of 700 years. The 218 well-appointed guestrooms feature breathtaking lake view or rural scenery. Guests can enjoy a variety of local and international culinary delights at the 2 restaurants and 1 lounge located in the hotel. The largest pillar-less ballroom in Fengjing Area, three additional Function Rooms at nearly 100 square meters are equipped with state-of-the-art technology as well as huge lakeside lawns featuring natural landscape. Fully equipped 24-hour fitness center, indoor heated swimming pool with breathtaking lakeview outdoor terrace.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎下榻上海虹桥万豪万枫酒店, 探索“东方魔都”——上海的非凡魅力。上海虹桥万豪万枫酒店位于虹桥商务中心区，交通地理位置优越，紧邻上海交通枢纽中心, 10分钟车程即可轻松抵达上海虹桥国际机场、虹桥高铁站等通枢纽，距离国家会展中心20分钟车程；毗邻韩国美食一条街，步行三分钟；至紫藤路地铁口、龙柏新村地铁口，步行9分钟; 至爱琴海购物中心，万象城步行10分钟；距离七宝古镇、宝龙美术馆，上海动物园，车程10分钟。酒店秉承“流畅、可靠、乐活”的品牌服务理念，去繁求简，体现简约之美，致力于为新一代商旅人事提供简约，友好，真诚的入住新体验，是商务和休闲旅客出行的理想之选，让您尽情感受上海这座金融摩登之城的魅力。酒店拥有76间精致的客房，客房超高层高，给您足够的空间和高度释放压力，让灵感归属；1个万枫餐厅，中西美食融合，尽享舌尖愉悦；1个会议室满足您在繁华商圈中举办多种活动的需求，助力商务成功，同事配置有自助健身房，让您充分享受运动带来的乐趣; 洗衣房，提供打印服务让您的旅程更加轻松自如，非凡厨师精心制作的健康营养美味早餐，让您精力充沛开启新一天的工作或旅行，充分满足保障您的商务出行需要，客房标配舒达品牌床垫、华夫格亲肌肤系列床品、55英寸智能投屏电视、高速WIFI等。上海虹桥万豪万枫酒店与您共同探索魔都，感受简约之美，感受“东方巴黎”的魅力。

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Shanghai Jiading is located in the center of Jiading District, with a unique geographical location. The hotel has convenient transportation and easy access to famous scenic spots such as Shanghai International Circuit, Guyi Park in Jiading, Anting Old Street and so on. Only 40 minutes’ drive from Hongqiao International Airport, Hongqiao Railway Station and Shanghai National Convention and Exhibition Center, the hotel is well developed and can easily reach all administrative areas in the region. The hotel features a wide range of high-quality rooms and suites total in 228, all in warm neutral tones and stylish decor. From 30 square meters of deluxe rooms to 60 square meters of executive suites, all rooms are fully equipped and furnished with spacious desk and modern furniture, offering stunning views of the city, bringing guests a comfortable experience at home. The hotel adheres to the concept of simple and comfortable accommodation to meet the needs of business or leisure travelers.

hotels.descriptionEn: A sophisticated retreat from the crowds and hectic pace of the Jiading District, Sheraton Shanghai Jiading Hotel is well equipped to keep you refreshed, relaxed and totally in touch. It is only a 10 minutes' walk to Metro 11 which takes you to downtown Shanghai and a 20 minutes' drive to Shanghai International Circuit, which lets you experience the real fast and furious. In addition, our Jiading hotel is just 30 minutes from Hongqiao International Airport and 75 minutes from Pudong International Airport. Stage an unforgettable Shanghai event in our more than 3,200 square meters of multifunction conference space, featuring flexible setups and advanced meetings technology. Choose from our 1,050-square-meter pillarless Grand Ballroom, 478-square-meter Junior Ballroom and 15 other meeting rooms. Our friendly, efficient planning and catering teams are at your disposal to arrange the perfect meeting, training session, wedding or social gathering. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel in Shanghai, China.

hotels.descriptionEn: Shanghai Marriott Hotel Pudong East is ideally located in Jinqiao Pilot Free Trade Zone, also renowned as the “Green City” of Biyun International Community. Nestled beside a beautiful park and canal, the neighborhood offers a diverse array of restaurants, bars, and shops. It is approximately a 15-minute drive from Lujiazui, Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone, Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park, and Shanghai New International Expo Centre. Shanghai Disneyland is about a 20-minute drive away. Pudong International Airport lies 30 kilometers distant, requiring roughly 30 to 35 minutes by car; Hongqiao International Airport is 30 kilometers away, with a driving time of around 45 minutes.  The hotel has 324 stylish guest rooms, 67 apartments, and 4 Food and Beverage outlets of Man Ho Chinese Restaurant, Casalingo Italian Restaurant, Gourmet House and The Lounge. The event facilities feature a magnificent 655 square meters Grand Ballroom and an additional 841 square meters of state-of-the-art event space in 10 separate rooms.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海静安瑞吉酒店地处北京西路，坐落在当地文化和商业中心静安区的中心地段。酒店内部装潢典雅精致，传统英伦韵味和中式华美风格巧妙融合，书法、手工金箔画等中国艺术和文化作品为之画龙点睛，宛若别致静谧的休闲绿洲。酒店公共空间内矗立着由世界有名艺术家Dale Chihuly倾情创作的五座玻璃雕塑，视觉效果非常惊艳。上海静安瑞吉酒店拥有491间精致时尚的客房，内设六间特色餐厅及酒吧、瑞吉品牌特色水疗中心及健身中心。同时，约1,400平米的艾斯特宴会厅配有约90平米的LED墙面投影系统，缔造非同凡响的活动体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan is situated on West Beijing Road in the heart of Jingan District, Shanghai’s cultural and business center. The hotel’s elegant interiors create an oasis of calm, blending traditional English and Chinese palatial styles with elements of Chinese art and culture, such as calligraphy and handcrafted gold foil paintings.Adding to its visual appeal, the hotel’s public spaces showcase five glass sculptures by world-renowned artist Dale Chihuly.The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan features 491 exquisitely designed guest rooms, six distinctive restaurants and bars, the St. Regis brand’s signature Spa, and a fitness center. Its 1,400-square-meter Astor Ballroom includes a 90-square-meter LED wall projection system, offering guests an unparalleled experience during their stay.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海康桥万豪酒店邻近上海张江高科技园区和上海迪士尼®度假区附近，可谓是休闲工作两相宜。酒店位于浦东周康地区，设有符合人体工学的办公区、无线网络和餐厅，宾客可在餐厅享用会议早餐或商务晚餐。酒店还拥有约 1,100平方米的活动空间，可供举行大型宴会和董事会议等活动，因此备受商务旅客青睐。行程自由的客人可前往以自助餐为主的贡厨餐厅悠闲享用美食，在健身中心保持强健体魄，于珑锦轩中餐厅以传统粤菜招待亲朋好友、意大利餐厅享用传统意大利美食，在酒店的儿童俱乐部享受午后亲子时刻。或者，可探访附近的上海迪士尼主题乐园、邵家楼水乡古镇、周浦花海或佛罗伦萨小镇购物中心。
hotels.descriptionEn: Relax with friendly service & upscale amenities at our Shanghai Marriott Hotel Kangqiao. Our stylish hotel is located in the ZhouKang area of Pudong, near Shanghai Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park and Shanghai Disney® Resort. Enjoy our contemporary rooms and suites, with high-speed Wi-Fi, soaking tubs, sofa beds and advanced in-room technology. Dine in our popular hotel restaurants, including an international buffet at Goji Kitchen Bar, traditional Cantonese at Jade Pavilion, and Italian cuisine at D.O.C.G. Enjoy our hotel’s complimentary kids club, 24-hour fitness center and sparkling indoor pool. Those looking to host a meeting or special occasion will appreciate our brand-new Great Room and more than 1,100 square meters of event space, with superb catering and planning services. Take our complimentary shuttle to Shanghai Disney® Resort, explore the Pudong District, or visit the water town of Zhao Jia Lou and Florentia Village shopping center. A refreshing stay awaits you at our modern hotel in Shanghai.

hotels.descriptionEn: Plan your visit to the Renaissance Shanghai Zhongshan Park Hotel. With a unique location over the Zhongshan Park Station Metro Line 2, 3, and 4, directly to popular destinations including Lujiazui, Nanjing Road, People Square, Jin’an Temple, Hongqiao Railway Station, Shanghai Railway Station, Shanghai South Railway Station, Pudong International Airport, and Hongqiao Airport. Total guest rooms occupying on the 25 floor and above of the 60-storey building with a breathtaking Sky Lobby, including Deluxe Rooms, Premium Rooms, Club Rooms and Club Suites and signature Duplex, offer panoramic views. An impressive 2,200 square meters of meeting space which can be combined for various event set-ups. Delectable dining options include Azur, Zpark Coffee.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海，这座以炫丽的天际线、悠久的地标建筑和蓬勃发展的经济而著称的东方明珠之城，是商务和休闲旅行的美好目的地。 当您来到中国内地这座繁华而充满生机的城市时，上海绿地万怡酒店是您的理想下榻之所。 上海绿地万怡酒店是嘉定区率先营业的国际品牌酒店，为您提供理想的住宿环境和超凡的宾客服务。 酒店座落于嘉定商业区的中心，邻近上海国际赛车场，知名的 F1 大奖赛举办地。 我们的宽敞客房包括行政楼层客房和套房，均配备液晶电视、高速上网、光线充足的办公区、客房内保险箱、迷你吧、冰箱和豪华床上用品。 MoMo Cafe 每天早晨精心烹制健康美味的早餐，令您充满活力开启美好一天。 健身中心是您放松身心、焕发活力的好去处，而商务中心则助您效率倍增。 旅行上海，入住上海绿地万怡酒店，领略历史积淀与时尚踪迹碰撞的东方魅力之都。
hotels.descriptionEn: Known for its spectacular skyline, historic landmarks and growing economy, Shanghai is the perfect backdrop to business and leisure travel. When visiting our thriving city in Chinese mainland, choose the Courtyard Shanghai Jiading. The first international brand in the Jiading district, Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai Jiading offers ideal accommodations and first-class service. We're in the heart of the Jiading business district close to Shanghai F1 - the Shanghai International Circuit that is home to popular motor racing. Our spacious guest rooms, including executive floor rooms and suites, feature LCD TV, high-speed Internet, well-lit work area, in-room safe, mini-bar, fridge and luxurious bedding. Start your morning at the MoMo Cafe for a hearty breakfast. Rejuvenate at our fitness centre and stay productive at our business centre.  When visiting Shanghai, stay at the Courtyard Shanghai Jianding, bridging the old and new of our charming city.

hotels.descriptionZh: 与迪拜哈利法塔师出同门，上海绿发JW万豪侯爵酒店堪称新的地标性建筑，为市中心天际线划出一道靓丽的风景。酒店从黄浦江汲取设计灵感，它那颇具特色的中庭风格令人印象深刻，充满了光线和色彩的变化。这里富有创造力的氛围弥漫在你的四周，每次更深入的探究都会得到新的感受。514间客房和套房，每一间都富有现代气息，赏心雅致，可以饱览城市景观或者江景。拥有超过3,200平方米的会议场地，其巨大的无柱式宴会厅和带有烟色玻璃的烹饪厨房，是举办活动或接待客人的理想之选。酒店共设有4间风格迥异的特色餐厅，包括FLINT扒房，时尚烧烤酒吧；航迹厨房（Merchant Kitchen）餐厅提供特色国际菜肴的精美自助餐；JW酒廊提供下午茶、美食和现场音乐，以及带有法式风情的三层菱餐厅（Le Manoir Ling）主理精致粤菜，并设有露台酒吧，卡拉OK和私人包厢。酒店特别推出“JW家庭计划”，创造乐趣难忘的亲子时光。JW家庭计划包括PAPAHUG亲子楼层，JW蔬苑趣味采摘，小小厨师烹饪课堂，侯爵宝宝萌趣互动，更有为小客人们量身定制的童趣乐园，充满了玩偶与小帐篷，趣味游戏机，动画片放映机，让萌宝们徜徉在梦幻童话乐园里，尽情释放活力。
hotels.descriptionEn: From the architectural minds behind Dubai’s Burj Khalifa, JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Shanghai Pudong has added a new landmark to the downtown skyline alongside Huangpu River. Each of 514 guest rooms and suites, modern and beautiful, overlooks Shanghai or the river. More than 33,000 sq. ft. of meeting space with pillar-free ballroom and a culinary theater, revealed through smoked glass, to engage and entertain. Dining includes four restaurants, a stylish bar and grill at Flint; elaborate buffets featuring international dishes at Merchant Kitchen; afternoon tea, live music at JW Lounge and the three-story Le Manoir Ling offering Cantonese cuisine in a French setting, a rooftop bar, karaoke and private dining. "Family by JW", where children and their parents enjoy an unforgettable time together, introduces PAPAHUG family floor, JW Garden and cooking class. New Kids Land tailored for children, where they can play with dolls, small tents and game machines, enabling them to linger in a wonderland of fairy tales.

hotels.descriptionEn: Situated near Qibao Ancient Town Le Meridien Shanghai Minhang offers stylish comfort in a legendary travel destination. Find your respite in contemporary accommodations with signature comforts, modern essentials and floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping views of the Qibao Area. Delight your palate with bountiful buffets and delectable international fare at our distinctive hotel restaurants. Stay with moments of an eclectic array of attractions within minutes of the National Exhibition and Convention Center Shanghai, Hongqiao Train Station, Shanghai Zoo and Hongqiao International Airport . Bring your big ideas to life in dynamic meeting and event spaces, enhanced by expert planners and custom catering professionals. Punctuate an unforgettable day of business or sightseeing with a refreshing swim in our sparkling pool or an exhilarating workout in our fully equipped fitness center. Perfectly placed in the Minhang District, our hotel is a stylish retreat in Shanghai China.

hotels.descriptionEn: Fairfield by Marriott Shanghai Pudong  offers a prime location in the heart of Shanghai, an ideal spot from which to enjoy our spectacular city. It all comes together at this hotel with affordable rooms near Shanghai New International Expo Center, Century Park, Shanghai Science and Technology Museum and many other attractions. Our hotel is close to Line 4 and Line 6 subway station, making it easy to navigate the best of Shanghai. Begin your morning with an energizing workout in our well-equipped fitness center, and enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast before setting off. You can look forward to unwinding in one of the 200 simple and stylish guestrooms. At Fairfield by Marriott Shanghai Pudong , you're our #1 priority. Our business travelers will be taken care of with a comfortable working area and High Speed Internet Access in all rooms, as well as a dedicated Business Center. If business brings you to Shanghai, our enormous meeting/function space of over 1,500 square meters, including our pillar-less Grand Ballroom, provides great versatility and makes us the ideal choice for meetings, conferences, weddings and events of any size.

hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel is located in the commercial centre of Shanghai Jingan District, the Jingan District is an ideal destination for business and leisure. The Metro line 1, 3, 4, 12, 13 just 200 meter from hotel, take you to the Shanghai Railway Station, Yu Garden, Xin Tian Di, Tian Zi Fang, Shanghai Museum of Natural History, Nanjing Road West, Jing An Temple, and People's Square. In addition, hotel is just 30 minutes from Hongqiao International Airport and 50 minutes from Pudong International Airport. Guests will enjoy spacious accommodations featuring well-lit desks, high-speed Internet, in-room safes and mini-bars, as well as a 30th-floor Executive Lounge with panoramic skyline views. To satisfy your craving, our MoMo cafe, MoMo 2 Go and lounges offer coffee, cocktails and casual dining throughout the day. Jump-start your day in our 24-hour fitness center, unwind in our indoor heated pool. To meet with clients in our state-of-the-art event facilities will lead you to focus on a successful session.

It is 3.8 kilometers away from the Zhujiajiao Ancient Town Tourist Area and takes 10 minutes to drive there. Within 30 minutes, one can quickly reach Hongqiao International Airport and the National Exhibition Center. Meanwhile, the hotel is well-connected with the expressway network, making it convenient for guests to drive to the urban area of Shanghai and other regions in the Yangtze River Delta. The superior commercial and leisure environment is surrounded by numerous large enterprises and industrial parks. The hotel features 138 modern and comfortable guest rooms, a Windsor All-Day Dining Restaurant, a fitness center, and other supporting facilities. It is an ideal choice for business trips, leisure vacations, and short-term stays.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海榕港万怡酒店深切了解商务人士的需求，酒店拥有精心设计的183间客房及套房，所有房间均以舒适时尚为设计理念，同时满足宾客对高科技生活的需求。酒店房间均提供灵活的工作及休闲空间，无线网络覆盖，接入卫星频道的55寸LED电视以及符合人体工程学设计得沙发等等。在我们宽敞的客房内休息放松，再活力满满地从事商务活动，或尽情探索城市的精彩魅力。这里的每一寸空间，都洋溢着舒适与热情活力，无微不至的贴心服务，为客人缔造宾至如归的住宿体验。位于酒店一层的全日餐厅-榕怡小厨，为宾客提供品种多样的自助早餐、本地佳肴和国际美食，全天提供欧陆式美食自助与零点服务，是您私享美食或商务款待的品质之选。舒适典雅的大堂酒廊供应精美甜点、咖啡、鸡尾酒以及各类饮品，是商务会谈或放松小憩的理想场所。酒店还设有贵宾行政楼层，满足客人的不同体验需求。行政酒廊，万豪旅享家打造的专属空间，安静的休息及洽谈环境，全天候提供的小食与软饮，专业定制的商务设施，尽显身份的尊贵。宾客可在此享受专属便捷的入住和退房手续，更有私密会议室满足不同客人的需求。酒店二十二层的健身中心为宾客提供全天候24小时健身服务和专业健身保障，为健身爱好者打造一片别致之地，让宾客随时保持健康体魄。
hotels.descriptionEn: Conveniently located in Dongding Building, a landmark building in Dongding commercial district, Courtyard Shanghai Songjiang is within walking distance of tram stop. And it is just 3.2km from the Songjiang Xincheng Metro Station and 31km from Hongqiao International Airport. In addition, the hotel provides easy access to popular tourist resorts nearby including Sheshan National Forest Park, Shanghai Happy Valley, Guangfulin Ancient Relic Park, etc. A blend of comfort and convenience can be found at our bran-new Courtyard Shanghai Songjiang. There are 183 spacious guestrooms, each featuring stylish fashion design elements and panoramic city views. Enjoy your trip at our guest rooms with thoughtful amenities, remarkable restaurants, and well-equipped fitness center. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard Shanghai Songjiang is sure to be more enjoyable and memorable.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Le Meridien Shanghai Sheshan welcomes business and leisure visitors with contemporary accommodation, extraordinary views and award-winning service. Our hotel benefits from a tranquil lakeside location in the Sheshan National Tourism Resort, within driving distance of the Metro station; Sheshan National Forest Park and Shanghai Moon Lake Sculpture Park are close by, as is Happy Valley Shanghai and the stunning Sheshan Basilica. Oversized rooms and suites are designed with plush bedding, sleek bathrooms and private balconies. Sample tasty Chinese specialties at Yu Palace, or relax with a meal and a drink at Le Cafe. There are plenty of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors at our resort - from swimming in the outdoor pool to playing a beach volleyball. You can also stroll down to Moon Lake and relax on the sandy beach. If you're in Shanghai to host an event, our hotel offers adaptable indoor and outdoor venues and comprehensive planning and catering services.

hotels.descriptionZh: 苏州河畔的上海苏宁环球万怡酒店，位于普陀区长风生态商业园区的核心位置——苏宁·天御国际广场。上海跨国采购会展中心及国家会展中心近在咫尺，东临上海长风海洋世界，乐高探索中心和长风大悦城商场。其222间装潢典雅的客房，均配备人性化周到的现代化设施，并可饱览窗外新古典主义欧式庭院的静谧舒适。庭院不仅令旅客尽享散步的闲适，更能提供欧式草坪婚礼，为良缘缔结承诺。约730平方米的多功能会议空间，包括一间约368平方米的无柱宴会厅并配备全彩LED高清显示屏，无论商务会务还是私人宴会，其震撼的视听效果尽显豪华。6间功能齐备的会议厅和便捷的商务中心，专业的会议及宴会策划团队，缔造定制化品质会务服务。万荟轩餐厅，集烹饪匠心、安全优质的食材、惬意的用餐空间、私人雅致的包房，不断将美食理念推陈出新，演绎美味经典，传承美食文化。别具格调的大堂吧，以其简约布局和舒适宽敞的环境，欢迎着来自五湖四海的商旅客人，而提供的精致下午茶和醇厚口感的酒水，为客人们减轻旅途和工作的疲劳，为唤醒饱满精神带来周到的呵护。24小时的健身中心、礼品店、礼宾部、洗熨服务及停车场等服务，让每一位入店体验的客人，享受宾至如归的欣喜。
hotels.descriptionEn: Experience the stylish comfort of Courtyard Shanghai Changfeng Park during your travels through China. This modern Putuo District hotel is conveniently near Changfeng CBD, Shanghai Convention & Exhibition Center of International Sourcing, the Suning Art Museum and Changfeng Park. Inside, the hotel offers 222 rooms and suites boasting exceptional views of our classical European courtyard. Recharge in new rooms and suites that offer indulgent bedding, flat-screen TVs, cozy reading chairs, marble bathrooms, ample desks and free Wi-Fi.  Savor delicious, globally-inspired restaurant cuisine, and work out in the 24-hour fitness center. Event planners will appreciate our more than 9,000 square feet of elevated venues, including private dining rooms, a pillarless ballroom ideal for high-impact presentations and a picturesque lawn. We look forward to welcoming you to Courtyard Shanghai Changfeng Park.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海外高桥喜来登酒店位于中国（上海）自由贸易试验区，距浦东中央商务区（CBD）约 15 公里。地理位置优越，近在咫尺的地铁轨道交通及若干条城市高速路将酒店与陆家嘴金融区、浦东国际机场、虹桥国际机场及上海迪士尼度假区轻松联通。酒店拥有四百余间装饰典雅的客房及套房，可饱览迷人港口景色。喜来登行政贵宾厅及配备升级设施的行政客房亦为宾客带来多姿体验。 酒店其他便利设施包括餐厅、酒吧及设施完善的健身中心。奉上中、日、国际盛宴的三个餐厅及酒廊为您打造难以抗拒的厨艺盛宴和饕餮体验。超过2600平方米会议空间包含了1000平方米8.6米高的无柱大宴会厅为您的活动无论是晚宴、婚宴还是各类会议或是国际大会提供理想场所。 毗邻长兴岛、崇明岛等沪上热门度假之地，足不出沪，即可在外高桥体验惬意别样的文化之旅。荷兰式建筑的荷兰小镇带你领略异国风情，占地300公顷的上海滨江森林公园是个天然氧吧，驱车半小时内亦可直达共青国家森林公园、吴淞口炮台湾国家湿地公园，让您尽享自然。这里也是购物者的天堂，集合了山姆会员旗舰店、盒马X会员店、欧尚大型超市、星美国际电影院及众多一线品牌、占地6万平方米的森兰国际商都满足您各种购物需求。同时，距酒店仅需几分钟车程的外高桥进口商品直销中心，为您提供超4000种进口食品及商品。
hotels.descriptionEn: Welcome to Sheraton Shanghai Waigaoqiao Hotel. Strategically situated in the Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone of Pudong New District, our hotel is conveniently connected via express highways and city metro lines. The hotel is also one of the closest international hotels to Shanghai Disneyland.  Our luxurious property features an indoor pool, a golf course, a wellness center and more. Guests can relax in our sauna or enjoy a soothing massage at our spa, or check emails and work in our well-equipped business center. Each guest room is spacious and elegantly decorated, offering beautiful river views and large windows that provide plenty of natural light. Our rooms also feature free WiFi, a flat-screen TV and more, as well as a large private bathroom. Our on-site restaurants offer delicious creative dishes to satisfy your appetite, including the option of breakfast. Whether business or pleasure brings you to this area, you will be able to relax and connect with what’s important to you.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海外滩W酒店是一家坐落于北外滩的奢华酒店，与浦西的繁华都市交相辉映，融合自然、历史和传统海派文化元素，兼具历史独特韵味与先锋潮酷的非凡格调。374间精心设计的客房和套房既蕴含了老上海风情，也彰显了W的时尚风潮。酒店拥有逾5,800平方米的活动空间，配备灵活多变的设备与视听设施，是您举办惊艳四座的会议的上佳场所。5个餐厅和酒吧，全力满足不同宾客对美食的需求：现代纽约风格浓郁的标帜餐厅，全天供应国际佳肴；跃层设计空间的艳中餐厅，呈现新式江南料理与粤菜相结合的特色美食；一同与艳汁酒吧追溯到上海鸡尾酒盛行的黄金年代；风格多变的WOOBAR®酒吧，随着日夜交替呈现不同风貌；热带风情的WET®池畔酒吧更是众多社交达人尽情玩乐的好去处。宾客更可轻松享受一系列实用设施与定制化的服务，如激发活力的FIT健身中心、舒缓身心的AWAY®水疗中心、闲适自在的WET®室内碧波泳池和可饱览上海浦东地标天际线的WET®室外碧波泳池。从白天直至深夜，上海外滩W酒店精彩持续上演，让您沉浸在传统东方古韵与现代西方文化的交融和碰撞，恣享生活。
hotels.descriptionEn: W Shanghai - The Bund is a luxury hotel located on the up-and-coming North Bund in glamorous Shanghai. Wake up to views of the Huangpu River from 374 supremely chic hotel rooms and suites that fuse sophisticated Mandarin designs with playful twists. Innovative decor and 5,800 square meters of event space ensure your meetings are anything but ordinary. Taste the flavors at our five restaurants and bars, including The Kitchen Table, a modern New York City-style bistro; YEN, celebrates contemporary Jiangnan and Cantonese cuisine mixed in with some Shanghainese favorites; LIQUID, a Golden Age-inspired cocktail bar; WOOBAR®, a playground that spotlights world-renowned DJs and crafted concoctions on The Bund and WET® Bar, a perfect place for cocktails, light fare and finger food. Unwind in spectacular style at our hotel's FIT gym, then pamper yourself at AWAY® Spa. Take a swim in our outdoor and indoor WET® pools with a playful WET® Deck that faces Shanghai's iconic skyline.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海外滩瑞吉酒店坐落于摩登繁华的上海外滩，尽览黄浦江潋滟波光与浦东天际线交相辉映的壮丽画卷。酒店拥有189间客房，包含20间套房，配备精致非凡的设施及贴心周到的瑞吉管家服务，拥有2个餐厅和1个瑞吉酒吧。酒店运用玉兰花刺绣与艺术辉映的奢华融合，宾客置身在这座璀璨富丽的标志性建筑里，体验深厚底蕴的阿斯特家族待客之道，感受令人迷醉的外滩风光。上海外滩瑞吉酒店，融合东西方文化，启迪艺术魅力的理想选择。酒店拥有近 1,100平方米的会议空间，饱览外滩长廊景致。配备先进设施，空间更可灵活多变，以满足各种不同形式的宴会和会议活动的需要。专属瑞吉会议管家更贴心为会议组织者提供 24 小时服务，确保每一场会议顺利进行。
hotels.descriptionEn: The St. Regis on the Bund, Shanghai is nestled in the modern and bustling Shanghai Bund offering breathtaking views of the stunning panorama where the shimmering waves of the Huangpu River and the skyline of Pudong complement each other. The St. Regis Shanghai on the Bund has 189 guest rooms, including 20 suites, all equipped with exquisite facilities and thoughtful St. Regis Butler service. It also features two restaurants and one St. Regis Bar. The hotel blends the luxury of magnolia embroidery with art, allowing guests to immerse themselves in this dazzling and magnificent landmark building, experience the profound heritage of the Astor family's hospitality, and enjoy the enchanting views of the Bund. The St. Regis Shanghai on the Bund is the ideal choice for those seeking to blend Eastern and Western cultures and inspire artistic charm.

hotels.descriptionZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到供应当地精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选计划，无不展现出我们对伟大设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。在福朋酒店，健身不仅仅局限于健身房。我们与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和专享健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: From objects found and collected over time, to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on tap, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points, workouts are not confined to just to the gym. We've partnered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 上海威斯汀大饭店坐落于繁华的上海市中心，距人流如织的外滩滨江步道仅有两个街区之遥，是一家地理位置优越的 5 星级商务酒店，酒店周边名品店及餐厅云集，入住尽享便利。入住酒店，您不妨在清晨选择酒店恒温泳池畅游一番，或走进威斯汀健身中心，尽情挥汗，开启充满活力的一天。饭店配有 568 间华贵典雅的客房和套房。舒适的威斯汀天梦之床助您安享一夜好眠，客房内可欣赏美不胜收的黄浦江和外滩景观，或观赏上海城市美景和豫园古朴景致。上海威斯汀大饭店集商务酒店与亲子酒店于一身，是商务旅行与休闲旅游的理想选择。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in dazzling downtown Shanghai two blocks from the vibrant promenade on the Bund waterfront The Westin Bund Center Shanghai is a conveniently situated 5 star hotel in a neighborhood of luxury brand shops and celebrated restaurants. Enjoy easy access to major business districts as well. While at the hotel, jump start your day in our beautiful heated pool or the WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio. Enjoy delectable Eat Well breakfast buffets and surrender to pampering treatments in the ISpa Shanghai. Two architecturally dazzling 26 story towers with 568 hotel rooms and suites surround you in sumptuous style and 5 star amenities. Sink into a plush Westin Heavenly Bed, enjoy high tech amenities and superb views of the Huangpu River and the Bund or the Shanghai cityscape and Yu Garden.

hotels.descriptionEn: Ideally suited for both business and leisure travelers, Courtyard Shanghai Xujiahui welcomes you to China with sophisticated accommodation, a host of terrific on-site perks and a peerless downtown location. Our hotel rooms and suites feature artful design touches and amenities like a flat-screen TV, deluxe bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi access, an ergonomic, well-lit workspace, a mini-fridge, a coffee maker and floor-to-ceiling windows which offer dazzling panoramic views of the downtown Shanghai, China cityscape. Maintain your workout routine at our state-of-the-art fitness center, take a refreshing dip in our Romanesque indoor pool or savor handcrafted international fare at our hotel's popular MoMo Cafe. Ideally situated in bustling Xujiahui commercial district, our hotel places you moments away from a wide range of prominent business destinations and we're within walking distance of downtown's most noteworthy shopping and dining. Elevate your experience at Courtyard Shanghai Xujiahui.

All bedrooms are equipped with 55 inch flat screen televisions, build in USB ports and free Wifi.

hotels.descriptionEn: Centered amid the dynamic Zizhu National Hi-Tech Industrial Development Zone, Courtyard Shanghai Minhang is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. Enrich your visit to Shanghai at our hotel in the Minhang District.

hotels.descriptionEn: Located in China Central Place, Beijing CBD, JW Marriott Hotel Beijing is near the Embassy District and just a 3-minute walk from Dawanglu Station (Subway Lines 1 & 14). It offers direct metro access to the Forbidden City and Universal Beijing Resort, with both airports 45–50 minutes away by car.The hotel boasts 588 spacious rooms (starting from 42 sqm) with panoramic windows, marble bathrooms, rain showers, soaking tubs and signature bedding. Griffin-themed family rooms come with playful welcome gifts for kids.Guests can relax in the 1,000-sqm JW Garden, featuring a pickleball court, yoga lawn and fresh herbs. Asia Bistro serves Chinese and Japanese buffet with alfresco garden seating.Twelve event venues include a 1,230-sqm ballroom, Loong Gallery and outdoor lawn—ideal for weddings and meetings. An Executive Lounge and 24-hour gym blend business and leisure seamlessly.Where calm meets the capital—stay in the moment at JW Marriott.

hotels.descriptionZh: 北京宝格丽酒店位于京城专属使馆区的核心地带，在酒店的整体设计上，与品牌旗下所有的宝格丽酒店及度假村一样，北京宝格丽酒店一如曩昔的选择了意大利久负盛名的建筑事务所ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel来共同打造北京宝格丽酒店。北京宝格丽酒店拥有119间典雅的客房及套房，其中包括一间宝格丽套房，所有房间均由意大利奢华家具品牌如Maxalto和B&B Italia打造而成。 占地1500平方米的宝格丽水疗中心拥有11间豪华私人理疗室，一个健身中心和一个从罗马卡拉卡拉浴场中获取灵感而设计的25米室内恒温游泳池，宾客可在此感受身心的复苏与重生，开启焕然舒缓的水疗与健身体验之旅。宝格丽酒店的意式珍馐素来受到饕客喜爱，北京宝格丽酒店在延续这一美食传奇的同时，亦是首家与米其林星级名厨Niko Romito合作的宝格丽酒店及度假村。宝格丽酒吧窖藏丰富，宾客可在全球宝格丽酒店及度假村标志性的椭圆形吧台品鉴各种鸡尾酒、红酒、香槟以及更具特色的宝格丽餐前酒，并可在户外露台饱览河畔私属花园美景，尽享非凡意式生活。
hotels.descriptionEn: The Bvlgari Hotel Beijing is conceived as the ultimate Urban Resort: it rises within the Genesis Beijing, an oasis of tranquility that balances art and nature with sculpted gardens that extend along the Liangma River and include the Genesis Art Gallery. Designed with the contemporary style of the Italian architectural firm ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, the hotel will feature 119 rooms and suites, including a 380-sqm Bvlgari Suite. The hotel offer the first Il Ristorante presenting the collaboration with Michelin-starred Italian chef Niko Romito, The Bvlgari Bar, a private park, a 1500-square-metre BVLGARI SPA, a 25-meter pool and a BVLGARI ballroom, establishing a new benchmark for enlightened luxury living and personalized services.

Our hotel in downtown Beijing is close to Metro Line 10, Airport Express Sanyuanqiao Station and Beijing Capital International Airport for convenient access to transportation. Featuring spectacular views, our Beijing hotel offers deluxe guest rooms and suites meeting international standards of comfort and technology, including 42-inch LCD TVs, high-speed Internet access and premium amenities. With 1,600 square meters of meeting and banquet facilities, our hotel in downtown Beijing offers breathtaking spaces for weddings and business meetings, as well as the assistance of our well-trained event professionals. Our hotel also offers an on-site fitness center, heated indoor pool and three restaurants and bars. We look forward to greeting you soon at our upscale hotel in the middle of China's Chaoyang CBD District.

hotels.descriptionZh: 北京怀柔万豪酒店坐落于怀柔科学城核心区域，毗邻雁栖湖国际会展中心，距市中心约60公里，坐拥静谧自然与科技氛围。酒店周边汇聚中科院物理研究所、中科院空天信息创新研究院等顶尖科研机构，并可轻松抵达雁栖湖风景区、红螺寺、慕田峪长城等自然与文化胜地，成就“科技+生态”交融的旅居体验。交通亦十分便捷，距怀柔北站约10分钟车程，首都国际机场约65分钟。酒店拥有1365平方米灵活多功能会议空间，包括565平方米无柱宴会厅及4间组合会议室，满足各类高端活动需求。272间客房以黄花城水纹为设计灵感，配备高端设施与定制用品，尽显现代雅致。贡厨全日制餐厅、万豪中餐厅、大堂吧与行政酒廊共同呈现多元美食体验，恒温泳池、24小时健身房与儿童俱乐部更为一站式旅居增添活力与惬意，是商务差旅、家庭度假与活动举办的理想之所。
hotels.descriptionEn: Beijing Marriott Hotel Huairou is situated in the heart of Huairou Science City, adjacent to the Yanqi Lake International Convention Center. Surrounded by leading research institutions, it offers convenient access to attractions like Yanqi Lake, Hongluo Temple, and Mutianyu Great Wall, delivering a unique blend of technology and nature. The hotel boasts excellent connectivity, approximately 10 minutes from Huairou North Station and 65 minutes from Beijing Capital International Airport. The hotel features 1,389 square meters of meeting space, including a 565-square-meter pillar-free ballroom and four modular meeting rooms. Its 272 guest rooms blend modern elegance with design inspiration from the rippling waters of Huanghuacheng. Diverse dining options are available at GOJI, MOHAO, and the Lobby Lounge, while a heated swimming pool, fitness center, and kids' club complete the leisure experience. This makes it an ideal choice for both business travelers and family vacations.

hotels.descriptionEn: Aloft Beijing Huairou is located in the Huairou Science City of Beijing. The new hotel is surrounded by abundant tourist resources, and guests can easily reach famous scenic spots. Featuring 242 guestrooms, the hotel offers Western cuisines and Beijing's local cuisine at Depot by Aloft, its all-day dining restaurant, a selection of grab & go meals at Re:Fuel as well as signature cocktails at W XYZ Bar. Additional facilities include the hotel's Splash pool, 24/7 Re:Charge Gym, Kids Club for families traveling with childrens.   Aloft Beijing Huairou will provide a fashionable and innovative stay experience full of vitality for music enthusiasts, as well as those who pursue high-touch, and design aesthetics.

hotels.descriptionZh: 多年来，王府井大街一直是各种活动的中心，时至今日，步行街仍是深受外来游客和当地居民青睐的旅游、购物胜地。作为万豪国际集团旗下的五星级酒店，北京金茂万丽酒店闹中取静，提供豪华的设施设备和细致入微的服务，让宾客在繁华地段尽享商旅体验。酒店位于北京市中心，距离故宫约2公里，距离天安门广场约4公里，距离地铁8号线约400米，共有321间客房，其中包括16间套房，每间都融汇了时尚现代与温馨典雅的色调，其中西区客房可欣赏到紫禁城的美景。 宾客可以方便地前往附近的小吃街享用当地特色美食，也可以在酒店的餐厅和酒吧品尝来自世界各地的美食佳肴。近1000平米的宴会厅在王府井地区位列前茅，并设有五间可灵活布置的会议室，可满足您的不同需求。酒店设施时尚现代，室内泳池和健身中心，为宾客悉心打造健康生活方式。
hotels.descriptionEn: Deftly combining traditional elegance and modern style as a Marriott Luxury and Lifestyle Hotel, the Renaissance Beijing Wangfujing Hotel delivers an enchanting experience in the heart of the city. Set against the backdrop of Beijing's lively Wangfujing Street, our hotel offers immaculately designed rooms and suites - many of which feature breathtaking views of the Forbidden City, one of China's most beloved landmarks. Iconic attractions including Tiananmen Square are just moments from our door, as are the local delicacies of Snack Street. As a guest at the hotel you will enjoy access to our fitness center as well as our serene indoor pool. Delicious onsite dining options abound, ranging from the seasonal tastes of China at Wanli to international fare and an exciting open kitchen atmosphere at Food Studio. Planning an event in Beijing book the impressive Jinmao Ballroom the largest of its kind in Wangfujing.

hotels.descriptionZh: 经过整体焕新升级后的北京金融街威斯汀大酒店2020年耀目归来。酒店位于北京核心二环内的西城区金融街，邻近众多国际闻名的金融机构和购物中心，以及天安门广场、故宫博物院、中国国家博物馆、妙应寺白塔等城市文化地标景点。宾客步行可达4条地铁线路，乘坐1号线可直达北京环球影城，2号线直达雍和宫，4号线直达动物园、圆明园，19号线一站即达传统美食一条街——牛街；酒店距离北京南站约20分钟车程，距离首都国际机场约45分钟车程，距离大兴国际机场约60分钟车程，为休闲及商务旅客提供便捷的出行选择。升级后的酒店共有9个自然采光充足的会议室，总面积可达到1,618平方米。483间修饰一新后的客房，显得更为宽敞雅致，搭配特色威斯汀天梦之床和薰衣草睡眠精油，让每一位宾客更深刻地体会到威斯汀的酣然好梦。位于酒店五层的威斯汀健身中心和恒温泳池，让宾客在旅途中尽享活力运动的健康生活。一层Plush大堂吧通透的设计将自然光引入室内，是商务会谈和品味美味下午茶的理想之选；食集自助餐厅为宾客提供各种环球美食和本地精选美味；Prego地中海餐厅提供经典美味的地中海美食，让每一位宾客足不出户就能品尝到浪漫的美食。与此同时，酒店26层行政酒廊为每一位行政楼层的宾客在提供精致美食之外，更能一览北京繁华景致。
hotels.descriptionEn: Newly renovated in 2020, The Westin Beijing Financial Street is located in the Financial Street of Xicheng District, close to many internationally renowned financial institutions and shopping centers, the city's cultural landmarks such as Tian'anmen Square, The Palace Museum, etc. Guests are able to walk to 4 subway lines, Line 1 to Beijing Universal Studios, Line 2 to The Lama Temple, Line 4 to The Old Summer Palace, one stop to the traditional food street - Niujie Street by Line 19; 45 minutes' driving distance to Beijing Capital International Airport and 60 minutes' to Beijing Daxing International Airport.Each spacious guest room is elegantly decorated and offers free Wi-Fi, TV and more, plus the signature Westin Heavenly Bed. Take a dip in our indoor swimming pool, get in some exercise at our Westin Workout. With three dining options on site offering a variety of cuisines, you won’t have to venture far to find extraordinary food. Enrich your mind with high-quality accommodations and instinctive services.

Hotel features 439 stylish guest rooms with Sheraton's signature Sleep Experience bedding, guests can also enjoy 3 restaurants featuring Western, Itameshi and Lounge with 24 - hour Sheraton Fitness Center with sunlit indoor swimming pool for relaxation. A signature Sheraton Open Art Gallery also perfectly embodying the Sheraton DNA of the World’s gathering place. It brings art to the community with Sheraton Community mindset, we have everything you need to work, stay and play in Beijing.

Relax in contemporary hotel rooms and suites, family suites or private villas. Many of the rooms enjoy balconies overlooking the mountains. Accommodation features include flat-screen TVs, sofas, large desks and WiFi access. Private villas offer open kitchens and access to an inviting courtyard hot springs pool. Resort guests can take a dip in the infinity pool and indoor and outdoor hot springs. Take advantage of our restaurants, day spa and gym. Sophisticated meeting and wedding venues are spread across nearly 48,500 square feet of space. Explore outlet shopping and the theme park or travel beyond Changping to sights including Beijing's Juyongguan Great Wall, Badaling Great Wall and Ming Tombs.

hotels.descriptionEn: The St. Regis Beijing is located in the heart of Beijings quiet, diplomatic compound in a noble setting only 400 meters away from a city highway leading you directly to Beijing Capital Airport or Railway South Station. It takes about 7 minutes to walk from the hotel to Jianguomen Subway Station, and Subway Line 2 will directly lead to worker stadium, Subway Line 1 will directly lead to Universal Resort Subway Station. Our luxury hotel offers many of the legendary St. Regis traditions created at The St. Regis New York, including our personalized Butler Service, Evening Ritual, Afternoon Tea and the St. Regis Bloody Mary. After a stroll along Wangfujing, a famous shopping street, indulge yourself at our Iridium Spa, complete with a natural hot spring that originates 1,500 meters below the surface. Let us pamper you with additional luxury amenities, such as a stunning glass walled swimming pool, a 6,000 sq meter landscaped garden, three exceptional restaurants and two signature bars.

hotels.descriptionZh: 开启迷人的北京之旅。北京这座拥有悠久历史的古城融合了时尚现代的风貌和历久弥新的文化古韵，现代化的建筑楼群与古代宫殿在这里交相辉映，别具风采。北京万豪行政公寓装修豪华，并紧邻王府井大街。 公寓拥有一居室，两居室，家庭套房、亲子套房和三卧室公寓式客房共220套，每套客房均提供设施齐全的厨房、用餐区、客厅、高速无线上网，这里是各种短期和长期住宿的理想之选。北京万豪行政公寓内设有健身中心和室内阳光泳池，可一览故宫景致。步行距离可轻松到达天安门广场及故宫博物院等名胜。宾客可前往位于二层的怡然居享用国际美食。 在这里，城市精彩触手可及。
hotels.descriptionEn: Experience the ideal blend of location and welcoming services at The Imperial Mansion, Beijing Marriott Executive Apartments. Situated in Wangfujing, in the midst of Beijings business, entertainment and shopping area, our hotel is the ideal choice for every traveler to this exciting city. Feel at home in our generously-sized, one, two and three bedroom, family and kids apartments, each with a fully-equipped kitchen, a dining room, a living room, complimentary WiFi and great amenities. Take in views of the Forbidden City from the fitness center and our light-filled indoor pool with soaring skylights. Enjoy delicious dining in our Residents Lounge, where our hotel's chefs create tempting international cuisine. Nearby, you'll find Tiananmen Square and Forbidden City, Wangfujing Street, temples, parks and nightlife. Whether staying with us for vacation or an extended visit, we look forward to welcoming you to our Apartments.

hotels.descriptionZh: 北京粤财JW万豪酒店坐拥古都北京市中心宣武门黄金地段，遥望天安门、故宫、西单等多个名园胜景及繁华商业区。出行方便快捷，多条地铁线近在咫尺。酒店共有406间客房，房间宽敞舒适，设计现代时尚。60间套房中包括17间配备厨房的公寓套房及13间设有开放式景观阳台的空中花园套房。24小时“为您服务”专员为宾客提供全天候、高水准的个性化服务。酒店拥有2,500平方米先进的宴会与会议空间，800平方米无柱大宴会厅层高6.7米，配有30平米高清LED屏幕和投影仪，并且可分隔成三个小会议厅。300平方米的大客厅为公寓风格，设有多功能会议区域、就餐区和开放式厨房，使工作与娱乐无缝对接。酒店三间主题餐厅及一间酒吧提供当地及各国美食体验，顶层的豪华健身俱乐部设有24小时高科技健身房、按摩浴池、蒸汽室和桑拿房，以及玻璃屋顶标准恒温泳池，让宾客在此能够放松身心，享受一份恬静。为了给各位宾客带来更具个性化的视听体验，我们精心提供了包括中文和英文在内的多语言电视频道。酒店即将引入今日俄罗斯与俄罗斯环球等频道，进一步丰富我们的频道选择，确保所有下榻于此的客人都能感受到家一般的温馨与熟悉。
hotels.descriptionEn: JW Marriott Hotel Beijing Central enjoys a prime location in Xuanwumen, the ancient heart of Beijing, ideal for both executive retreats and leisure travelers. The hotel features 406 luxuriously appointed guestrooms, including approximately 17 Residence Suites equipped with kitchens and 13 Sky Garden Suites. Three restaurants and one lounge provide a variety of local and international gourmet experiences. The top-floor health club offers guests exquisite experience of 24-hour full-quipped gym, whirlpool, steam, sauna and a swimming pool with abundant natural light. A dedicated event floor includes an 800 sqm Grand Ballroom, a 300 sqm residential-style Living Room and nine function rooms. To create a more tailored viewing experience, we provide multi-language TV channels including Chinese and English. We are excited to soon expand our selection with RT Russia Today TV and RTR Russsia Television and Radio-Planeta, ensuring all guests feel at home.

We are a 10-minute drive from the SKP Shopping Mall (Beijing’s most luxurious shopping district), China World Trade Center (the commercial hub inside the CBD), the CCTV building (Beijing’s poster construction), and much more.  The Line 1 Subway nearby provides fast, direct access to the Forbidden City and other UNESCO sites, The Great Hall of the People, the National Center for Performing Arts, and Universal Studios Beijing.  The adjacent China Red Sandalwood Museum allows a quick cultural experience when time is short.  And the Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) is only 30 minutes away.Welcome to convenient, new luxury living at The Sandalwood Beijing Marriott Executive Apartments.

hotels.descriptionZh: 若您想在天津国家会展中心附近寻得一处放松休憩之地，国家会展中心天津福朋喜来登酒店便是您的理想选择。酒店地处天津大道与地铁1号线国瑞路地铁站旁，距离机场和火车站都不到30分钟车程，交通十分便利。复古现代的室内设计，灵感来自水手们的港口生活，301间简约雅致的客房可让宾客尽享舒适与惬意。“玩啤食社”作为品牌的新概念餐饮，是集多种功能与一体的灵活多元化空间，除了享用地道美食，亦可来杯现磨咖啡、点杯当地精酿啤酒、与挚友聊天或是游戏聚会。有会议或活动需求的宾客拥有6个灵活场地可以选择，方便活动策划师为您量身定制活动方案。酒店与国家会展中心天津万豪酒店毗邻而居，使得宾客能够充分利用额外的设施设备，比如餐厅，健身中心，游泳池和会议空间。
hotels.descriptionEn: If you are looking for a place to kick back and wind down by the Tianjin National Convention & Exhibition Center, Four Points by Sheraton, Tianjin National Convention and Exhibition Center is just the ideal choice. Set beside Tianjin Avenue and Guoruilu Metro station of Line 1, the hotel is within 30 minutes’ drive to the airport or train station. With a vintage modern interior design here inspired by the life of sailors at the port, an easy and comfortable relaxing time could be spent in one of our 301 guest rooms. As a new Food & Beverage concept outlet, The Mesh offers a flexible and diversified space with a variety of functions. For meetings and events, a total of 6 flexible event spaces awaits to cater guests with different needs. The hotel is connected with Tianjin Marriott Hotel National Convention and Exhibition Center, which allows guests to take advantage of extra amenities such as corridor to the Convention Center, restaurants, fitness center and event spaces.

hotels.descriptionZh: 国家会展中心天津万豪酒店与天津国家会展中心相连通，东方韵味与欧洲典雅并存，是您恢复活力、探索美食、激发灵感的理想之地。坐落于天津大道与1号线国瑞路地铁站旁，30分钟内车程即可抵达机场或火车站，从酒店到达交通枢纽十分便捷。389间宽敞现代并精心设计的客房搭配全景落地玻璃窗，令房间内拥有充足的自然光线并同时将迷人的城市天际线尽收眼底。品牌特色的万豪中餐厅，主理粤菜、新京菜和淮扬菜，餐厅设有10间雅致的私人包厢，是亲朋聚餐、商务宴请的理想之选；贡厨全日制餐厅提供零点菜单及品类丰富、食材新鲜的本地和国际自助美食，宾客还可享用开放式厨房现场烹制的各类海鲜以及西式和亚洲风味精选。室内半无边星空穹顶泳池及24小时健身房可供宾客度过惬意的闲暇时光，万豪贵宾廊更为尊贵的会员提供私人空间、创造专属体验。1196平米的津韵大宴会厅以及其他10个灵活场地，可满足商务会议、社交活动和精致婚礼等各种需求。酒店与国家会展中心天津福朋喜来登酒店毗邻而居，使得宾客能够享用额外的餐饮和会议空间。
hotels.descriptionEn: With a direct entrance to Tianjin National Convention and Exhibition Center, Tianjin Marriott Hotel National Convention and Exhibition Center is set next to Tianjin Avenue and Guoruilu Metro station of Line 1, its convenient to reach the airport or train station that are both within 30 minutes drive. Each of the 389 guestrooms have been thoughtfully designed with floor-to-ceiling windows allow sufficient natural light and offer the captivating view of the city skyline. Chinese restaurant Man Ho serves authentic Cantonese cuisines, Beijing cuisine with a modern twist and Huai Yang cuisines in an elegant interior with ten appointed private dining rooms. All-day-dining restaurant Goji Kitchen+Bar serves local and international delicacies with a la carte menu and buffet features live cooking station. Kicking back and relaxing at the beautiful indoor swimming pool or work up a sweat at 24-hours gym. A 12,874-square-feet Grand Ballroom and 10 function meeting spaces ideal for various meetings and events.

hotels.descriptionZh: 在天津母亲河海河之畔，一座承载着城市记忆的历史建筑，经岁月雕琢后焕发新生。天津市和平区解放北路 10 号，天津解放桥福朋喜来登酒店静立于此，与天津火车站仅一河之隔，毗邻解放桥、世纪钟等标志性景点，将海河的旖旎风光尽收眼底。这座由原信托邮储银行历史风貌建筑改建而成的酒店，宛如一本厚重的历史书卷，等待着每一位宾客翻开，探寻其中的故事与传奇。​它的建筑风格融合了当时的流行元素，承载着无数人的回忆与情怀。如今，在保留建筑原有历史风貌的基础上，注入现代奢华与舒适的元素。踏入酒店，仿佛穿梭于时光隧道，古老的楼梯承载着岁月的痕迹，每一级台阶都诉说着过往的故事。酒店共设有 6 种房型，97 间精心设计的客房与套房，每一间都将福朋喜来登品牌的舒适与时尚完美融合。客房内采用温馨雅致的色调，搭配高品质的床品，柔软的床垫、蓬松的羽绒被以及多款特色靠枕，为宾客打造一夜好眠。房间内智能化设备：便捷的灯光、温度调节系统，满足宾客个性化需求，迷你吧、咖啡机等设施更是为旅居生活增添惬意。​
hotels.descriptionEn: Standing quietly at No. 10 Jiefang North Road, Heping District, Tianjin, Four Points by Sheraton Tianjin Jiefang Bridge is just across the river from Tianjin Railway Station and adjacent to landmark attractions like Jiefang Bridge and Century Clock, offering a stunning view of the Haihe River's charming scenery.Converted from the historic building of the former Trust Postal Savings Bank, the hotel is like a decorous history book, waiting for every guest to open it and explore the stories and legends within. The hotel has 6 room types with 97 carefully designed guest rooms and suites, each perfectly integrating the comfort and fashion of the Four Points by Sheraton brand. The rooms adopt warm and elegant colors, paired with high-quality bedding soft mattresses, fluffy duvets and a variety of characteristic pillows to create a good night's sleep for guests.

hotels.descriptionEn: The arrival of the Courtyard by Marriott Tianjin Hongqiao, the brand’s first foray into the city, draws business and leisure travelers from around the globe. Catering to this discerning group, the hotel offers a location within the Lujiazui Business Center, moments from the XIBEIJIAO Metro station and traditional Muslim Food Street. 7 minutes from the West Railway station. Dining is also available in-room, where guests can work peacefully at a large desk or settle into a cozy sofa. The hotel offers six event spaces and select meeting and business services. To break from work, guests can head to the fitness center. Spring flowers, summer music, nighttime glow along the river, winter tea and crosstalk. For Specific details, please contact the hotel at 86 22 58985555.

hotels.descriptionEn: The TEDA, Tianjin-Marriott Executive Apartments combines the amenities of a luxury hotel with the privacy of a residence in the affluent Tianjin Economic Technological Development Area of Tianjin Binhai New Area. Connected to the 5-star Renaissance Tianjin TEDA Convention Centre Hotel, our 15-story hotel is ideal for long stays with world-class dining, a health club and indoor pool, a relaxing spa and a central location near Financial Street and corporations in the Free Trade Zone. For families, we offer a kid’s club and easy access to the prestigious Tianjin International School and Tianjin Maple Leaf International High School. We offer studio and one, two and three-bedroom furnished apartments, each with a full kitchen, free Wi-Fi and satellite TV, as well as housekeeping, grocery shopping, room service and on-demand limousine services. We also provide an upscale venue for business meetings with gourmet dining, a meeting butler and 12 multi-function rooms with over 64,000 sq. ft. of event space.

hotels.descriptionEn: Discover the perfect venue from which to balance business and leisure during extended stays in Tianjin, China. The Lakeview Tianjin, Marriott Executive Apartments welcomes you as a quiet oasis of calm within the Central Financial District. Choose from one, two and three-bedroom serviced apartments each equipped with a full kitchen, in unit laundry, HDTV, high speed Internet, private safe, and more. Take advantage of our health club. Swim in our indoor pool, unwind in three whirlpools, and even indoor simulated golf. Enjoy tennis throughout the year in our unique indoor facilities, or take a soothing lakefront stroll through our garden. Moments from downtown and the airport, near the Tianjin Museum, Tianjin Grand Theatre and Tianjin Olympic Sports Center.Our serviced apartments are positioned at the city's focal point, ideal for business, relocation, and long stays in Tianjin China.

With its contemporary interiors and expansive 6,109 square meters of event space complemented by technologically advanced features and fine catering, this impressive meeting and conference hotel easily hosts a variety of events. At our Tianjin 5-star hotel, you can sample a tantalizing choice of food and wine from the open kitchen of Renaissance Brasserie. Unwind from the rigors of the day at the impressive health club or with a swim in the 25-metre pool. And when the day is done, retreat to a spacious guest room featuring tasteful decor, plush designer bedding and high-speed Internet connections. A stay at our 5-star hotel in Tianjin, China is truly an extraordinary one.

hotels.descriptionZh: 时尚豪华的重庆 JW 万豪酒店，驻于海航保利国际中心大厦，地处重庆市中心繁华地段，地理位置优越，周边交通非常便利。酒店拥有 451 间宽敞的客房，环境装饰及设施用品时尚雅致，为您缔造轻松愉悦体验。酒店内设多间特色餐厅，供应重庆地方特色美食以及各式国际风味美食，全日提供餐饮服务。酒店拥有约 2,200 平米多功能活动空间，配备齐全的现代科技设施，是在重庆举办各种活动的理想商务酒店。酒店配备专业的活动保障团队，可提供卓越的活动策划和餐饮服务，从盛大婚礼到小型商务聚会均可胜任。此外，酒店还设有室内泳池、静谧水疗中心以及装备齐全的健身中心等设施。咫尺开外即是解放碑等热门景点，您可轻松开启探索之旅。
hotels.descriptionEn: The contemporary, elegant JW Marriott Hotel Chongqing rising high near the prominent Chongqing People's Liberation Monument, welcoming you to the heart of Chongqing. Holding the distinction, providing curated amenities and sophisticated services, our hotel is catering to the wishes of distinguished and neoteric guests. Experience the comfort of the luxury, savor the delicacy of the world, your memorable and mindful escape inaugurates here.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店拥有360间现代化客房，以巧妙设计充分利用空间，使宾客可根据自身需求灵活调整房间布局。宾客可以享受房间内各种设计独到的设施和用品，豪华舒适的床品、尺寸灵活的工作台以及替代衣橱的钉物墙。每间客房均配有Moxy品牌标志性的可折叠办公桌椅、50~55 英寸纯平电视、床头 USB 接口、迷你冰箱、步入式淋浴间以及免费高速无线网络，让宾客能够全天保持畅联。宾客还可以使用万豪旅享家APP在移动端快捷办理入住、退房，并使用数码钥匙进入房间。
hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel has 360 modern rooms, cleverly designed to make the most of the space, allowing guests to flexibly adjust the layout of their rooms according to their needs. Guests can enjoy a variety of specially designed amenities and amenities in the room, including luxurious and comfortable bedding, flexible work tables and studded walls that replace wardrobes. Each room features Moxys signature foldable desk and chair, 50 to 55-inch flat-screen TV, bedside USB port, mini refrigerator, walk-in shower and free high-speed Wi-Fi to keep guests connected throughout the day. Guests can also use the Marriott Bonvoy App to quickly check in and out on mobile and access their rooms with a mobile key.

hotels.descriptionZh: 重庆北站福朋喜来登酒店坐落于重庆两江新区民安大道中段，交通便捷，出行通畅。酒店接驳地铁4号线，可一站直达重庆北站；5公里范围内覆盖朝天门、洪崖洞等热门网红景点；重庆江北国际机场距离酒店约18公里；酒店位于渝北两江新区财富广场和国博中心商圈，周边CBD聚集，白天朝气蓬勃的年青人在这里逐梦蓝图，资金流、信息流、人才流和商业流在这里合和，续写着精彩的城市传奇；夜晚川流不息的车流点亮都市璀璨霓虹，街边根须密织的大榕树，安静热烈的盛开，欢迎每一位旅途的归人。                                        酒店设计风格别具匠心，后现代工业风与时尚潮流交相辉映，宁静原木系元素与明丽的色带动静相宜，传统的石材工艺与艺术红墙炽烈碰撞，营造出惊艳的视觉冲击和独特审美韵味；酒店打造多元的社交空间，咖啡吧、商务办公、网红打卡、健身房等满足当代客群青春活力的出行需求。                                 酒店拥有各式高品质客房及套房共177间，客房创新的采用前瞻性的设计，秉承舒适旅居的人文理念，采用精致色调风格、配置有65寸的大屏LED电视、舒适的人体工学沙发、Type-c充电接口等设施，让每位旅客在旅途中享受到精致舒适的生活美学；全屋落地景观大窗，纵览迷人都市风光。                                 酒店为宾客提供多样用餐选择，满足宾客的不同饮食喜好。宾客可以在活力四射的全日制玩啤食社享用地道的重庆美食，在观赏开放式厨房的现场烹饪过程同时尽享味蕾美味时光；大堂吧提供种类繁多的中国茶、咖啡和“醇饮优选”精酿啤酒，收获悠闲时光。酒店与重庆啤酒有限公司携手推出麦作精酿系列，精心打造山城季节性特色精酿“醇饮优选”啤酒，为宾客带来原汁原味的本地风味，呈现福朋喜来登品牌标志性“醇饮优选”计划。宾客可以品味一杯醇香佳酿，收获闲适放松时光，为旅途再添滋味。                                                                                            同时，酒店设有多个宴会会议空间，浪漫奢华的婚宴场景，沉浸式影音效果，配备专业细致的策划团队，个性订制，满足宾客多种宴会及会议需求。                                                                重庆北站福朋喜来登酒店全体伙伴，恭迎品鉴！
hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing North Railway Station is located in Liangjiang New Area.The hotel is connected to Metro Line 4, one stop directly to Chongqing North Railway Station; About 5 kilometers distance are Chaotianmen, Hongya Cave and other popular destinations ; Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport is about 18 km away. The hotel gathered around the CBD between Yubei Liangjiang New Area Financial Centers and International Exhibiton Center .Hotel has a total of 177 of high-quality rooms and suites , equipped with 65 inch large screen LED TV, comfortable ergonomic sofa, Type-c charging interface and other facilities,so that each passenger in the journey to enjoy the exquisite and comfortable life aesthetics.At the same time, the hotel has a number of banquet and conference Spaces, romantic and luxurious wedding scenes, immersive audio and video effects, to meet the needs of Variety guests .All partners of Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing North Railway Station, warmly welcome your arrivals.

hotels.descriptionEn: Le Meridien Chongqing, Nan’an is part of Wanda Plaza; a new residential, shopping and entertainment destination. The downtown hotel is a 10-minute drive from the Liberation Square CBD. Also nearby are Starlight Plaza and Metro Line 3, which runs to the Chongqing Yuelai International Convention Center. A sense of passion for innovation is evident in our restaurants and public spaces. Enjoy our state-of-the-art fitness center and indoor heated pool. Stylish and sophisticated with ultra-modern technology, Le Méridien Chongqing, Nan'an offers high quality accommodations with 317 refined rooms and suites featuring unique art pieces and showcasing views of the vibrant city. An arrival experience at our hotel aims to reset the guest’s mind, leaving everyday life at the door.

hotels.descriptionZh: 秉承万怡品牌 "便捷住宿，自在随心" 的核心理念，酒店团队以万豪标准的专业素养，为商旅散客与团队提供全流程贴心服务。从高效精准的客房预订，到细致周到的团队接待，每一处细节都旨在营造舒适宁静的休憩空间。客房内精心配置的现代化设施与人性化设计，更兼顾商务需求与居住舒适度，延续了品牌在 "睡眠质量" 与 "舒适度" 上的高分口碑。餐饮体验同样诠释着品质与匠心。酒店主厨领衔的专业团队，不仅每日呈现丰盛的自助早餐，更提供贴心房间送餐服务，让美味无需等待。针对商务宴请、私人聚会等多元需求，团队可依托江津本地食材特色与精湛烹饪技艺，量身定制自助午宴、主题晚宴等个性化餐饮方案，从健康营养的搭配到地域风味的创新，全方位满足味蕾期待。
hotels.descriptionEn: Staying true to Courtyard’s core philosophy of "effortless stays, made personal," the hotel team delivers end-to-end thoughtful service for both business travelers and groups, upholding Marriott’s professional standards. From seamless room bookings to meticulous group arrangements, every detail is designed to create a tranquil retreat. Modern amenities and ergonomic touches in the rooms cater to both productivity and relaxation, reinforcing the brand’s acclaimed reputation for superior sleep quality and comfort.  Dining here is a celebration of craftsmanship and quality. Led by expert chefs, the culinary team not only curates lavish daily breakfast buffets but also offers in-room dining for convenience. For business banquets or private gatherings, customized menus—from lunch buffets to themed dinners—highlight local Jiangjin ingredients and innovative regional flavors, balancing nutrition with creativity to delight every palate.

hotels.descriptionZh: 重庆解放碑威斯汀酒店位于解放碑中心，是山城时尚地标性酒店。酒店大堂设于51层，挑高10米，360°落地全景玻璃窗打造出200米高空的云端景观大堂，住客可俯瞰解放碑两江汇聚的山水风光，下楼即是繁华的解放碑商圈，长江索道、洪崖洞等热门景区。酒店拥有333客房及套房，配套威斯汀天梦之床，丹麦B&O液晶电视、符合人体工学的Herman Miller办公座椅等。53层锦肴轩·川上精攻二十四味型川菜，餐厅内的270度玻璃观景屋、54层天际泳池以及频出新意的停机坪创意都市系列亦是各大潮人山城必打卡之地。
hotels.descriptionEn: Surrounded by popular shops, prestigious businesses and tourist attractions, The Westin Chongqing Liberation Square is a haven of wellness and renewal. Immerse yourself in a calming oasis in scenic hotel accommodations with modern technologies, LCD TVs, Dyson hair dryer, capsule coffee machine, high-speed Wi-Fi and signature Heavenly® Beds. hotels.descriptionZh: 重庆渝中半岛福朋喜来登酒店雄踞于“山城”核心——渝中半岛，坐拥得天独厚的地理位置，交通便利，毗邻重庆多个网红打卡景点（人民大礼堂、解放碑、洪崖洞、李子坝轻轨、观音桥等）。酒店共拥有215间客房，融合现代设计和贴心细节，助您卸下旅途疲惫，焕活身心。酒店内设施齐全，玩啤食社（全日制餐厅）、特色中餐包房、会议室、多功能厅等，场地灵活多变，配备齐全的现代科技设施，是您举办商务会议、大型庆典及私人宴会的理想之选。无论您因何到访重庆，重庆渝中半岛福朋喜来登酒店都将以真诚的服务伴您开启一段精彩纷呈的山城之旅。
hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Chongqing Yuzhong Peninsula,stands at the core of the "Mountain City" - Yuzhong Peninsula. It enjoys an exceptional geographical location and convenient transportation, adjacent to several popular tourist attractions in Chongqing (such as the People's Grand Hall, Liberation Square, and Hongya Cave). The hotel features 215 guest rooms, integrating modern design and attentive details, allowing you to relieve your travel fatigue and rejuvenate your body and mind. The hotel is fully equipped with various facilities, including the Beer Bar (all-day dining restaurant), special Chinese banquet rooms, meeting rooms, and multi-function halls. The venue is flexible and versatile, equipped with complete modern technological facilities. It is an ideal choice for you to hold business meetings, large-scale celebrations, and private banquets. No matter why you visit Chongqing, we will provide sincere service to accompany you on an exciting journey through the mountain city.

hotels.descriptionZh: 东莞松山湖雅乐轩酒店坐落于松山湖科技产业园，现代设计融合轻快色彩，主打年轻化体验。地铁1号线松佛站步行800米即达，距深圳宝安机场约1.5小时车程，交通便捷。客房简约明快，部分落地窗可览湖景，配备舒适床品与Bliss沐浴品牌。聚聚乐餐厅提供中西式自助早餐，推荐广式米粉与手工肉松面包。酒店设172平米宴会厅及500㎡会议空间，2楼健身房免费开放，3楼24小时自助洗衣烘房，轻松兼顾商务休闲。 步行1分钟达万科生活广场，5分钟漫步“松湖烟雨”，周边汇聚万象汇、山姆会员店、悠兰里文化艺术街区及望野博物馆，畅享湖城相融的漫游体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Aloft Dongguan Songshan Lake is located in the Songshan Lake Tech Park, featuring modern design with vibrant colors. It's an 800m walk from Songfo Station (Metro Line 1) and a 1.5hr drive from Shenzhen Bao'an Airport.Rooms are sleek with lake views, comfy beds, and Bliss bath products. Nook Restaurant serves a breakfast buffet with local rice noodles and buns. The hotel offers a 172㎡ ballroom, 500㎡ meeting space, a free 2nd-floor gym, and a 24hr laundry on the 3rd floor.Vanke Life Square is a minute away; "Songhu Misty Rain" is a 5min walk. Nearby Mixc One, Sam's Club, and art districts offer a great city-meets-nature experience.

hotels.descriptionZh: 东莞万豪酒店位于市中心东城中路，毗邻旗峰山公园，掩映于繁茂绿意之间。酒店交通便利，距离东莞站约15公里、深圳宝安国际机场约43公里、广州白云国际机场约60公里，尽享大湾区生活圈的高效便捷。酒店地理位置优越，可轻松前往东莞核心区域的多个繁华商圈，及虎英公园、可园博物馆、迎恩门等城市地标，畅享城市人文与自然美景交融的独特魅力。                    东莞万豪酒店以自然敬畏的初心呼应自然本源，将岭南山水意境融入当代设计语言，构筑一处离尘不离城的静谧桃源。酒店2025年焕新启幕，262间客房及40间行政公寓以简约东方美学为底色，融入现代雅致格调。大部分客房配备观景阳台，或远眺旗峰山峦叠翠，或私享都市宁静绿洲。室外山景泳池、室内恒温泳池及健身房焕活身心；大堂吧及行政酒廊为旅居提供尊贵休憩享受；都会尚膳全日制餐厅呈现缤纷国际佳肴；万豪中餐厅匠心演绎地道粤式风味。 酒店配备2,246平方米会议及宴会空间，自然采光充足的多功能厅及会议室满足多样商务需求，宴会厅180度全景落地窗将葱郁山景映入室内，营造绿意环抱的视觉享受。此外，占地800平方米的户外宴会空间，更是举办草坪婚礼仪式、庆典酒会等的理想之所，于蓝天白云与繁花绿意间，见证非凡的人生重要时刻！以自然为幕，以文化底蕴为笔，重新定义大湾区都会旅居美学。在山水与城市的交响中，抵达身心归属的理想之境。身栖繁华，心泊云上！
hotels.descriptionEn: Dongguan Marriott Hotel is located in the city center, adjacent to Qifengshan Park. Conveniently positioned, it is 15 km from Dongguan Railway Station, 43 km from Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport and 60 km from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, with easy access to core commercial districts and landmarks like Huying Park and Keyuan Museum.Inspired by reverence for nature, the hotel integrates Lingnan landscape aesthetics into contemporary design, offering a quiet urban retreat.Renovated in 2025, it has 262 guest rooms and 40 executive apartments with understated Oriental and modern styles. Most rooms have viewing balconies. Guests can enjoy outdoor/indoor pools, a fitness center, Lobby Lounge, City Breeze All-Day Dining and Marriott Chinese Restaurant.With 2,246㎡ of meeting/banquet space, it caters to business and events like lawn weddings, with the banquet hall boasting 180° mountain-view windows.Redefining Greater Bay Area urban hospitality, Dongguan Marriott is your ideal sanctuary.

hotels.descriptionEn: Find space to thrive at Sheraton Dongguan Hotel a beautiful destination set among lush gardens in Dongguan China. Our hotel is just a 20 minute drive from Humen Railway Station and an hour by car from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport; Shenzhen Baoan Airport is 40 minutes away. The CTS shuttle bus service available from hotel to HK city, Shenzhen bay and HK airport. Make yourself comfortable in spacious hotel rooms, complimentary WiFi, well-appointed bathrooms and the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience Bed. Relax by the outdoor pool or maintain your fitness at the 24 hour gym. Those planning events in Guangdong Province can choose from 1,075 square meters off Ballroom space, trust our seasoned planners and caterers to manage every detail ensuring a successful occasion. We look forward to welcoming you to Sheraton Dongguan Hotel.

hotels.descriptionEn: Aloft Nanhai, Foshan is conveniently located in Shishan Town, just a stone's throw away from the Nanhai Economic Development Zone with many businesses and universities. We're also just a short two-minute walk from Hexin Plaza and Shishan Square's shopping mall. Meet and mingle with friends at our onsite bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from Nook Restaurant, our 24/7 pantry. Plus, you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower, custom amenities by Bliss® Spa and more. Our plug and play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to the 42” LCD TV to maximize work and play. A hairdryer and free toiletries are also included.

hotels.descriptionEn: Foshan Marriott Hotel is centrally located in Foshan, a city with rich Lingnan culture, a premium hotel to provide guests with a city retreat in Southern China. The hotel is situated at the Guangdong Financial High-Tech Service Zone in Nanhai district. The hotel is part of a commercial complex complete with an upscale shopping mall, enabling the hotel to be the ideal place for business and leisure travels. over 4,000 square meters of versatile event and meeting space, including a 1,800-square-meter pillar-less Grand Ballroom with a ceiling height of 13 meters that can be divided into three banquet halls and is outfitted with a 180-square-meter built-in LED screen. The 270 sophisticated guestrooms feature high-speed wireless, ergonomic workspaces and Marriott’s “Revive” bedding, guest could enjoy a scenic view of Qiandeng Lake.  Guests looking for delectable dining can experience the unique flavors at our signature Man Ho Chinese Restaurant and all-day-dining restaurant.

hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard by Marriott Foshan Hotel is located in the Guangdong Financial High-Tech Service Zone-the center business hub of Nanhai district, Foshan. The hotel is also part of an all-in-one commercial complex project with upscale shopping mall in distinctive style, which is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard by Marriott Shunde Longjiang is situated in the core commercial district of Longjiang Town, known as the "Furniture Capital of China." The hotel features a contemporary design that integrates wood, marble, and stainless steel elements. It offers 258 spacious guest rooms with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows, dedicated workspaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, 42-inch LCD TVs, and modern marble bathrooms with separate wet and dry areas. Dining options include the Pavilion restaurant and YiCui Chinese Restaurant, which specializes in authentic Cantonese dim sum and Shunde local dishes. Leisure facilities comprise a 24-hour fitness center, an outdoor swimming pool, and recreational options such as pickleball courts.

hotels.descriptionZh: 广州 W 酒店坐落于欣欣向荣的珠江新城, 以生机勃勃的城市元素为经纬线, 汇聚一系列现代建筑、历史遗迹、豪华购物中心和娱乐场所, 织就一幅光彩夺目的锦绣画卷。酒店地处城市繁华中心地带, 步行可达多处历史景点以及地铁站和广州东火车站。酒店标帜餐厅, 全天候供应地道丰盛的中式佳肴和国际风味人气料理, 让广大美食爱好者一饱口福。您也可以前往 WOOBAR 酒吧小酌， 品赏特色酒饮。W 酒廊为酒店时尚现代的混搭风格锦上添花，而 FIT 健身中心， WET® 泳池和 AWAY® 水疗中心则可以助您放松身心、重焕活力。酒店 317 间客房（包括 32 间豪华套房）散发着传统与创新交相互融的魅力, 配备 W 睡床和按摩浴缸等别具特色的设施, 并采用先进的科技、华丽的装潢和气派的布局, 带给您非同凡响的住宿体验。在专业策划师的精心协助下, 酒店别具风格的会议场地可以让平平无奇的活动变得分外出彩。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the city’s bustling Pearl River New Town District, W Guangzhou weaves the city's vibrant threads into a dazzling tapestry of modern architecture, rich history, luxury shopping and captivating entertainment. This city center hotel is steps from ancient sites, as well as the Metro and Guangzhou East Railway Station. All-day dining restaurant The Kitchen Table offering authentic Chinese and international cuisines to tempt every epicurean. After sampling those tantalizing tastes, discover signature sips in WOOBAR. W Lounge adds to the avant-garde mix, while FIT, WET and AWAY Spa fuse relaxation and rejuvenation. A magnetic intersection of heritage and innovation, our 317 hotel rooms, including 32 luxury suites, unite unique amenities, like our signature W Bed and indulgent jetted tubs, with top technology, glamorous décor and generous layouts. Our elevated, city center venues, supported by expert planners, take ordinary events and turn them into extraordinary productions.

hotels.descriptionZh: 广州奥园喜来登酒店地处番禺万博CBD核心位置，毗邻5A景区广州长隆度假区。拥有便捷的交通直达城市交通枢纽，步行约5分钟即可抵达地铁7号线、18号线南村万博站，约10分钟车程抵达长隆度假区，约20分钟到达广州琶洲会展中心；此外，广交会期间酒店内将设置境外采购商办证点，并为住店客人提供来回酒店和广交会展馆的免费穿梭巴士服务。周边餐饮购物娱乐一应俱全，步行即可抵达万达广场、番禺天河城、四海城等大型综合购物中心。酒店拥有两百余间宽敞舒适的客房和套房，分布在 30 到 41 楼，视野开阔，透过全景落地玻璃即可俯瞰城市繁华美景，匠心设计的空间可谓工作休闲两相宜，舒适睡床缔造喜来登闻名遐迩的标志性特色睡眠体验。位于41楼的行政酒廊，指定客人可享非凡礼遇，包括早餐和欢乐时光，专享行政酒廊待遇及特权。3家风格别致的餐厅汇聚中西美食，为您的味蕾带来奇妙的美食之旅。超过1375平方米的会议空间，包括一个820平方米的可分隔为两个区域的无柱式宴会厅以及8个可灵活使用的会议室及多功能会议厅，适合各种主题的会议、婚礼等。24小时开放的健身中心包含设备齐全的健身房以及室内恒温泳池。让您尽情放松、身心愉悦。
hotels.descriptionEn: Gemstones and jewels are the visual and energetic inspiration at the Sheraton Guangzhou Panyu, located in the city’s central business district near Chimelong Resort. Sparkling stones cascade from the ceiling in the lobby, where a cozy lounge invites conversation and connection over coffee and cocktails, and glass and metal features, decorative panels and a carved ceiling create a gallery-inspired setting. This aesthetic carries into accommodations where large windows overlook the city from the 30th to 41st floors, spaces are dedicated to work and relaxation and beds are designed with Sheraton’s signature sleep experience. In the Executive Lounge, select guests enjoy dedicated benefits including complimentary breakfast and happy hours. The hotels jewel box opens to reveal even more beautiful spaces, a Chinese restaurant with private dining rooms, a pillar-free ballroom with built-in LED screen, an indoor infinity pool overlooked by lounge beds and an all-day cafe with international buffets.

hotels.descriptionEn: Experience the ideal blend of location and welcoming services at Four Points by Sheraton Guangzhou, Baiyun. Located in the center of Baiyun CBD, linked directly to Baiyun Culture Square Metro Station, nearby GZ Baiyun International Convention Center, shopping malls and office towers, the hotel is a contemporary hub for business and leisure travelers. Relax in 350 beautifully appointed hotel rooms and suites with modern amenities. Enjoy great craft beer with Best Brews™ at Lobby Bar or barbecue buffet at The Mesh. A stand-alone Convention Center managed by Marriott Hotel Team, providing a flawless meeting and social engagement in versatile event space, enhanced by custom catering and experienced planning professionals. Punctuate a day of work with a refreshing dip in our outdoor pool or a workout in Fitness Center. Centered amid popular attractions, our hotel is the home base for your visit to Guangzhou, China.

hotels.descriptionZh: 现代时尚与典雅的唯美融合，广州白云国际会议中心越秀万豪酒店将成为南中国区商旅新目的地。酒店坐落于中国广州白云新城核心区域，与广州地铁2号线白云文化广场站相连；邻近广州白云国际会议中心，距离广州体育馆仅需5分钟车程，为商务旅行的客人提供便捷、优越的商业环境。陶醉于8万平米的户外园林景观，大师糅合岭南园林故事谱写蕴含文化共融、宾客汇聚的寓意。流连于酒店餐厅的美食探索：领悟万豪中餐厅传承的精致粤菜。宽敞、典雅的贡厨餐厅提供丰盛的自助早、午、晚餐。酒店配备设施先进齐全的健身中心和室内恒温泳池、瑜珈室和干、湿蒸房，助宾客祛除一天的疲惫。850间糅合传统园林和现代美学设计的客房和套房，均配备齐全的设施和室内娱乐系统。酒店拥有私密格调的独立会议中心，提供高品质的视听会议设备。占地1300平米的无柱式大宴会厅是城中宴会庆典的理想之选。广州白云国际会议中心越秀万豪酒店，为您缔造卓越非凡的酒店体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Fusing contemporary stylish and incomparable elegance, Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Baiyun is a premium hotel to provide guests with a city retreat in Southern China. Located in the center of Baiyun CBD, linked directly to Baiyun Culture Square Metro Station, the hotel is also conveniently connected to GZ Baiyun International Convention Center, providing an impeccable and friendly business surrounding area for travelers. Explore a culinary journey at one of our restaurants and bars or take a vigorous workout at our hi-tech Fitness Center and refreshing pool. An impressive stand-alone Convention Center offers top-tier function facilities and the state-of-the-art technology. The expansive 1,300 sqm pillarless ballroom is set to become the perfect destination for celebration and events. Our 850 modern hotel rooms and suites are luxuriously appointed and equipped with sophisticated in-room entertainment systems. Elevate your experience at Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Baiyun.

hotels.descriptionEn: Element Guangzhou Baiyun is located at the center of Baiyun CBD, linked directly to Baiyun Culture Square Metro Station, conveniently connected to Guangzhou Baiyun International Convention Center, Guangzhou Children’s Park, Guangdong Art Academies, Guangzhou Urban Planning Bureau, 5-minute drive away from Baiyun Mountain, Guangzhou Gymnasium, Gate 5 and CapitalLand SKY+ shopping malls, creates a convenient and nature-influenced environment especially for family visitors. Encouraging a sense of wellbeing and green lifestyle, the hotel includes Fitness Center and the Bikes to Borrow Program, which are designed for guests to stay invigorated.
