hotels.descriptionZh: 广州富力丽思卡尔顿酒店地处广州中央商务区珠江新城的核心，临近珠江，毗邻广东省博物馆、广州大剧院、广州图书馆以及时尚新地标K11购物艺术中心，与广交会新馆和广州塔隔江相望。距离白云国际机场约有45公里，或30分钟的车程。 酒店拥有350间客房，90套豪华公寓。最基础的房型均以50平方米起步，每间客房均拥有入门走廊、步入式衣帽间等贴心设计。原木板搭配柔软细腻的羊绒地毯让旅途之家倍感温馨；全新「尊贵客房」，展现当代经典与丽思卡尔顿黄金标准的精彩结合。个性化的私密、舒适与尊享，是丽思卡尔顿行政楼层的代名词。位于33楼的行政酒廊尽揽270度珠江美景，在这里，行政楼层客人可以在每日五个时段享受多彩精致的餐饮及一系列的个性化服务。 酒店拥有以米其林一星餐厅丽轩为代表的五间特色餐厅及酒吧，既承传了“食在广州”的饮食精髓，又紧贴世界美食潮流：除了尊贵粤式餐厅丽轩，还有提供地道意大利罗马菜肴的意轩意大利餐厅，国际美食舞台FOODS，欧式大堂吧珍珠酒廊和英式威士忌雪茄吧邱吉尔吧。丽思卡尔顿水疗为客人量身订制个性化的水疗及健身体验：九间理疗房，美容沙龙和水疗精品店，还有专业的理疗师热忱为您服务；24小时健身中心配有瑜伽房及罗马式室外恒温泳池，是城中的一站式休息绿洲，为宾客提供个性化休闲体验；超过3,300平方米的宴会及会议空间，包括面积达1,209平方米的无柱豪华宴会厅，资深的宴会及会议服务团队，致力为客户提供仔细周到的个性化服务，成就每个难忘的聚会。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the center of Pearl River New City, The Ritz-Carlton, Guangzhou is a luxury destination in the Southern China hub. Distinctive services and facilities include 350 guest rooms, with the Club Lounge and suites and guest rooms newly renovated, as well as five restaurants and lounges, including the signature Cantonese restaurant, Lai Heen, which has retained its Michelin star consecutively since the inaugural Michelin Guide Guangzhou in 2018. An extensive health club and The Ritz-Carlton Spa rejuvenate body and mind, while extensive catering and meeting facilities span over 3,300 square meters, including a large pillarless Grand Ballroom that measures 1,209 square meters. The Residences at The Ritz-Carlton, Guangzhou features 90 luxury serviced apartments of one to four bedrooms in size.

hotels.descriptionZh: 我们的酒店位于广州天河商务区的中心地带，邻近汇聚了广州市内大多数财富 500 强企业的中信广场和耀中广场。酒店地处市中心，位置优越，距高级购物中心和广州火车东站仅举步之遥。您可在我们的威斯汀健身馆畅快锻炼，在室内和室外泳池中尽情畅游，或享受按摩护理。还可前往我们的四家时尚餐厅和酒吧享用粤菜和意式料理等品类丰富的营养美食。酒店 444 间客房和套房均配备豪华舒适的天梦之床，室内采用挑高天花板设计，房间装饰色调柔和，助您保持心神宁静。宽敞整洁的客房内配备免费无线上网接入、平面电视，大型浴室内配有花洒和浸泡式浴缸。我们的活力客房致力于帮助您重焕身心活力，而威斯汀运动客房则可助您随心畅享健身之乐。
hotels.descriptionEn: In heart of the Tian He business district, our hotel is adjacent to CITIC Plaza and China Shine, home to the majority of the Fortune 500 companies in Guangzhou. And our ideal City Center location puts you just steps from high-end shopping and the Guangzhou East Train Station. Stay fit at our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio and in resplendent outdoor and indoor pools or reenergize with a sumptuous treatment. Enjoy delicious nourishment in our four chic restaurants and lounges, which feature a variety of cuisines including Cantonese and Italian. Our 444 hotel rooms and suites all offer the Heavenly Bed, high ceilings, and soft colors to keep you calm in spirit while in Guangzhou.  Each immaculate and spacious room offers complimentary WiFi, flat-screen TVs and large bathrooms with rainfall showers and soaking tubs. Our Renewal Rooms are a mecca of complete rejuvenation while the WestinWORKOUT Room inspires workouts at your own pace.

hotels.descriptionEn: Fairfield by Marriott Guangzhou Huadu is located in the heart of Huadu District, adjacent to the Huadu District Government and Huadu Square. It is closely adjacent to Baiye Plaza, a large comprehensive shopping center, allowing you to enjoy the fun of shopping at any time during your busy schedule. The hotel is surrounded by the scenic Huadu Lake National Wetland Park, where the beautiful lake and mountain scenery provide an ideal place for you to relax and get close to nature. It is also adjacent to the fun-filled Guangzhou Sunac Cultural Tourism City, adding more joy and excitement to your journey. With a highly advantageous geographical location, the hotel is surrounded by an integrated three-dimensional transportation network that combines airports, high-speed railways, subways, and expressways, helping you fully explore the thousand-year-old commercial capital of Guangzhou.

hotels.descriptionZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。

Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 本酒店位于广州 “东进” 战略核心腹地，坐拥黄埔临港经济区与穗港智造合作区交汇的枢纽位置，是连接广州主城、联动深圳与香港的重要门户。享有立体多维的路网体系，双地铁环伺，多条主干道与快速路贯通周边，快速通达珠江新城等核心商圈，轻松连接大湾区各主要城市。周边配套丰富完善，近百万方商业综合体、特色滨水古街满足消费休闲需求，更有十余座生态公园环绕，绿意盎然，营造宁静自然的居住环境。酒店内设 168 间雅致舒适的客房，并配备全日制餐厅 “玩啤食社”，提供丰富多样的美食；大堂吧 “醇饮优选” 精酿啤酒，是放松小酌的品质空间。此外，酒店还拥有 3 间配备先进视听设备的多功能会议室，以及全天候自助洗衣房与健身房，全面满足商务差旅与休闲住宿需求，是城市精英出行下榻的品质之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in Guangzhou's "Eastward Expansion" core, at the Huangpu Port and Sui-Hong Intelligent Manufacturing Zone intersection, it is a key gateway connecting Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. It enjoys excellent transport with two metro lines and major roads, offering 30-minute access to hubs like Zhujiang New Town for seamless Greater Bay Area connectivity. Surrounding features nearly one million sqm of commercial complexes, a waterfront ancient street, and over ten ecological parks for a tranquil, green environment.The hotel offers 168 elegant rooms. All-day dining at "The Mesh," the craft beer lobby bar "Best Brew Selection," three multi-function meeting rooms, a 24-hour laundry, and a fitness center cater to both business and leisure travelers, making it the top choice for urban elites.

All of our 291 guest rooms and suites, including our stately Presidential Suite, have everything you need for productivity and relaxation here in China. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer wonderful views over Nansha and the Jiaomen River. Throughout our hotel, local design elements blend with contemporary decor and technology. Stay connected during your time in Nansha, Guangdong with high-speed Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. Get a good night’s rest in the crisp cotton sheets of a plush Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience bed. Divisible into three sections, our hotel's pillarless grand ballroom provides an inviting setting for weddings and receptions in Guangdong, China. We can't wait to welcome you to Sheraton Guangzhou Nansha Hotel.

Enjoy essentials like the Four Comfort® Bed, delicious breakfast, fresh coffee, and great local beer with Best Brews™. Our 296 spacious guest rooms feature free WiFi and flat-screen TVs, with 24-hour room service available. hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel completed an extensive renovation following the transformed Sheraton concept in 2022. Located in the heart of Guangzhou's CBD, the hotel is connected to shopping malls, such as TEEMALL, Grandview Mall, and Taikoo Hui. The hotel is right at the intersection of two major metro lines, Line 1 and Line 3, providing easy access to Canton Fair Complex and airport. The hotel's 445 newly renovated rooms are bright and spacious, with an emphasis on energy and personalised experiences. The hotel features an all-day-dining restaurant, Bene Italian & Seafood Kitchen, Yue Chinese Restaurant, and the hotel's lobby bar, &More by Sheraton. The hotel has 13 event venues, including a grand ballroom. Our valued guests can enjoy natural light in the fitness centre and executive lounge while overlooking Tianhe Sports Centre. The hotel offers a heated outdoor pool, making it the ideal place to relax. Free shuttle service between the hotel and Canton Fair Complex is offered during Canton Fair period.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店坐落于广东省河源市源城区高埔岗万洞旅游区，位于美丽的巴伐利亚庄园内，是一家国际品牌度假村酒店，拥有高雅设施，以及提供超凡服务和各种休闲活动的巴伐利亚庄园，庄园内设施丰富齐全，是结合吃住行游购娱为一体的一站式旅游目的地，使得无论是家庭出游、朋友聚会、公司团建等都能在此探索旅行的新乐趣。距离埔前高速公路交汇处仅 500 米左右，方便住客轻松前往广州、惠州、深圳和中国香港等城市（到惠州约 1 小时，到广州和深圳约 2 小时，广深港高铁香港西九龙站直达河源东站路程仅60分钟）。酒店交通位置便利，可轻松到达河源市以及河源市周边的旅游景点，如万绿湖、桂山风景区和恐龙博物馆。
hotels.descriptionEn: This international brand resort in Heyuan, with its high-end facilities, first-class service and Bavarian manor with diversified recreational activities, will lead the market for the local conference team, tourist team and leisure and holiday crowd. The hotel is located in the beautiful Bavarian manor of Gaopugang Wandong Tourism Zone, Yuancheng District, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province. It is only 500 meters from the intersection of Po Qian Expressway and easily accessible to cities such as Guangzhou, Huizhou, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, 1 hour to Huizhou, 2 Hour to Guangzhou and Shenzhen, Direct trip from Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Heyuan East just 60 minutes. Convenient traffic location, but also easily reach the Heyuan city and tourist attractions around Heyuan, such as Lake Wan, Guishan Scenic Area and the Dinosaur Museum.

hotels.descriptionZh: 广东鹤山方圆福朋喜来登酒店坐落在大雁山风景区山脚，欢迎莅临下榻，尊享宁静休闲时光，尽情放松休息。酒店设施齐全，位于中国沿海省份广东省的南部，位置便利，邻近闪闪发光的山湖，可轻松前往当地景点。酒店地理位置优越，距鹤山市中心仅数分钟左右行程，距江门仅约 31 公里，乘车很快可达。在探索完当地的自然景点之后，可返回酒店现代化客房内放松休息，客房配备福朋特色睡床，提供免费瓶装水、免费高速 Wi-Fi 和 49 英寸液晶电视。当饥饿来袭，可在酒店内的热门餐厅之一享用美味可口的国际佳肴与正宗粤菜。如果是为活动策划而来，则酒店装饰时尚且配备先进科技的现代化场地将是您的理想之选。广东鹤山方圆福朋喜来登酒店是位置优越的山地酒店，可满足您的各种需求，给您带来难忘体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Unwind in our peaceful retreat nestled into the base of Da Yan Mountain Scenic Spot at Four Points by Sheraton Guangdong, Heshan. Located in the southern portion of China’s coastal Guangdong Province, our well-appointed hotel is conveniently situated next to a shimmering mountain lake and offers easy access to local attractions. Downtown Heshan is only minutes away and Jiangmen is just a quick 19 mile drive from our ideal location. After exploring the area's natural attractions, unwind in our contemporary hotel accommodations with Four Points signature beds, free bottled water, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and 49-inch LCD TVs. When hunger strikes, dine in one of our popular onsite restaurants for delicious International and Cantonese fare. If visiting for event planning reasons, take advantage of our modern venues with stylish decor and advanced technology. We offer everything you need for an unforgettable experience in our ideally-located mountain hotel at Four Points by Sheraton Guangdong, Heshan.
hotels.hotelImageAlt: Four Points by Sheraton Guangdong, Heshan

hotels.descriptionZh: 惠州白鹭湖雅居乐喜来登酒店坐拥迷人的水滨景观，并提供贴心服务和周到设施，热诚欢迎您光临下榻。酒店客房和套房面积宽敞，各类设施配备齐全，包括喜来登甜梦之床、平面电视、设有人体工学座椅的宽大办公区以及免费 Wi-Fi，您可于此尽情放松身心、重焕活力。客房还设有阳台，可欣赏花园美景或水滨景观。欢迎前往华美的室内外泳池畅游一番，畅玩精彩纷呈的水上乐园，在酒店健身房挥汗锻炼，酒店内还设有孩子们喜欢的儿童俱乐部。开始探索之旅前，不妨在酒店餐厅享用中式和国际美味佳肴。我们的水滨酒店邻近泗州塔、惠州体育公园以及西湖风景区。酒店拥有迷人的宴会厅、现代会议室，以及包括户外婚礼证婚场地在内的精美户外活动场所，是举办各类活动的理想选地。我们热诚期待您光临下榻惠州白鹭湖雅居乐喜来登酒店。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Huizhou Bailuhu welcomes those traveling through China with friendly service, thoughtful amenities and impressive water views. Relax and recharge in spacious hotel rooms and suites filled with amenities, including Sheraton Sweet Sleeper Beds®, flat-screen TVs, ample workspaces with ergonomic chairs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Rooms also feature balconies which reveal garden or water views. Relish the gorgeous indoor and outdoor pools, experience the water park, break a sweat in our gym and bring your children to our Kids Club. Sample delicious Chinese and international favorites at our hotel restaurants before going out to explore the area. Our waterfront hotel is near the Sizhou Tower, Huizhou Sports Park and West Lake Scenic Area. Event planners will appreciate our stunning ballrooms, modern meeting rooms and beautiful outdoor event venues, including the outdoor wedding chapel. We look forward to your visit to Sheraton Huizhou Bailuhu.

hotels.descriptionZh: 惠州富力万丽酒店坐落于城市商业中心，坐拥西湖和东江的迷人美景，是商务和休闲旅行的理想栖身之所。酒店地处商业区，周围环绕精品写字楼和大型购物商场；地理位置优越，交通便利，可轻松抵达高铁站、机场、公交站或地铁。酒店内设333间风格时尚的客房和套房，房内公共娱乐区域面积至少也有47平方米，同样房内配备豪华床上用品、独立控温器和互联 网接入口。在我们的室内游泳池和24小时健身中心，您可随时来此游泳健身放松身心。酒店内精品餐厅提供国内外美食，满足您不断变化的味蕾需求；同样，您可在酒店怡廊品尝一杯精心调配的鸡尾酒，结束漫长一天。酒店拥有11个不同规模，总面积超过2288平方米宽敞的会议设施。坐拥非凡江景，配备豪华璀璨的灯光和专业超凡的音效设施，定能满足不同的宴会及会议需求。轻松满足您婚礼或商务会议的各种需求。惠州富力万丽酒店热情友善的员工随时为您服务，优越的地理位置及豪华的室内设备随时满足您的各种需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover the ideal blend of a prime location with upscale amenities at Renaissance Huizhou Hotel. Situated in the center of Jiang Bei Central Business District, with direct access to Huizhou's major shopping areas, tourist attractions and commercial centers, our contemporary hotel is the ideal choice for every traveler. Throughout our modern Guangdong Province hotel, you'll find upscale amenities, spacious rooms and suites with stunning river views, a full-service spa, an indoor, glass domed pool, international restaurants and much more. Our extensive selection of dedicated meeting rooms and event spaces are complemented by our expert planning and culinary teams, ensuring that your business events, weddings and social galas are a great success. When it is time to explore, Huizhou railway station is just minutes away, with trains to take you to Beijing, Hong Kong and beyond. Whether traveling for business or enjoying a vacation, we look forward to welcoming you to our Huizhou hotel.

hotels.descriptionZh: 我们的惠州度假酒店地处大亚湾海滨，驻于公园巷海港综合大楼之上，坐拥壮丽的大亚湾风光，您可于此出发开启现代古城探索之旅。您可走出酒店，探索当地的艺术、建筑和美食以及数千年历史遗迹。亦可纵身跃入我们的室内或室外泳池畅游一番，便利前往海滩感受细腻柔软的沙滩，或前往洄水疗中心寻找身心慰藉。还可租赁自行车骑行游览惠州，或到健身中心保持身心活力。酒店内还设有三家餐厅、艾美家庭儿童俱乐部和宽敞的活动空间。我们所有 296 间设施齐全、布置精美的客房和套房，均设有可一览中国南海壮阔海景的私人阳台。温馨的木质元素与现代家具，特色艾美睡床以及先进的科技设施（包括 55 英寸纯平网络电视），巧妙配搭，相得益彰。
hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled on the beach overlooking Daya Bay as part of the Park Lane Harbour Complex, our Huizhou resort is the gateway to discover a distinctive blend of ancient and modern China. Explore art, architecture and cuisine, with a historical heritage dating back thousands of years. Take a dip in our indoor or outdoor hotel pools, put your toes in the sand with direct beach access or find solace at Ocean Spa. Stay active in our Fitness Centre or with bicycle rentals for touring Huizhou. Three dining venues, Le Meridien Family Kids Club and ample event space are also available. Each of our 296 well-appointed hotel rooms and suites boasts a private balcony with breathtaking views of the South China Sea. Warm wood accents and contemporary furnishings complement our signature Le Meridien BEDs and state-of-the-art technology, including 55-inch flat-screen IPTVs.

hotels.descriptionZh: 从日积月累的各类珍藏物件，到从当地采购精酿桶装啤酒的醇饮优选项目，凡此种种无不展现出我们对精妙设计和本土风情的由衷尊重。晨间于此享用美味早餐，开启美好新一天，晚上则有各类现代休闲餐饮选择。覆盖整个酒店的免费 Wi-Fi 可助您轻松社交、高效工作。此外，福朋健身房跳脱出传统的健身房概念，与 Your Trainer 展开合作，通过智能手机和平板电脑提供个性化训练和健身体验。福朋酒店秉承以旅行者为重的设计理念，满足宾客之所需，缔造休闲放松的住宿体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店拥有191间装修简约时尚的客房，房型覆盖大床房、双床房和套房。超高层的大堂装修风格、线条流畅，极速网络全覆盖。同时配有万枫小铺，实现随时便携购物的乐趣。万枫餐厅位于酒店3楼，享有130个可同时就餐的餐位，提供品类丰富的中西式美食，满足宾客每日能量。位于3楼24小时开放的健身中心，双面自然采光全落地窗，配备高科技健身设备，让出行在外的您无时无刻体验健康活力的生活。同层设有自助洗衣房，配置多台快速洗衣干衣设备，助您旅途无忧。酒店拥有200平方多功能宴会厅，位于3楼，配备先进的视听设备，无柱空间设计，可分隔为2个不同面积的会议室，满足不同的会务需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Hotel have 191 rooms with a modern and simple design, covering king rooms, twin rooms, and suites.A modern and minimalist lobby with smooth lines, featuring a self-service kiosk and high-speed internet access throughout all public areas.The Fairfield Restaurant on the third floor with 130 dining seats offering a rich variety of Chinese and Western cuisines.A fitness center on the third floor with natural light from full-length windows, high-tech fitness equipment, and 24-hour availability.A self-service laundry room on the third floor with multiple high-speed washing and drying machines.A multifunctional banquet hall on the third floor with advanced audio-visual equipment and a 200-square-meter pillar-free space that can be divided into two conference rooms of different sizes.These facilities and equipment are designed to provide guests with a comfortable and convenient stay, ensuring that every aspect of their experience is taken care of.

hotels.descriptionEn: Jieyang Marriott Hotel, nestled in Rongjiang New City, offers stunning views of Rongjiang River and Huangqi Mountain. Adjacent to Wanda Plaza and just 19 km from Jieyang Chaoshan International Airport, it's perfect for business and leisure travelers. Featuring 260 rooms blending Chaoshan culture with Lingnan style, it combines tradition with modern elegance.Ideal for cultural exploration, dining options include "MAN HO" for Chaoshan cuisine and "Goji" Kitchen & Bar for Eastern-Western fusion.With an 1800 sqm banquet hall, versatile meeting rooms, an indoor pool with river views, and a fitness center, it's the ideal venue for luxury events and relaxation.

hotels.descriptionZh: 有一种享受，来自于隐秘与尊贵的私人会所；有一种回归，承载于翱翔在红树林之上的白鹭；有一种品味，搭建于建筑与艺术之间；有一种空灵，驻足于这片海岸，这个如家一般的“安所”——深圳欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓。酒店坐落于地处深圳湾商圈核心位置——“都市娱乐目的地”华侨城欢乐海岸上，毗邻深圳CBD的福田经贸中心、深圳硅谷——南山科技园、蛇口现代化工业园区以及“特区中的特区”——前海合作区，坐拥中国目前罕有地处现代化大都市腹地——滨海红树林湿地，集自然景观，金融商务于一体。位于深圳华侨城主题公园群与滨海大道之间的深圳欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓，商圈路网通达全城，出行方便快捷，距深圳湾口岸约10分钟车程，距深圳机场约35分钟车程。在这片瑰丽静谧的美景簇拥下，欢乐海岸万豪行政公寓以提供非凡设施与优质服务，营造惬意的居家般住宿体验，为来自世界各地的旅客打造一个温馨、舒适的安心之所。
hotels.descriptionEn: Experience modern hotel amenities and all the comforts of a cozy home at The OCT Harbor, Shenzhen - Marriott Executive Apartments. Choose from studio, one-, two- or three-bedroom serviced apartments with stunning views of the city and harbor, artful decor, modern furnishings, living and dining space, an office area and a fully-equipped kitchen. Our family-friendly hotel features a Resident's Restaurant offering delicious international dining, an outdoor pool and a kid's pool, a kid's play room and a 24-hour fitness center. When you’re ready to venture out and soak up the region’s charming spirit and vibrant culture, our Nanshan District hotel puts you within steps of the Shopping Mall, Wetland Park, Dream Aquarium, Qushui Bay's restaurants and bars and the Creative Exhibition Center. Nearby you'll find amusement parks, theaters, historical sites and much more. Whether joining us for work, a vacation or an extended stay, we look forward to introducing you to the charms of Shenzhen, China.

hotels.descriptionEn: Shenzhen Marriott Hotel Golden Bay welcomes visitors with a prime beachfront location on Golden Bay – one of the top eight domestic bays in China. Our hotel features 325 spacious guest rooms and suites, featuring panoramic sea views, as well as free high-speed Internet access and the latest in-room perks. Modern interiors take cues from local culture, combining elements from the Dapeng Fortress as well as Shenzhen, China's storied fishing heritage. With three uniquely themed restaurants and a refined lobby bar, the hotel presents a curated journey through innovative Cantonese flavors and global culinary delights. In addition, we also provide a wide range of on-site amenities for hotel guests, such as a 24-hour fitness center, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a kids’ club and a tranquil spa. Designed with your flexibility in mind, our hotel proudly boasts over 30,000 square feet of state-of-the-art event space, on-site planning and catering teams and an easily accessible location in Shenzhen, China.

Immerse yourself in the city's serene charm and let your spirit roam free. The hotel offers 160 guest rooms and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing stunning city views. hotels.descriptionEn: Renaissance Shenzhen Luohu Hotel locates in heart of Luohu business district, approximately 1.5 km from Luohu Port, offering convenient cross-border access to Hong Kong SAR.  It is adjacent to Kingglory Plaza and MixC Shopping Mall, and only a 5-minute walk to Guomao Station on Metro Line 1.The surrounding neighborhood features a vibrant local atmosphere. Guests can easily walk to Dongmen Pedestrian Street and Xiangxi Village to experience Shenzhen’s authentic lifestyle and diverse culture. The hotel offers 397 comfortable and elegantly designed guestrooms and suites, combining convenience with a relaxing stay experience.The Sky Paradise is a slow revolving restaurant offering a unique dining experience, where guests can savor delicious cuisine while enjoying the 360° panoramic view of Shenzhen's skyline.The hotel features a 24-hour fitness center to meet guests’ workout needs at any time, while the outdoor swimming pool offers a relaxing leisure space (opening hours are subject to hotel operation).

hotels.descriptionZh: 深圳前海华侨城JW万豪酒店坐落于深圳宝安中心区，共配备463间客房、公寓和套房。酒店坐拥前海湾美景，紧邻欢乐港湾、“湾区之光”摩天轮、滨海艺术中心、“湾区之眼”书城等大型公共设施，邻近腾讯大铲湾企鹅岛。酒店交通便利，距离深圳宝安机场及深圳湾口岸约25分钟车程。酒店二期光之翼位于欢乐港湾3号，邻近地铁临海站，与湾区之光摩天轮隔窗相望，设有107间客房，包括28间公寓和10间套房，入住宾客均可享受行政酒廊礼遇。另设港湾尚膳餐厅、光之翼壹号多功能厅和健身房。酒店主楼拥有356间宽敞舒适的豪华客房和套房，设计风格融合中式典雅与时尚现代。室内外泳池、水疗中心和健身中心让宾客感受全身心放松的舒适体验。酒店提供精致多元化的用餐体验：全日制餐厅都会尚膳荟萃环球美食，让宾客尽享多元化的选择；大堂酒廊是放松休憩或洽谈商务的理想场所，可一边细呷香茗，一边享用当地滋味小食与精致小点，悠享午后仪式感。占地共2,600平方米的8间多功能宴会厅，是举办大型产品发布会、大小型会议、展览、婚宴及社交宴会的理想之所。
hotels.descriptionEn: JW Marriott Hotel Shenzhen Bao’an is conveniently located in the heart of Bao’an District with 463 luxurious guestrooms, apartments and suites. Located in the Qianhai Bay, adjacent to city landmark Bay Glory Ferris Wheel, OH Bay, Bay Opera and “Eyes of the GBA” book store, and close to Tencent Dachan Penguin Bay. Main Tower offers 356 guestrooms and suites. It occupies a stunning modern landmark building and enjoys panoramic views of Qianhai Bay and the Pearl River Delta. Hotel dining options include The Lounge and The Shenzhen Kitchen. The hotel offers a luxurious spa, Fitness Center, Indoor heated and Outdoor Swimming Pools. Eight multi-function venues offer 2,600sqm of cutting-edge meeting and banquet space. Glory Tower, as an extension of JW Marriott Hotel Shenzhen Bao'an, features 107 guest rooms, apartments and suites that start at a spacious 50sqm. The guest rooms instill a fresh and appealing ambiance conducive to relaxation while enjoying the superb views over Qianhai Bay and Bay Glory Ferris Wheel.

hotels.descriptionZh: 深圳前海华侨城艾美酒店作为艾美品牌首进深圳之作，通过艾美品牌“探索世界，揭秘目的地”的品牌理念以及独有的三重滤镜 — 目的地、文化及美食，为富有创意思维的宾客带来超乎想象的目的地探索体验。深圳前海华侨城艾美酒店坐落于宝安中心区，地理位置优越，毗邻湾区之光摩天轮和滨海艺术中心。拥有353间时尚典雅的客房及套房，1间新食谱全日餐厅及1间北纬22酒廊。配备超过2,000平方米的宴会空间，包括1,080平方米的大宴会厅、前海湾宴会厅及2间多功能会议室。
hotels.descriptionEn: Le Méridien Shenzhen, Bao'an marks the first Le Méridien hotel in the city of Shenzhen. Through the distinctive Le Méridien ‘Destination Unlocked’ promise, and its distinct filters of discovery - Coordinates, Culture and Cuisine, Le Méridien Shenzhen Bao’an is set to present unexpected and engaging experiences to curious and creative-minded travelers. Le Méridien Shenzhen, Bao’an is located at the heart of Bao’an central district and nearby the Bay Glory Ferris Wheel and Bay Opera of Shenzhen.  The hotel features 353 guestrooms and suites, offers two culinary venues that cater to the taste buds of the diners with a carefully crafted dining environment and specialties, including Latest Recipe and Lobby Lounge Latitude 22.  The hotel provides over 2,000 square meters of meeting and function spaces, including 1,080 square meters Grand Ballroom with capacious foyer, 425 square meters Qianhai Bay Ballroom featuring abundant natural light and 2 meeting rooms.

hotels.descriptionZh: 深圳前海华侨城瑞吉酒店坐落于深圳宝安区的繁华核心地带，地理位置优越。酒店的289间精致客房与套房尽览城市天际线或海湾美景，为宾客打造优雅难忘的入住体验。四间餐厅和酒吧提供丰富的用餐体验，呈献瑞吉品牌标志性的优雅与本地美馔的活力风味。酒店还拥有超过1,000平米的多功能会议空间，包括696平米的阿斯特宴会厅和多个会议室，是商务与休闲的理想之选。配备定制化的瑞吉管家服务、先进的健身中心和豪华的水疗中心，深圳前海华侨城瑞吉酒店重新定义了奢华居停，带来优雅、服务与创新的美妙融合。
hotels.descriptionEn: The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao’an enjoys a prime location in the heart of the thriving Bao’an District. Featuring 289 elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites, each offering breathtaking views of the city skyline or the bay, the hotel promises a refined and unforgettable stay. Guests can indulge in a variety of dining experiences across four exquisite restaurants and bars, each offering a harmonious blend of St. Regis’s signature elegance and the vibrant flavors of local cuisine. The hotel also boasts over 1,000 square meters of versatile event space, including the Astor Ballroom and several meeting rooms, making it the ideal destination for both business and leisure. With personalized butler service, a state-of-the-art Fitness Center, and a luxurious spa, The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao’an redefines the standard of luxury in Shenzhen, offering an exceptional fusion of elegance, service, and innovation.

hotels.descriptionZh: 深圳瑞吉酒店坐落于罗湖区地标性建筑京基一百大厦75至100层，共有290间客房，包括41间套房，以量身定制的管家服务与恒久传承的经典品味，吸引着全球眼光独到的名流雅士。位于96层的酒店大堂，可将深圳繁华都市城景、唯美海湾日落与香港远山翠色尽收眼底，令宾客在静谧云端中与都市脉络紧密相连。三间餐厅和一间酒吧，以壮阔天际线为幕，致力于缔造非凡云端飨宴。设施完善的健身房拥有引人注目的28米室内无边泳池——全景落地玻璃环绕，营造出凌空畅游的震撼视觉与私密体验。铱瑞水疗中心专注于提供健康舒适的护理体验，为客人打造焕发活力的生活方式。在深圳瑞吉酒店举办的每一场活动，皆承袭品牌传奇的管家服务精神。酒店拥有近2,100平方米的宴会厅及会议空间，搭配先进科技设备与灵活布局选择。专业的宴会管家团队将全程悉心统筹，以细致入微的服务，成就每一个难忘的经典时刻。
hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled on floors 75 to 100 of the KingKey 100 landmark building in Luohu District, The St. Regis Shenzhen features 290 guest rooms, including 41 suites. With its bespoke butler services and timeless classic elegance, the hotel caters to luminaries from around the world. Located on the 96th floor, the hotel lobby offers a panoramic view of Shenzhen’s bustling urban skyline, stunning bay sunsets and the green hills of Hong Kong, allowing guests to stay closely connected with the city’s pulse while enjoying a peaceful retreat above the clouds. Three restaurants and one bar, set against the magnificent skyline, are dedicated to creating extraordinary sky-high dining experiences in the clouds.The well-equipped fitness center boasts a striking 28-meter indoor infinity pool. The Iridium Spa specializes in providing rejuvenating and relaxing treatments.The hotel offers nearly 2,100 square meters of banquet and meeting space, paired with advanced technical equipment and flexible layout options.

hotels.descriptionZh: Courtyard Shenzhen Northwest is located near the city center, the airport and the new convention center. The hotel offers modern amenities including two restaurants, a lounge, a fitness center, meeting space, modern accommodations and an Executive Lounge.
hotels.descriptionEn: In the center of the Shenzhen greater airport area, just moments from the new exhibition center, Courtyard Shenzhen Northwest offers convenient access to the city and beyond. Walk from our hotel to the Fuyong Metro Station, which takes you to the Qianhai Pilot Free Trade Zone or Futian Central Business District. Fuyong Wharf is only 15 minutes away, connecting you to Zhongshan, Macau and Hong Kong International Airport. Whether you're in Bao'an, Shenzhen for business or on vacation, you'll find convenience and comfort in guest rooms featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, modern decor, 24-hour room service and complimentary Wi-Fi. Executive-level hotel guests can enjoy access to a host of additional amenities in the Executive Lounge. Dining options include all-day international fare at Pavilion Restaurant and a Chinese eatery with private dining rooms. With easy access to the airport and more than 16,000 square feet of event space, our hotel is an ideal destination for meetings and business gatherings in Baoan.

From here, guests can easily reach commercial landmarks and entertainment attractions such as MixC, Shashan Golf Club, Happy Valley, and Window of the World, enjoying efficient and convenient business and leisure experiences. hotels.descriptionEn: Discover an effortless blend of comfort and convenience at Courtyard Shenzhen Bay. Take advantage of our hotel's outstanding placement in Nanshan, moments from the Shenzhen Bay Super Headquarter Matrix and Hi-Tech Park station. We're also close to a range of notable attractions in downtown. Settle into our tastefully decorated, spacious hotel rooms and suites; enjoy panoramic views of Nanshan, Shenzhen, a flat-screen TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, a large workspace and a mini-bar. Elevate your stay in our Executive-level rooms to enjoy lounge access, free snacks and beverages and a scenic garden setting. Savor quintessential Cantonese dining at Pavilion, unwind with a custom cocktail at our hotel lounge or keep in shape at our 24-hour fitness center. Host an event to make use of versatile venues, superb A/V technology, expert planning and an impeccable hotel location near Hi-Tech Park station, as well as a variety of public transportation options. Courtyard Shenzhen Bay is designed for the intelligent traveler.

Each of our 350 guest rooms and suites comprises the Heavenly Bed and a rain forest shower, as well as a 42” LCD TV. Your room provides a wonderful contemporary experience and respite during your travels.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店地处深圳市中心充满活力的南山中央商务区，位于南山区别具现代风格的地标大厦内，是商务和亲子旅行的理想住宿之选。酒店距华润深圳湾体育中心和深圳保利剧院仅数步之遥，紧邻知名购物餐饮商圈。酒店共设 340 间舒适客房与套房，在房内可以饱览迷人的港景和城景。酒店内共有六家餐厅，供应各式国际风味佳肴和饮品，方便您轻松用餐。酒店健身中心免费开放，您可在此坚持日常锻炼。酒店会议与宴会场地总面积约 1579 平米，提供美味餐饮服务，活动策划团队更是细致周到，竭力满足各种活动承办需求。无论您缘何来到深圳，选择深圳中洲万豪酒店，即可获享难忘居停体验，旅·获自在。
hotels.descriptionEn: Housed in a contemporary landmark building and soaring above the Nanshan District's lively CBD, Shenzhen Marriott Hotel Nanshan is a unique destination for business and leisure visitors to southeastern China. CR Shenzhen Bay Sports Center and Shenzhen Poly Theatre are steps away and great shopping and dining is also nearby. Our hotel features 340 comfortable guest rooms and suites with captivating harbor and city views. Enjoy a bite to eat in one of our five on-site restaurants, which serve an extensive list of international cuisines and beverages. Maintain your workout routine at the fitness center, which is available free of charge. Our hotel can cater to all of your event needs with 17,000 square feet of meeting and banquet space — enhanced by delicious catering and the careful attention of our planning team. Whatever your reason for visiting, we're confident you will have a memorable stay at Shenzhen Marriott Hotel Nanshan.

hotels.descriptionZh: 深圳NOA酒店因现代工业设计而别具特色。它通过毛坯混凝土、石材和钢材等材料的相互作用，重现罗湖区活力四射的建筑传统，将粗犷与精致巧妙融合在一起。酒店名称及理念源自诺亚方舟的故事，旨在将一座旧工厂改造成属于深圳年轻创意人群的蓬勃新世界。酒店内Deck Coffee & Taproom全日餐厅供应创新融合菜品、精品咖啡和精酿啤酒；Anyu An水疗中心健康综合体提供众多令人放松的护理项目。酒店将眼镜精品店、NOA Design Store（NOA设计商店）及艺术展览整合在一起，营造出自由奔放的社交氛围。
hotels.descriptionEn: NOA Hotel Shenzhen is distinguished by its contemporary industrial design. Through the interplay of materials like raw concrete, stone, and steel, it recreates the vibrant construction legacy of the Luohu district, balancing roughness with a sense of delicateness. The name and concept are derived from the story of Noah’s Ark, aiming to rebuild a former factory into a new world for the young, creative Shenzen crowd. Deck Coffee & Taproom, the hotel’s all-day restaurant, delivers innovative fusion cuisine alongside specialty coffee and craft brews, while the Anyu An·Spa wellness complex offers relaxing treatments for unwinding. The hotel integrates an eyewear boutique, the NOA Design Store, and art exhibitions, creating a free-spirited social atmosphere.

hotels.descriptionEn: Rich in Westin style, the Yuanshu hotel is dedicated to providing a pleasant recreational experience with a natural environment. Yuanjuku Hotel is built to promote efficient use of space, focus on sustainability, and provide convenient Internet facilities to help you stay online easily, creating a balanced and vibrant travel experience for you. Drawing on the exquisite design of urban residences, the room adopts a streamlined layout design to tap the space potential and present you with a rich guest room functional experience. Start your day with Rise Healthy Hot Breakfast at Genjuku Hotel with fresh granola, fruit, quality coffee and more. Motion Fitness Center The Motion Fitness Center is spacious and full of light, equipped with a large number of advanced cardio machines, strength training machines, open 24/7, for you to work out at your own pace. A 24-hour laundromat is available. Meeting space Work efficiently in our spacious and bright meeting rooms.

hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beerson taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Deliciousbreakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifithroughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Pointsworkouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personaltraining and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler inmind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 云浮新兴筠城喜来登酒店优雅迷人、舒适便利，欢迎莅临下榻。酒店位于新兴县城中心，专为商务旅客及寻访佛教大鉴禅师慧能故乡的宾客而设计。宽敞现代的客房几乎均可俯瞰新兴江美景；其内设施体贴周到，包括免费 Wi-Fi 和喜来登特色睡眠体验之床。在这里，不妨前往酒店之内的盛宴标帜餐厅享用国际风味自助餐，或到采悦轩中餐厅品鉴新鲜烹饪的各式粤菜。置身于云浮期间，您可在配备齐全的现代化健身中心挑战自我，或在恒温室内泳池畅游一番。若您计划在此举办活动，酒店还配备约 2100 平米的场地空间，其中包括一间无柱式宴会厅。若您想游览景点，国恩寺和龙山温泉均距酒店附近。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Yunfu Xinxing Hotel welcomes you with a seamless combination of comfort, elegance and convenience. Located in Xincheng, China, our hotel is designed for business travelers and guests seeking to discover the hometown of Buddhist figure Master Dajian Huineng. Settle in to spacious, modern accommodations, nearly all of which overlook the Xinxing River; thoughtful amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi access and the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. Elsewhere at the hotel, savor international buffet cuisine at Feast Signature Restaurant, or join us for seasonal, freshly prepared Cantonese dishes at Yue. Challenge yourself to a workout while in Yunfu at our contemporary on-site gym, which is furnished with a full range of equipment, or take a dip in the heated indoor pool. Those hosting events in West Guangdong can choose from 2,100 sqm of venue space, including a pillar-free ballroom. If you’d like to explore, attractions including Guo'en Temple and Loshan Hot Spring are within reach.

hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Zhanjiang, nestled along the picturesque Jinsha Bay, offers breathtaking ocean views and seamlessly blends modern luxury with coastal charm. The hotel features elegantly designed guest rooms and suites, all equipped with Sheraton’s signature Sleep Experience, while select rooms boast panoramic sea vistas. Multiple dining venues and bars serve authentic Cantonese delicacies and international cuisine. A 1,440-square-meter pillar-free grand ballroom and versatile meeting spaces cater to premium business and social events. With an outdoor pool, fitness center, and kids’ club, guests can effortlessly transition between work and leisure. Whether for business or pleasure, Sheraton Zhanjiang delivers unforgettable coastal luxury with its signature hospitality.

hotels.descriptionZh: 肇庆鼎湖区喜来登酒店位于肇庆市鼎湖新区的中心地带。酒店宾客可饱览新区的众多美丽景色，如长利涌、湿地公园和其他水滨景观。酒店靠近众多知名景点，如鼎湖山、九龙湖和砚洲岛。酒店配备卓越的商务旅行和观光配套设施，商务和休闲宾客可便利享用。酒店交通便利。驱车 10 分钟左右可达肇庆高铁东站，25 分钟左右可至市中心，70 分钟左右可至广州白云国际机场。酒店设有超过 398 间舒适客房和套房，客房空间设计巧妙融入品牌理念。客房温馨舒适，配备高速 Wi-Fi、平板高清电视以及各种现代设施设备。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Zhaoqing Dinghu is located in the core area of Dinghu New District, Zhaoqing City. It is integrated with the most beautiful landscape belt of the New District, such as Changli River, wetland park and other waterfront landscapes. The hotel is close to famous scenic spots such as Dinghu Mountain, Jiulong lake and Yanzhou island.  It has perfect business travel and tourism supporting facilities, which can be easily reached by business guests and leisure tourists. The hotel has convenient transportation. It takes 10 minutes drive to Zhaoqing High-speed Railway East station, 25 minutes drive to city center, and 70 minutes drive to Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. The hotel has more than 398 comfortable rooms and Suites, and the brand concept is skillfully integrated into the room space design.  The guest rooms are equipped with high-speed WiFi, flat-panel HD TV and other facilities, which are warm and comfortable, but also have complete modern facilities and equipment.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎下榻中山保利艾美酒店，探索中山市魅力风情。中山保利艾美酒店位于中山北站附近，酒店风格时尚现代，周围汇聚众多当地企业、购物中心和餐厅。从酒店经短途车程即可到达众多纪念碑、寺庙、现代购物中心和绿意盎然的湿地公园，体会古典与现代融合的韵味，尽情探索中山市的风土人情。酒店内有三家餐厅，从自助早餐到精致中餐，供应丰盛美食，带您开启美食之旅。酒店可提供近 1,100 平米会议及活动空间，包括一间无柱式大宴会厅，是您举办婚礼和商务活动的理想之选。前往我们的健身俱乐部挥洒汗水，或在格调质朴的室内泳池中畅游，恢复身心活力。酒店客房和套房配备豪华睡床、液晶电视和视野非凡的落地窗，让您在繁忙的一天结束后，尽情放松休闲。我们竭诚为您提供难忘的住宿体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover cosmopolitan Zhongshan, China with a stay at the enticing Le Méridien Zhongshan. Located near North Zhongshan Station, Le Méridien Zhongshan is a contemporary hotel close to local businesses, shopping and dining. Explore Zhongshan City, a short drive away, and its unexpected blend of ancient and modern, with monuments, temples, shopping malls and verdant wetland parks. Indulge your culinary side at one of our three hotel restaurants, featuring sumptuous offerings ranging from a breakfast buffet to a refined take on Chinese cuisine. With almost 1,100 square meters of meeting and event space, including a pillar-free Grand Ballroom, our hotel is an exceptional venue for both weddings and business functions. Recharge at our health club or enjoy an invigorating swim in our pristine indoor pool.  At the end of the day, retreat to your room or suite and indulge in plush bedding, an LCD TV and floor-to-ceiling windows offering exceptional views. We look forward to making your hotel stay a memorable one.

hotels.descriptionZh: 城市新地标中山利和威斯汀酒店坐落于珠江三角洲西岸，从酒店出发可轻松直达中山港码头和港珠澳大桥。酒店拥有277间客房及25间套房为宾客打造一个舒适放松的氛围，帮助他们释放旅行的倦意。所有客房均可提供开阔的视野，宾客可在此欣赏充满活力的城市景观和珠江西岸美景。所有客房均配备品牌标志天梦之床（Heavenly® Bed）、天梦之浴、酣然好梦薰衣草精油（Sleep Well Lavender Balm）和酣然好梦菜单（Sleep Well Menu），帮助宾客享有整晚好梦并享受充满健康活力的入住体验。酒店设有室内恒温泳池及配备全套新晋有氧运动及健身设备的威斯汀健身中心（WesitnWORKOUT Fitness Studio），帮助宾客在旅途中保持健康与活力。中山利和威斯汀酒店拥有三家餐厅及一间大堂酒廊并提供多元的餐饮体验。全日制知味餐厅可提供琳琅满目的自助及零点美食；逸峰餐厅及酒吧呈现手工调制的经典鸡尾酒，宾客可在此一边细品美酒同时将窗外的城市美景尽收眼底；大堂酒廊提供多款香醇咖啡，主题下午茶套餐，精选啤酒和葡萄酒，是与商务伙伴品茗或与家人朋友小酌的理想之选。此外，酒店的厨师团队专注于提供健康及原汁原味的食材，通过威斯汀营养美味菜单（Eat Well Menu），帮助宾客及儿童在享用美味的同时保持健康活力，以充沛精力迎接旅途中的每一天。
hotels.descriptionEn: In the heart of China lighting capital, The Westin Zhongshan Guzhen shines a light on style, comfort and wellbeing. Set along the west bank of the Pearl River Delta, the hotel draws on its Greater Bay location to offer a distinct experience. Guest rooms overlook the city or river and feature signature Westin touches including Heavenly Bed and Heavenly Bath amenities. This attention to wellness carries into WestinWORKOUTTM, the 24-hour fitness center, providing everything for working out while on the road. Dining includes an all-day buffet restaurant and the inviting Lobby Lounge, where guests connect over a menu of curated beverages. The hotel’s location near the Guzhen Convention and Exhibition Center and adjacent to the Lihe Lighting Expo Center makes it ideal for meetings and social gatherings. More than 28,000 sq. ft. of event space includes a pillar-free ballroom with a large LED screen, state-of-the-art lighting and space for 1500 guests.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎莅临下榻中山喜来登酒店，体验舒适、时尚和服务的理想融合。这家别具一格的新颖海滨酒店位于一处娱乐和零售综合体内，信步可至购物和餐饮场所以及景点。这家高级酒店位于中山市中心，设有 362 间舒适客房，包括 44 间精心设计套房，适合各种场合，是您家庭度假和商务住宿的理想目的地。乐享酒店餐厅供应的正宗时尚美食，包括 Yue 中餐厅的粤菜和盛宴餐厅的丰盛自助餐与国际美食。一天结束后，特色睡床将您旅途的疲惫一扫而空，智能设施助您放松休闲，高速上网让您保持通畅联络 — 提供各种必需设施与服务，让您在中山市中心舒适下榻。酒店格调时尚现代，位于中山市中心，坐拥河滨风光和夜晚华灯初上的城市美景，必会为您打造令人意犹未尽的难忘住宿体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Experience the ideal blend of comfort, style and service at Sheraton Zhongshan Hotel. Our chic, new waterfront hotel is located in an entertainment and retail complex, within walking distance to shopping, dining and attractions. Situated in downtown Zhongshan, China, our upscale hotel offers 362 comfortable guest rooms, including 44 uniquely designed suites, and is the ideal destination for every occasion, from family getaways to business stays. Enjoy our hotel restaurants with authentic and genuine style cuisines, including Cantonese at Yue and a sumptuous buffet and international dishes at Feast. When your day is finished, recharge in our signature bed after your travels, kick back with smart amenities and stay connected with high-speed Internet – all the essentials for an effortless stay in the city center of Zhongshan, China. With riverfront views and the city lighting up at nights, our modern hotel in downtown Zhongshan will surely leave you in awe and wanting more!

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店拥有 296 间宽敞舒适的客房和套房，坐拥中心湖风光和繁华城景。臻厨全日餐厅位于 22 层，可欣赏壮美的城市天际线，带领宾客踏上精彩的赏味之旅。大堂吧位于同一楼层，行政酒廊位于 20 层，均是商务会谈和休闲聚会的卓越之选。位于 5 层的万豪中餐厅是宾客探索珠海当地风味的起点。艺术中心景观草坪和室外泳池均坐落于 6 层，宾客可于此感受微风拂面的惬意感觉。酒店拥有两个宴会厅，珠海厅位于 3 层，面积约为 900 平方米, 配备约 80 平方米的高清 LED 屏幕；金湾厅位于同一楼层，面积约 400 平方米；酒店 5 层还配备有 5 间多功能厅，为您举办婚礼、社交聚会和商务会议等提供理想场地。
hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel boasts 296 spacious and comfortable guest rooms and suites with city and Central Lake views. The all-day dining restaurant, ZHUHAI KITCHEN, located on the 22nd floor, is the ideal place to taste delicious food while gazing out at the gorgeous skyline. THE LOUNGE on the same floor and the M Club on the 20th floor are excellent options for business meetings and casual gatherings. The Chinese restaurant, MAN HO, on the 5th floor is the starting point for guests to explore local cuisine and taste Zhuhai. The Art Center View Lawn and outdoor pool, which are both on the 6th floor, are must-see places for guests who want to relax and feel the breeze. The hotel's 900-square-meter Zhuhai Ballroom, which is located on the 3rd floor, has an 80-square-meter high-definition LED screen. It also has a 400-square-meter Jinwan Ballroom on the same floor and 5 conference rooms on the 5th floor, making it an ideal location for weddings, social events, and business meetings.

hotels.descriptionZh: 珠海华发喜来登酒店是一家位于中国广东省珠海市的海景酒店，共有 544 间舒适的客房，包括 76 间设计别具一格的套房。无论是家庭度假还是商务住宿，酒店的时尚住宿选项都能满足您的需求。酒店共有三家特色餐厅，无需四处搜寻，在酒店内就能尽享美味。酒店坐落在珠海海边，正对澳门特别行政区，地理位置非常优越。结束漫长的日间观光行程后，喜来登特色睡眠体验之床将您一天的疲惫一扫而空，包括平板电视在内的智能设施助您放松休闲，高速网络让您保持通畅联络，各种常用设施与服务也很齐全，让您在珠海无忧下榻。酒店休闲设施丰富，设有网球场、健身中心和室内外泳池，让您度过充实的闲暇时光。无论您缘何选择珠海华发喜来登酒店，我们都将为您提供超乎预期的卓越服务。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in China's Guangdong Province, Sheraton Zhuhai Hotel has 545 comfortable guest rooms, including 76 uniquely-designed suites. Our hotel provides a stylish destination for everything from family getaways to business stays. You never have to venture far to find delicious cuisine; we feature three distinctive restaurants on-site. One of our exceptional features is our hotel location, with Macau located just in front of us. After a long day of exploring, you can recharge in our Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience after your travels, kick back with smart amenities including flat-screen TVs and stay connected with high-speed internet – all the essentials for an effortless stay in Zhuhai. We offer plenty of activities to keep you occupied during your down time, including a tennis court, fitness center and both indoor and outdoor swimming pools. Whatever the reason for joining us, Sheraton Zhuhai Hotel is sure to exceed your expectations.

hotels.descriptionZh: 珠海南湾福朋喜来登酒店拥有163间融合经典设计及本地元素的客房及套房，亦设有儿童主题套房。酒店拥有一个将全日餐厅、大堂吧及社交空间融为一体的多功能共享空间“玩啤食社”，除了提供丰富的自助早餐、品牌标志性“醇饮优选”计划中的本地精酿啤酒，还提供精选咖啡、中式品茗、儿童菜单、甜品、小食、简餐及客房送餐等服务，满足宾客多样化需求。182㎡的多功能会议场地配以专业的视听设施与支持团队，能满足会议、宴会及活动所需。24小时开放的健身中心和自助洗衣房，以及免费地下停车场，为宾客出行提供了便利。下榻珠海南湾福朋喜来登酒店，开启一段真诚舒适的旅程。
hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Zhuhai Nanwan features 163 guestrooms and suites blending classic design with local elements as well as the themed suites for children. The multifunctional shared space “The Mesh” integrates an all-day dining restaurant, lobby lounge, and social area. The Mesh offers abundant buffet breakfast, local craft beers from the Best Brews® program, as well as selected coffee, Chinese tea, a children's menu, desserts, snacks, A La Carte, room service and so on to meet guests’ diverse needs. The 182 ㎡ multifunctional meeting space, equipped with professional audiovisual facilities and dedicated support team, accommodates conferences, banquets, and events. The 24-hour fitness center, self-service laundry room and complimentary underground parking lot provide convenience for guests.Immerse yourself in an honest and comfortable stay at our hotel in Zhuhai.

hotels.descriptionZh: 珠海是一座风光旖旎的海滨城市，素有“中国里维埃拉”的美称。毗邻湾仔口岸的地标建筑珠海中心大厦的41 至 72 层，便是珠海豪华海景酒店 - 瑞吉酒店所在地，这里坐拥大湾区的辽阔景致，珠澳两地的城市风光可一览无余，是名副其实的海景酒店。在这里，瑞吉酒店用悉心周到的特色管家服务与丰厚礼遇，引领宾客踏上一场充满魅力的旅程。您可于酒店餐厅尽情享用美食，前往游览长隆海洋王国和圆明新园，还可选择酒店内面积逾 1,500 平米的场地空间举办优雅活动。忙碌一日之余，前往酒店内的铱瑞水疗惬意享受按摩、美容和健康护理。在珠海瑞吉酒店，我们用现代方式为您重新诠释经典。
hotels.descriptionEn: Rising over the clouds in a beautiful coastal city, The St. Regis Zhuhai leads guests on a compelling journey curated with St. Regis' signature Butler service and rituals. Taking up the top 31 floors of the iconic, 72-story Zhuhai Tower, our hotel is a waterfront haven in Wanzai, a beautiful coastal city known as “Chinese Riviera.” Find an upscale haven in elegantly styled accommodations with signature amenities, refined design elements and breathtaking views of the vast Greater Bay and Zhuhai and Macao landscape. Thrill your palate with diverse and delectable cuisine at our hotel restaurants. Explore compelling attractions including Chimelong Ocean Kingdom and The New Yuan Ming Palace. Celebrate and succeed in more than 1,500 square meters of sophisticated event space. Punctuate your day with a restorative massage, beauty or wellness treatment at our luxurious hotel spa. Recraft the classics in a modern way at The St. Regis Zhuhai in China.

hotels.descriptionZh: 珠海万怡酒店位于十字门中央商务区核心地段，酒店地理位置优越，毗邻珠海国际会展中心、横琴口岸与横琴粤澳深度合作区。酒店与新兴商业中心——十字门华发商都无缝衔接。酒店交通便捷，十字门轻轨站举步可达，距离湾仔口岸、拱北口岸分别约为3公里和9公里，距离珠海金湾机场约30公里。酒店所处建筑联通十字门轻轨站，便捷通达横琴口岸与港珠澳大桥珠海公路口岸，为往来粤港澳大湾区的宾客提供高效出行体验。宾客可轻松探索珠海主题度假区、圆明新园、珠海渔女等热门景点，感受滨海魅力。新酒店的设计巧妙融入本地海洋元素与渔村文化。大堂公区以“珍珠：至简中蕴含至繁”的特质为设计灵感，温暖典雅的色调搭配贝壳纹理装饰，打造兼具艺术性与实用性的公区空间。酒店拥有188间现代简约的客房与套房，均配备舒适床品、高清电视、灵活便捷的办公区及免费高速无限网络等现代化设施，兼顾高效商务和深度休憩。同时，宾客于房内即可远眺澳门繁华景致、壮丽海岸线及葱郁山景，惬享独具魅力的海滨风光。
hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard by Marriott Zhuhai is located in the core area of the Shizimen Central Business District. The hotel enjoys a superior location, adjacent to the Zhuhai International Convention and Exhibition Center, Hengqin Port and Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone. The hotel is seamlessly connected to the emerging commercial center, Shizimen Huafa Commercial City. The hotel has convenient transportation and is within walking distance of Shizimen Light Rail Station.  The hotel building is connected to the Shizimen Light Rail Station, with convenient access to Hengqin Port and Zhuhai Highway Port of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, providing guests traveling to and from the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area with an efficient travel experience. Guests can easily explore popular attractions such as Zhuhai Chimelong International Ocean Resort, Yuanmingyuan New Garden, Zhuhai Fisher Girl, and experience the charm of the seaside.

hotels.descriptionZh: Zhuhai Marriott Hotel is a family-friendly downtown hotel with spacious rooms and suites, free Wi-Fi and ocean views. Among its amenities are six restaurants and bars, an Executive Lounge, modern venues, an outdoor pool, a fitness center and free parking.
hotels.descriptionEn: Zhuhai Marriott Hotel welcomes guests traveling through China to its family hotel with friendly service, thoughtful amenities and an ideal setting. The downtown hotel sits beside the rich flora and fauna of Jingshan Park, overlooking the Hongkong-Zhuhai-Macao bridge. We are near the famous Zhuhai Fisher Girl statue, the Zhuhai Light Rail Station, Jiuzhou Ferry Terminal and Zhuhai Airport. Recharge in our spacious hotel rooms or suites while enjoying amenities like our indulgent beds, marble bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, ample workstations and free Wi-Fi, as well as enticing ocean and Zhuhai views. Executive rooms and suites have access to the Executive Lounge and special amenities, including complimentary afternoon tea. Savor delicious cuisine and custom cocktails in the four restaurants and the lobby bar in the hotel or take advantage of our outdoor pool and gym. For those planning events, the hotel features seven upscale venues, including our Marriott Ballroom. We look forward to your stay at Zhuhai Marriott

hotels.descriptionEn: Renaissance Zhuhai Hotel is located on the riverside of Qianshan River, in Uni Park complex with modern facilities and convenient access to transportation. The hotel has 316 marine-themed stylish rooms. Through the panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms, guests could enjoy the charming riverside view, as well as the New Lisboa and Macao Tower - the landmarks of Macau. The hotel features two unique restaurants and an R lounge. It’s also facilitated with indoor and outdoor event spaces spanning more than 4,000 square meters where the hotel’s professional banquet planning team strives to bring a personalized meeting experience to guests. Additionally, the hotel is equipped with a heated swimming pool, a 24-hour fitness center, children's playgrounds, and other leisure and entertainment facilities. Guest can enjoy the five panoramic views of the Zhuhai-Zhongshan-Macau-Mountain-River city and sea bridge from the balcony of our Club Lounge.

hotels.descriptionZh: 浙江安吉 JW 万豪酒店是中国地区的大型 JW 万豪品牌度假酒店，欢迎莅临下榻，探索碧绿的竹海和巍峨的青山。我们的酒店拥有舒适的客房，服务热情周到，还可欣赏高尔夫球场的迷人景致。在宽敞的客房中开启新一天，随后您可前去参观竹博园，尽情探索园内的博物馆和园林景观。您可于此尽情领略当地茶文化， 您也可携全家前往全新的凯蒂猫主题公园游玩，尊享天伦之乐。您还可在高尔夫球场尽情挥杆，在酒店室内泳池畅游，啜饮当地出产的白茶，或尊享放松身心的水疗服务，开启休闲之旅。同时，您可以随心选择一处酒店餐厅享用美食，或在精美迷人的酒廊中尽情放松。安吉既适合举办社交活动和商务会议，又适合休闲旅游。您可在酒店现代化的宴会厅或会议室中举办活动，并可邀请客人探索当地的自然风光和绿色生态工业。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover towering bamboo forests and green mountains during your stay at JW Marriott Hotel Zhejiang Anji, An Magnificent Resort JW Brand hotel in China. You will be warmly welcomed at our resort designed with comfortable guest rooms offering views of the golf course. Wake refreshed in your spacious room before exploring Bamboo Park, with its museum and gardens. Immerse yourself in the local tea culture. Or enjoy family attractions such as the new Hello Kitty Park. Start your leisure journey through playing golf, refreshing in our indoor pool or sipping locally white tea and relaxing in our soothing spa. Afterward, dining in one of our restaurants or unwinding in the stunning lounge. Anji is an inspired destination for social events and business meetings as well as leisure travel. Host your event in our modern ballroom or meeting rooms, and invite guests to explore natural wonders and ecologically friendly industries.

hotels.descriptionZh: 杭州JW万豪酒店提供雅致的住宿环境。客房设计典雅时尚，室内设备的选用将为您提供舒适便利。无论您选择入住豪华客房，行政客房还是宽敞的套房，每一种杭州JW万豪酒店的客房都定能满足您挑剔的需求。在酒店的26楼的行政酒廊，您可俯瞰西湖及闹市美景，这里供应品种齐全的自助早餐，下午和晚上依然提供多种茶点和小吃。夜色渐浓时，这里当然不能少了鸡尾酒、精选葡萄酒及各色开胃菜，酒店专业的烹饪团队将会为客人们带来国际和当地特别受欢迎的美食。四个不同风味的餐厅将带给您难以忘怀的美食体验。酒店内的现代设施全方位为您打造家外之家的感受，全年营业的游泳池、涡流池，让您在住店期间可以尽情舒缓身心。24小时健身中心可助您时刻保持强健体魄。杭州JW万豪酒店友好且细心的员工们很高兴为您服务，我们致力让您在杭州拥有一个愉快而难忘的经历。
hotels.descriptionEn: JW Marriott Hotel Hangzhou welcomes you to China with a prime location in the heart of the city center. Brimming with luxury amenities, every hotel room is designed for comfort and convenience; a variety of room and suite layouts are available to meet your needs. Overlooking iconic West Lake, our stylish Executive Lounge boasts spectacular city views of downtown Hangzhou, China and serves a full breakfast, snacks and refreshments throughout the day and cocktails and light meals in the evenings. Our four restaurants, including a signature steakhouse, allow you to savor unforgettable cuisine without leaving our luxury hotel. We also provide a heated pool and an advanced fitness center. Thanks to almost 20,000 square feet of versatile venue space and a stately grand ballroom, we're an ideal destination for business meetings and social events in downtown Hangzhou. No matter your reason for visiting China, JW Marriott Hotel Hangzhou will provide you with a distinctive luxury experience.

hotels.descriptionZh: A superb destination for work or play, Le Méridien Hangzhou, Binjiang offers modern, artfully designed hotel rooms and suites, outstanding on-site restaurants, a fitness center, a pool and 15,000 square feet of event space in bustling Hangzhou, China.
hotels.descriptionEn: Situated in the vibrant Binjiang business district and overlooking the iconic Qiantang River and the natural beauty of Longjing Mountain. The art inspires Le Meridien Hangzhou, Binjiang, which features 198 contemporary hotel rooms and 24 suites for business and leisure travelers to Hangzhou, China. The ideal location brings convenient transportation to nearby destinations, including the West Lake Scenic Area, Yunqi Town, and the Liuhe Pangoda. The hotel offers three culinary venues that cater to the diner's taste buds with exquisite specialities and a well-crafted environment, including Latest Recipe All-Day Dining, Le Mei Chinese Restaurant, and Lobby Lounge Latitude 30. As one of the area's premier venues for ideal business and social events, the hotel provides over 15,000 square feet of space, including a magnificent 8,000 square-foot ballroom. Le Meridien Hangzhou, Binjiang offers an artistic travel experience to reset our guests' minds, leaving everyday life at the door.

hotels.descriptionEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Hangzhou Binjiang is located in the central business district of Binjiang, surrounded by commercial areas including Binhe Road and Riverside Paradise Walk, easily meeting both business and leisure travel needs.The hotel blends European minimalist aesthetics with the artistic charm of the Qiantang River’s tides. It features 188 guest rooms, each with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows offering sweeping city views. Smart amenities, premium bedding and personalized services create an efficient, comfortable working and resting environment for business travelers.Comprehensive facilities include AC Kitchen and AC Café offering cross-continental culinary experiences, a 24-hour fitness center and self-service laundry to help guests maintain their daily routines, and flexible meeting spaces for various business discussions and small events. Here, streamlined design and attentive service deliver a carefree travel experience defined by "the art of effortless living" to global travelers.

hotels.descriptionEn: Centrally located in the heart of Hangzhou Binjiang District, the hotel is ideally situated for business or exploring the city. Discover the area's colorful roots with easy access to West Lake, a world heritage site. The Exhibition Center and Silk Market are also nearby. Gather in our expansive meeting spaces or pillar-less grand ballroom. Relax in the Sheraton Club Lounge, overlooking the Qiantang River. Sheraton Fitness and an indoor heated pool supports your well-being while on the road and dynamic dining options offer satisfying international cuisine. Our 266 guest rooms and 35 suites offer alluring skyline and river views. Stay connected with High Speed Internet Access and flat screen TVs. Our Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience with nightly turn down service encourages restful sleep.  A rain forest shower refreshes the senses

hotels.descriptionZh: 杭州富春芳草地臻品之选度假酒店 一个人与自然生态的融合生活圈，可游可居的文旅综合体选址于富春江畔，将富春江七里泷景区的山水长廊、历史长廊，原汁原味地展现给中外宾客。酒店坐拥220亩天然林场，配套住宿202间/套以特色小木屋，度假式别墅排屋为主，辅以少量特色水上船屋;在鸟鸣中晨醒，自然芳华推窗而入。从农场到餐桌，饮食优选当季新鲜食材。拥抱天与地，尽享天地自然乐趣。芳草地它蕴藏着人们心底原舍、原乡的田园情结立意于全新引导都市人接触自然、回归自然、体验自然。在山幽鸟鸣间，不必费力的遇见山水、遇见芳草，遇见自然!

hotels.descriptionZh: 杭州富阳喜来登酒店，位于以黄公望先生创作《富春山居图》而闻名的杭州富阳。同时它是万豪国际集团率先在富阳区建立的豪华型酒店，南临富春江，东连东吴公园，北靠富春山馆，位于集旅游休闲、商务购物为一体的鹿山时代广场，是您探索城市的理想下榻之处。酒店拥有230间豪华客房及套房，60％的房间拥有一线江景。置身于酒店12层，在环境典雅宁静的采悦轩中餐厅享用风味俱佳的地道杭帮菜和粤菜，感受美食的碰撞；或于全日制餐厅体验自助早餐以及丰盛美味的西式午餐和晚餐。亦可前往宽敞舒适的大堂酒廊，与亲朋好友欢聚一堂，尽情享受惬意时光。酒店拥有共计近2000㎡的聚会空间、喜来登健身中心、室内游泳池，还设有别具特色的童趣乐园，致力于为您打造与众不同的会聚之所。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Hangzhou Fuyang, located in Hangzhou Fuyang, which is famous for Huang Gongwang's painting “Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains”. Which is the first hotel by Marriott International in Fuyang District, with Fuchun River in the south, Dongwu Park in the east and Fuchun Mountain Pavilion in the north. It is located in Lushan Times, which integrates tourism, leisure and business shopping, is the ideal base to explore the city. The hotel has 230 deluxe rooms and suites, more than 60% of which have a river view. On the 12th floor of the hotel, enjoy the authentic Hangzhou food and Cantonese food in the elegant environment of YUE Chinese Restaurant; Or experience buffet breakfast and delicious Western lunch and dinner at the Daily Social Restaurant. Enjoy a relaxing time with family and friends at the comfortable Lobby Lounge. The hotel is equipped with nearly 2000m² banquet space, Sheraton Fitness, Swimming Pool, and Kid's Club, committed to creating a unique meeting place for you.

hotels.descriptionEn: Set against a lush forest backdrop in Hangzhou Qingshan Lake Science and Technology City Hangzhou Marriott Hotel Lin an is an ideal choice for work or play. Our 293 hotel rooms and 35 suites boast contemporary design touches and first rate amenities ensuring a comfortable and pleasant stay. All guest accommodation boasts a flat screen TV, free WiFi, a mini fridge an ergonomic workspace and more. If you are seeking a distinctive venue for a meeting or social event in the Hangzhou China area our hotel provides 12 event rooms and over 35000 sq ft of event space. Indulge in handcrafted Chinese or  fine dining at our signature restaurants, stay in shape at our fitness cntr or enjoy a day of rejuvenation at our hotel spa. You will be delighted with our pristine location we are surrounded by Hangzhous immaculate natural landscape adjacent to Qingshan Lake and a short walk from Lion Mountain Park. No matter what brings you to China we cannot wait to welcome you to Hangzhou Marriott Hotel Lin'an.

hotels.descriptionEn: Business-friendly with a designer touch, Renaissance Hangzhou Northeast Hotel blends elements of current fashion trends with those of Chinese opera. Located in Hangzhou's vibrant Linping District, our hotel is moments from the city's attractions and near many ancient landmarks in Zhejiang Province. Our two dining options make it easy to satisfy your cravings here in Hangzhou. Wan Li Restaurant highlights the diverse flavors of China, Food Studio serves a global buffet. R Bar boasts a vibrant atmosphere, craft cocktails; we provide a stylish backdrop for relaxation after a day in Zhejiang. Our modern yet whimsical rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with scenic city views, while our Club-level accommodation offers Lounge access and additional amenities. Select our hotel to host your event, and enjoy 12,000 square feet of space, a ballroom and on-site planning and catering.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Azure Qiantang, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Hangzhou is perched on the bank of the Qiantang River, overlooking tidal bore. Our hotel provides unfettered access to the vibrant heart of Hangzhou, China's Central Business District, and is near Six Harmonies Pagoda, the West Lake, Eight Diagrams Field and more. A captivating world within a layered urban landscape, the hotel presents an indoor pool, a tranquil spa and a fitness center, as well as two restaurants featuring river views and epicurean offerings. A majestic grand ballroom and seven spacious meeting rooms ensure indelible events. Our 205 guest rooms including 20 suites provide elevated comforts and luxury furnishings, set against a breathtaking backdrop, which includes venerable views of the Qiantang River through large floor-to-ceiling windows. Discerning service and premier technology ensure a truly distinguished hotel stay.

Here, inspiration takes flight amid Hangzhou’s most stunning vistas.

hotels.descriptionEn: Welcoming and modern, Sheraton Grand Hangzhou Wetland Park Resort provides travelers with a serene and lush escape overlooking China's famed Xixi National Wetland Preservation Area. A leading meeting and events destination in Hangzhou, our resort boasts an array of venue spaces, including an elegant ballroom which can be divided into three separate spaces. Guests can also purchase snacks and refreshments from the all-day self-service 24 hour7 Market for easy meals on the go. The hotels 24 hour gym also allows guests to maintain their exercise routine even while traveling.

hotels.descriptionEn: Future Sci-Tech City in Hangzhou China is a complex constructed to attract worldwide industries. Set within this exciting venture is the Marriott Executive Apartments Hangzhou, serviced apartments designed for long-term business travelers. Serviced apartments are available with up to three bedrooms and feature full kitchens and washer/dryer setups. The Health Club includes a 24-hour gym, indoor pool and yoga room, and families enjoy access to our kids club. The hotel lounge, restaurant and mini-theater offer opportunities to socialize, while two meeting rooms are ideal for more formal gatherings. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel in Hangzhou China.

hotels.descriptionEn: Find the relaxing vacation experience at Sheraton Huzhou Taihu Lake Hot Spring Resort and Spa our revolutionary new hotel in Chinas scenic Zhejiang Province. Featuring a unique ring shaped 27 story structure placed over the waters of Tai Lake, our specially designed hotel boasts an ideal destination near ancient water towns, stone bridges, restored historic districts and waterways fed by the Grand Canal. After exploring the area, discover our hotel's premium amenities, including an onsite day spa, an infinity pool, a private beach and a custom wedding island that extends into Tai Lake. Experience beautiful water views as you sip on handcrafted cocktails or enjoy a leisurely meal in one of our waterfront restaurants. Unpack in elegant rooms with sleek marble bathrooms and complimentary WiFi. If visiting for event planning reasons, take advantage of our spacious Grand Ballroom and state of the art meeting facilities. Whatever your reason for visiting we look forward to welcoming you.

hotels.descriptionEn: No stuffy "hotel NPCs" in suits here—just high-five-ready Play Agents waiting to squad up with you! Step into our neon-drenched, industrial-chic wonderland and unlock these secret weapons:  Gamer’s Paradise: Foldable chairs transform into battle stations, a 55-inch mega-screen fuels your livestream glory, and blank walls become your creative canvas. Midnight popcorn carts + mixology rides? Let’s turn 3 AM into spontaneous party o’clock! We’ve shredded the hospitality rulebook! Every inch here radiates rebellious charm, and even the air tastes like freedom. Come crash with the world’s coolest misfits—where checking in means leveling up your social game IRL!

hotels.descriptionEn: Equally suited to business and leisure travel, the 5-star Ningbo Marriott Hotel is dedicated to making your visit to Zhejiang Province, China memorable. We're located in vibrant area of Ningbo city center, alongside the breathtaking Yao Jiang River, Zhongshan Park and Tian Yi Square. Make yourself comfortable in spacious hotel rooms with river views, complimentary Wi-Fi access, an in-room safe and a mini-bar. Stretch out in front of your LCD TV, or take advantage of a plug-in connectivity panel and an ergonomic workspace. Additional amenities for your Ningbo visit include a heated indoor pool and a sauna, as well as a modern fitness center. Satisfy your appetite at one of four on-site restaurants, where you can sample the flavors of China and the world. Those planning events in Ningbo will appreciate our over 12,000 square feet of event space, complemented by delicious catering and a reliable planning team. We know you're going to enjoy your stay at Ningbo Marriott Hotel.

With a curved, mobile desk, guests can arrange their own workspace according to their habits. Guests can enjoy healthy breakfast with a wide selection of oatmeal, scrambled eggs, sausage, make-your-own noodles, and other healthy choices, such as fruit, yogurt, and whole grain cereals and breads. Guests can also purchase snacks and refreshments from the all-day self-service 24 hour Market for easy meals on-the-go. The hotels 24-hour gym also allows guests to maintain their exercise routine even while traveling.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎下榻常州艾美酒店, 探索江苏“龙城”——常州的多彩魅力。常州艾美酒店位于新北区中华恐龙园板块, 车程约10分钟内即可抵达常州高铁站等主要交通枢纽。酒店提供多样的餐饮选择。宾客可于北纬31°啜饮艾美咖啡大师特调的illy咖啡, 去新食谱全日餐厅享用丰盛的国际自助早餐, 去东56小酒馆感受常州宵夜文化，亦或是到渔见中餐厅体验常州新菜的魅力, 聚会谈天, 尽享舌尖愉悦。酒店拥有263间客房和套房, 配备大屏飞利浦高清智能电视、独立浸泡式浴缸以及雨林式淋浴间。而席梦思特色睡床, 亦可让您在旅途中尽享一夜好眠, 用充沛活力迎接美好的每一天。酒店紧邻万达广场、江南环球港等大型商超, 地理位置优越。同时, 酒店配备了5间VIP多功能厅和1000㎡的无柱式宴会厅, 超千平的宴会及会议场地搭配自然采光给您足够的空间和高度释放思想, 满足您在繁华商圈中举办多种活动的需求。健身中心配备了专业健身器械、室内游泳池、瑜伽房、儿童乐园等让您充分享受运动带来的乐趣。酒店以艺术家的一天作为设计概念, 以当代设计演绎经典的龙城文化, 来强调人、艺术与自然的平衡, 启发宾客对于常州龙城雅韵的创意灵感。抵达艾美创驿大堂（Le Méridien Hub™）的那一刻起, 宾客沉浸于此, 探索当地文化。常州艾美酒店愿与您共同探索世界, 揭秘目的地。
hotels.descriptionEn: Welcome to Le Méridien Changzhou and explore the charm of Changzhou, Jiangsu’s “Dragon City”.Located in Xinbei District near China Dinosaur Park, the hotel is a 10-minute drive from Changzhou High-Speed Railway Station. It offers diverse dining: illy coffee at Latitude 31° North, international breakfast at Latest Recipe, local snacks at East 56 Bistro, and New Changzhou Cuisine at Yujian Chinese Restaurant.The hotel features 263 rooms and suites with Philips smart TVs, soaking tubs, rainforest showers and Simmons beds.Close to Wanda Plaza and Jiangnan Global Harbor, it has 5 VIP function rooms and a 1,000 sqm column-free ballroom. Facilities include a fitness centre, indoor pool, yoga studio and kids’ zone.With the concept “A Day in the Life of an Artist”, the hotel combines modern design with Dragon City culture. Le Méridien Hub™ lets guests experience local culture.Le Méridien Changzhou looks forward to exploring the world with you.

hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Changzhou Xinbei Hotel is designed for modern travelers. Boasting the location in the heart of Changzhous vibrant CBD steps away from plentiful shopping at Wanda Plaza and near noteworthy attractions like China Dinosaur Park, our hotel is your home base from which to explore the city during your time in China. All of our intelligently appointed rooms and suites boast plenty of space to relax, as well as plush bedding, complimentary high speed WiFi access, a flat-screen TV, a sleek marble bathroom, a mini-fridge and an ergonomic workspace. Guests can also take advantage of heated indoor pool, a well-equipped fitness center, exceptional onsite restaurant options and almost 23,000 square feet of sophisticated venue space for a business meeting, wedding or social gathering of any size here in the CBD, our pillarless Grand Ballroom, with seating for 1,200, offers a one-of-a-kind backdrop for an event. Discover the difference at Sheraton Changzhou Xinbei Hotel.

Its proximity to renowned attractions such as Tianmu Lake and Nanshan Bamboo Sea makes it an excellent choice for business and leisure visitors alike.

hotels.descriptionZh: 常州万豪酒店设有 263 间全景客房，设计典雅精致、宽敞舒适，可饱览绚丽的城市天际线景观。每间客房均配备先进的设施设备，包括 Wi-Fi 网络、配有羽绒被和纯棉床单的豪华床上用品，以及宽敞的大理石浴室和 42 英寸至 55 英寸的平面电视。酒店设有约 1,900 平方米的会议空间，其中包括面积约 800 平方米的大宴会厅和面积约 280 平方米的尊贵豪华宴会厅。酒店拥有都会尚膳餐厅、豪轩中餐厅、意大利餐厅及大堂吧等 4 间餐饮场所，宾客可尊享各式美味的当地及国际美味菜肴。常州万豪酒店设施齐全，为宾客提供多种健身选择，其中包括室内泳池和 24 小时开放的健身房。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover a blend of comfort and convenience in China at Changzhou Marriott Hotel, boasting 263 elegant rooms on the top floors of Changzhous iconic skyscraper. Our prime location is situated near the area's notable attractions, including China Dinosaur Park, Tianning Temple and Hongmei Park as well as many local transportation options. After a busy day in the city, explore the wealth of amenities at our hotel, including a 24 hour health center, an indoor pool and popular onsite restaurants. Unwind with delectable international cuisine in the City Bistro, The Hao Chinese restaurant, Tuscany Grill Italian restaurant and The Lounge. In the evening, retreat to spacious accommodations with WiFi access, marble bathrooms and comfortable bedding with cotton rich linens. If visiting Changzhou for business reasons, enjoy planning productive meetings in 20,623 square feet of modern venue space with hitech audiovisual equipment. We look forward to providing you with a memorable stay in our Changzhou Marriott Hotel.

hotels.descriptionZh: 常州万怡酒店地处常州、无锡、江阴三市交界的黄金地带，紧邻沪蓉、沪武高速，交通通达顺畅。 酒店距常州高铁站约20公里，距常州高铁北站约22公里，确保旅途出行更为高效便捷。 酒店拥有205间舒适现代的客房和套房，所有客房均设有露台，宾客可轻松饱览舜山怡人景致。 客房均配备舒适床品、步入式淋浴间、55寸高清电视、人体工学沙发、灵活便捷的办公区域及高速无线网络，部分房型还配有戴森高速吹风机，为宾客打造卓越入住体验。 所处的舜山小镇作为集文化、商业、游玩、住宿以及研学为一体的综合性文旅项目，巧妙将传统文化与现代格调相融合，成为当下游客造访常州的理想选择。
hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard provides flexibility and choices for our guests.  With locally inspired three meal a day restaurant options, Courtyard is your destination for a great breakfast, or drinks and dinner during the evening. You will also enjoy inviting, flexible spaces where you can work or relax, including our signature media pods, and free WiFi throughout. Plus, our well-equipped fitness center will help you stay refreshed and energized. Whether traveling for business or pleasure, your stay at Courtyard is sure to be comfortable and productive.

hotels.descriptionZh: 常州星河万丽酒店坐落于风景如画的西太湖，毗邻滆湖湿地公园、金沙湾高尔夫球场，景色秀美，风光旖旎。酒店以“探索新奇与发现美好”为品牌理念，演绎探险之旅，带您卓越体验生活的每一刻。酒店地理位置优越，25分钟车程可达常州市中心、常州高铁站，35分钟车程可达常州奔牛机场。冶艳山川合，风姿烟雨生。常州星河万丽酒店犹如一颗剔透晶莹的珍珠，优雅地倚立在西太湖岸畔，融入了这幅流动的水墨画中。酒店的设计融合了当地特色，极具江南风情，空间和材质的创新运用，以及对独特品质的不懈追求，使得常州星河万丽酒店迷人、奢华而不炫耀。酒店拥有339间别具特色的摩登客房和套房，每间房均坐拥令人惊叹的非凡湖景，并配备豪华的床上用品、高速上网、保险箱和迷你吧。集结中西式精致美馔：“燃”餐厅汇聚各国佳肴的自助餐以及别有情调的A LA CARTE零点，令您始终品尝心仪美味；万丽轩中餐厅提供原汁原味的精致淮扬菜，做工精细，色香味形俱佳。酒店还设有逾3000平米的宴会空间，包括1200㎡无柱大宴会厅、600㎡的多功能厅、以及四间多功能会议室及董事会议室，可为多至3000人提供理想的活动场地，一应俱全的会议及宴会配套服务，将为宾客带来丰富多元化的选择。另有酒吧、恒温泳池、多功能的健身中心、儿童乐园、VR影院等休闲娱乐项目，以及位于 43楼的行政楼层酒廊，其中顶楼还设有直升机停机坪。在此，西太湖碧水绿柳的如画景致尽收眼底。
hotels.descriptionEn: Set by picturesque the West Taihu Lake where vibrant waters blend into piercing blue skies the Renaissance Changzhou Wujin Hotel opens its doors to a chic environment. The hotel is conveniently located about 40 minutes by car from Changzhou Benniu Intl Airport. There are 339 lakeview rooms with unique lighting layout, simple, and colorful guest room levels bring you extraordinary accommodation experience.  The executive lounge on the 43rd floor offers panoramic views of the West Taihu Lake. Our restaurant is full service. You can dine with family and friends at any restaurant in the evening for a gourmet meal. We look forward to welcoming you to Renaissance Changzhou Wujin Hotel.

It deliver convenient experiences for leisure stays and daily relaxation.

hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled in the core of Gulou District, this next-generation Four Points by Sheraton under Marriott International blends modern business elegance with Jinling cultural charm.Designed in vintage-modern style, the hotel features a bright lobby with warm wood tones and refined metallic accents. The Mesh acts as a social hub offering coffee, craft drinks, light meals and flexible workspaces. It has over 182 stylish rooms and suites from 30㎡, equipped with Marriott-standard mattresses, panoramic windows, smart bathrooms and efficient work areas.Guests can enjoy craft beers via the Best Brews program and taste Chinese, Western and local Nanjing cuisines at the all-day dining restaurant. A 24-hour fitness center, business center and versatile meeting spaces are also provided.With convenient access to metro lines, transport hubs and scenic spots including Xuanwu Lake and Yuejiang Tower, the hotel combines international quality with thoughtful local service, delivering a balanced experience for modern travelers.

hotels.descriptionEn: Discover one of the four great ancient capitals of China at Renaissance Nanjing Olympic Centre Hotel. Nanjing has a firm place in the country’s history as an important inland ports and is quickly securing its status for the future with exciting growth in the city. Set in the Jianye District’s Hexi business circle, our modern business hotel boasts a prime location near the International Expo Centre and multiple industrial parks. The neighborhood is also offers shopping, dining and vibrant nightlife on La-Defense Street. Unpack in spacious accommodations with stylish decor, sleek bathrooms and deluxe amenities. Elevate your stay with an upgraded room for Club Level access and extra perks. Boasting multiple restaurants, a 24-hour fitness center, an indoor pool and more than 24,750 square feet of event space, our hotel is the ideal choice for both international and domestic business travelers. We look forward to providing you with a memorable experience at Renaissance Nanjing Olympic Centre Hotel.

hotels.descriptionEn: Moxy Nanjing Jiangning is  the first Moxy Hotels in China. Owned by Nanjing Jingyuan Co., Ltd, the 176-room Moxy Nanjing-Jiangning features the brand’s DNA with stylish decoration and fun collaborative spaces. The hotel is located at the intersection of Jiangning Development Zone, Hightech Zone and Dongshan Old Town. The location has a supporting commercial complex, We have easy access to subway line1 and line 5. It is adjacent to a number of popular tourist destinations, including Usnisa Palace, Gingko Lake, etc. It can reach Nanjing South Railway Station in 15min, and Nanjing Lukou Airport in 30min.

hotels.descriptionEn: Experience a new kind of comfort at Courtyard Nanjing Jiangning. Conveniently located 10-minute from Nanjing South Railway Station and connected directly with Metro Line 1, our hotel can easily access the notable local destination like Baijia Lake Park and many other attractions such as Niushoushan Cultural Park, and Confucius Temple. Our hotel features 229 contemporary guest rooms including 12 elegant suites. Accommodations are also equipped to meet your upscale lifestyle and include complimentary Wi-Fi, large work desks, flat-panel TVs. Satisfy your appetite at The Pavilion, our onsite restaurant and lounge serving savory breakfast and specialty dinner options, authentic Asian & local food and drinks. Maintain your exercise routine at our 24-hour fitness center. Host a productive meeting or intimate social event in one of our event rooms featuring AV equipment and custom catering options. Whether you're in Nanjing for business or pleasure, enjoy a memorable stay at Courtyard Nanjing Jiangning.

hotels.descriptionEn: Experience brilliant service in a prime setting at The Westin Nanjing, China. Located in the central business district, with stunning views of Xuanwu Lake and Nanjing's skyline, our 5 star hotel is the ideal choice for every traveler to this historic city. Each of our modern rooms and suites offers room to relax as well as our signature Westin products and amenities. Go for a swim in our indoor heated pool, work out in the WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio. Savor delicious dining in our hotel's restaurants, or enjoy a quiet dinner in the privacy of your room with 24-hour room service. If a business meeting, social event or wedding brings you to our hotel, you'll discover elegant venues highlighted by inspiring mountain and lake vistas, custom catering and a team of experts who will work with you from start to finish. When it's time to explore, Nanjing's history is just minutes away. Whether staying with us for work or vacation, we look forward to making your stay here memorable.

Include Danny’s Irish pub & restaurant-Nanjing’s first and only Irish bar; Daily Social Restaurant enjoys a good reputation of dinner buffet with international food and Nanjing local snacks.

hotels.descriptionEn: Treat yourself to an exceptional stay at Marriott Nanjing South Hotel. A fantastic choice for both business and leisure guests visiting China we feature contemporary guest rooms and suites and great location in the bustling Jiangning District tech and business zone near a variety of corporate destinations. Our hotel rooms provide locally inspired design accents and a host of outstanding perks like complimentary WiFi access, a flat-screen TV, a mini-bar and floor-to-ceiling windows. Savor expertly prepared all-day dining, or the sample flavors of China at our two onsite restaurants. In addition, our chic Lobby Lounge is the good place to begin or end your day in the Jiangning District. Make use of our fitness center with a sauna and steam room as well as a heated indoor pool. Select our hotel to host your meeting or social occasion to enjoy 27,000 square feet of venue space including two pillarless grand ballrooms. Marriott Nanjing South Hotel is excited to welcome you.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Sifang Hotel Nanjing, Autograph Collection showcases self expression and individuality at every turn. Conceived and designed by 24 international and domestic architects. The Main building takes the strategy of breaking one into two whole into parts conceals the public spaces down to the valley and breaks the guest rooms of ridge into small volumes. The whole building cluster consequently gets used to the terrain and fairly integrates with the environment. Concrete blocks of black, white and gray are applied where a contemporary Chinese water mountain cluster is created with the common cement products widely used in small village and towns and conceived and designed by Liu Jiakun, who is a Chief Architect in Jiakun Architects.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎下榻南通艾美酒店，探索“江海明珠”——南通市的多彩魅力。南通艾美酒店位于南通市核心地段, 车程约20分钟内即可抵达南通机场、高铁站等主要交通枢纽。酒店提供多样的餐饮选择。宾客可于北纬32啜饮艾美咖啡大师亲手奉上的illy咖啡, 去咖啡馆66享用丰盛的国际自助晚餐, 亦或是到乐美中餐厅体验淮扬美食与融合菜的魅力, 聚会谈天, 尽享舌尖愉悦。酒店拥有278间客房和套房，配备大屏华为高清智能电视、独立浸泡式浴缸以及雨林式淋浴间。而席梦思特色睡床, 亦可让您在旅途中尽享一夜好眠, 用充沛活力迎接美好的每一天。酒店紧邻山姆会员商店、宜家家居、万达广场、万象城等大型商超，地理位置优越。同时，酒店配备了6间VIP多功能厅和520㎡的无柱式宴会厅，近千平的宴会及会议场地搭配自然采光给您足够的空间和高度释放思想，满足您在繁华商圈中举办多种活动的需求。健身中心配备了专业健身器械、室内游泳池、智能按摩池、瑜伽房、儿童乐园等让您充分享受运动带来的乐趣。酒店以艺术家的一天作为设计概念, 以当代设计演绎经典的江海文化, 来强调人、艺术与自然的平衡, 启发宾客对于南通江海港湾意境的创意灵感。抵达艾美创驿大堂（Le Méridien Hub™）的那一刻起, 宾客沉浸于此, 探索当地文化。南通艾美酒店愿与您共同探索世界，揭秘目的地。

hotels.descriptionZh: 作为万豪国际集团大中华地区首家AC品牌，苏州AC酒店位于苏州姑苏区核心地段，距苏州站约20分钟车程，距苏州北站约40分钟车程，便捷通达各大景点名胜。酒店拥有135 间客房与套房，其中5间为庭院房。客房从苏州古典园林中汲取设计灵感，并以仿古城地图的丝绸画装饰，营造出一种优雅和谐的氛围。所有客房均配备55英寸高清液晶电视、独立淋浴间、免费高速Wi-Fi等设施。酒店的外观设计借鉴了传统苏州建筑中常见的白色泥墙、深灰色粘土制瓦片屋顶，以及起伏折叠的几何图形等特点，营造了一种宁静幽远的意境。在室内设计方面，酒店将现代与传统元素融合，各处都能见到凸显苏州元素的艺术作品，让宾客一迈入酒店便能感受到苏州的文化底蕴，呈现出独特的苏式待客之道。同时，酒店的多功能空间，可以根据宾客的需求在宴请和会议中随意切换；完善的健身配套设施可以帮助宾客放松身心，保持理想状态。酒店凭借多样化的空间转换、独特的人文体验以及对宾客需求的细致洞察，致力于让宾客沉浸在顺畅悦心的居停体验之中。
hotels.descriptionEn: AC Hotel Suzhou is located in Gusu District, the city center with the most profound history and cultural heritage in Suzhou. The hotel has become a new landmark with its modern glass and stone elements mixed with the traditional Jiangnan water town’s architectural features of white walls and black tiles.With timeless design, unique cultural experiences, and attentive service, AC Hotel Suzhou is committed to creating a pleasant and comfortable stay.
