hotels.descriptionEn: Slip into a brilliant world of floating art pieces as W Suzhou offers a modern interpretation of the city’s architectural and verdant heritage through playful installations of glass, light and other fantastical elements. Filled with vibrant hues inspired by local opera and furnishings that appear to defy gravity, luxury hotel rooms dazzle with signature W beds, pampering bath products, high-speed WiFi and ample workstations, as well as delightful views of Suzhou and Jinji Lake. If you need to extend your stay in China, select one of our 60 serviced apartments, all accentuated with swirling color. Escapism entices with larger-than-life nature motifs at our indulgent AWAY Spa, FIT and WET pool. Our dazzling venues elevate your event from ordinary to extraordinary. Exquisite gastronomy and a vivacious cocktail culture complete this remarkable hotel narrative. W Suzhou is in Building 7 of Suzhou Center, near Jinji Lake, trendy shopping and numerous corporate offices.

It features convenient transportation: walkable bus stops, 10-minute drive to the nearest subway station, 25 minutes to Suzhou’s ancient city center and railway station, and 40 minutes to Sunan Shuofang International Airport.The hotel offers 160 modern guest rooms and suites with industrial-style decor, warm tones, comfortable bedding, 65-inch LCD TVs, separate showers, and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Guests can use the Marriott Bonvoy App for digital room keys and express check-in/out.THE MESH, the brand’s signature dining venue on the 1st floor, provides local craft beers via Best Brews™,coffee and snacks. The 4th-floor all-day dining restaurant serves daily Chinese and Western buffet breakfast with local specialties.Guests have access to the 24-hour fitness center on the 4th floor, which is equipped with high-end strength training and aerobic fitness equipment.

hotels.descriptionEn: As the sun sets on Suzhou China the air fills with the melodies of fishermen returning with their daily catch. The day’s final light casts a glow on lush tea plantations, romantic canals and majestic mountains. In this Venice of the Orient, a 2,500 year old culture invites exploration of its ancient arts, temples and gardens. Set by scenic Taihu Lake where vibrant waters blend into piercing blue skies, Renaissance Suzhou Taihu Lake Hotel opens its doors to a chic environment. Local textures and colors are reflected in superb contemporary decor. Designer hotel rooms, suites and villas feature natural tones punctuated by flashes of turquoise and offer free WiFi, plush bedding and spa-inspired bathrooms. hotels.descriptionZh: 江阴霞客湾观堂臻品之选酒店以“游圣”徐霞客文化为核心IP，将传统东方美学与现代简约风格融合，让宾客在舒适居停中感受“身居一室，心游万仞”的文化体验。 酒店周边配套丰富，有国家地理研学、航天科技体验中心（含徐霞客游记VR体验）等研学项目，还有隐札迹营地、霞客探索乐园等，兼具研学、露营与儿童玩乐功能。 店内设182间客房（33-338㎡），部分含私人泡池、湖景或露台；康乐设施含24小时健身中心、沿湖户外无边泳池及儿童俱乐部；餐饮有4个餐厅（含1间特色餐厅）和6间茶室，全日餐厅享180度环湖景，中餐厅主打粤、淮扬菜；宴会空间含2间无柱大宴会厅（982㎡、726㎡）、5间多功能厅及户外派对草坪。依托德胧观堂与万豪臻品之选双品牌，酒店兼具文化深度与高端服务。
hotels.descriptionEn: Grand House, Jiangyin, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel takes Xu Xiake culture as its core IP, blending traditional Oriental aesthetics with modern minimalism, letting guests enjoy the cultural experience of “staying in a room, mind roaming far” during their stay. Around the hotel are rich facilities: National Geographic research, Aerospace Technology Experience Center, plus Yinzhaji Campsite, Xiake Exploration Park, combining research, camping and children’s play functions. Inside, there are 182 rooms, some with private spas, lake views or terraces; a 24-hour fitness center, lakeside outdoor infinity pool and children’s club; catering covers 4 restaurants and 6 tea houses—the all-day dining has a 180°lake view, and the Chinese restaurant focuses on Cantonese and Huaiyang cuisines. Banquet spaces include 2 column-free ballrooms, 5 multi-function halls and outdoor party lawns. Backed by Delonix Grand House and Marriott Tribute Portfolio, it integrates cultural depth and high-end service.

hotels.descriptionZh: 张家港万豪酒店位于张家港汇金国际购物和娱乐中心，便利舒适的均衡体验尽在此间。酒店位于张家港的经济和文化中心，步行片刻即可抵达张家港的各大景点，包括万达购物广场、张家港文化中心、保利大剧院和梁丰生态园。320 间客房和套房空间宽敞，设有落地窗和开放式浴室，可赏揽天际线景观。酒店设有中餐厅和海鲜自助餐厅，供应丰盛可口的美食；大堂休闲酒吧可谓工作和放松两相宜。健身设施包括一间 24 小时健身中心，其中设有瑜伽工作室和室内恒温泳池。这间现代化的新酒店设有两间无柱式宴会厅、四间会议室、一间多功能厅、一间董事会议室和一个室外花园，适合举办各类会议和婚礼。欢迎莅临下榻中国张家港国际商务酒店，体验卓尔不凡的尊贵感受。
hotels.descriptionEn: Convenience and comfort are well balanced at the Zhangjiagang Marriott Hotel, located within the Hui Jin International Center shopping and entertainment complex. Set in the economic and cultural center of Zhangjiagang, China, our hotel is walking distance to the city’s major attractions including Wanda Shopping Mall, Zhangjiagang Cultural Center, Poly Theatre and Liangfeng Ecological Park. The 320 guest rooms and suites feature spacious layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, skyline views and open-plan bathrooms. Dining is a discovery of cuisines with Chinese and seafood buffet restaurants; work and relaxation intersect at the lobby lounge and bar. Wellness amenities include a 24-hour fitness center with a yoga studio and an indoor heated pool. For meetings and weddings, our modern, new hotel offers two pillar-free ballrooms, four meeting rooms, a function room, a boardroom and an outdoor garden. A stay at our international business hotel in Zhangjiagang, China, is truly an extraordinary one.

hotels.descriptionZh: 镇江康华汇利喜来登酒店位于中国江苏省，采用精巧时尚的设计，配备现代化的设施，地理位置优越，恭迎您的光临。酒店位于镇江市中心，邻近万达广场，靠近火车站，距离机场也仅短途车程。客房宽敞优雅，提供免费 Wi-Fi 接入和喜来登特色睡眠体验之床，并可饱览城市或山峦美景。酒店内设三间餐厅，供应中餐、日本料理和国际美食。入住期间，您可以到酒店健身房享受健身锻炼，或在室内恒温泳池畅游几个来回。如果您在江苏举办活动，我们可以提供近 1,672 平米的多功能场地，其中包括一间 1200 平方米的无柱大宴会厅。如果您想要探索游览一番，西津渡古街和焦山亦近在咫尺。欢迎莅临镇江康华汇利喜来登酒店，开启非同一般的住宿之旅！
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Zhenjiang Hotel welcomes you to Jiangsu Province, China with stylish design, modern amenities and a convenient location. You'll find our hotel adjacent to Wanda Plaza in the heart of downtown Zhenjiang; the railway station is steps away, and the airport is easily reachable by car. Settle in to spacious, gracefully designed accommodation with complimentary Wi-Fi access, city or mountain views and our iconic Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. Savor Chinese, Japanese and international dining at one of our three hotel restaurants. Maintain your fitness at our on-site gym, or enjoy a swim in the heated indoor pool. If you're hosting an event in Jiangsu, we offer nearly 18,000 square feet of versatile venue space, including an expansive Grand Ballroom. Should you wish to explore, our hotel is just a short distance from attractions including Xinjin Ferry Street and Jiao Mountain. We look forward to making your stay special at Sheraton Zhenjiang Hotel.

hotels.descriptionEn: Perched atop a 76-story landmark in Jingkou District’s core commercial area, Zhenjiang Marriott Hotel is directly linked to Suning Plaza with easy access to transportation and local attractions. It offers 328 sky-high rooms with panoramic river, city and mountain views. Guests enjoy diverse dining, 1,532 sqm versatile event space, a 24-hour fitness center and an indoor heated pool. Blending Jiangnan’s heritage with Marriott hospitality, it delivers a premium experience for business and leisure travelers.

hotels.descriptionZh: 成都AC酒店坐落于凤凰山体育公园内，一个融合体育、演艺、商业休闲的综合体，也是一个生态、开放、多元的城市公园。酒店楼体外立面设计灵感源于四川传统文化元素“蜀锦”，转折变化的曲面流畅优美，结合菱形穿孔铝板的交织错落，形成了独特的编织肌理。从酒店出发，步行5分钟可达地铁5号线，驱车15分钟内可前往成都大熊猫繁育研究基地，驱车约18分钟左右可抵达昭觉寺景区，驱车约20分钟左右可抵达宝光寺景区。距成都东站约30分钟车程，距成都双流国际机场约45分钟车程，便捷的交通可畅达成都各商圈及景点。成都AC酒店优越的地理位置将为宾客提供便捷无忧的旅行体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Chengdu North in the Phoenix Hill Sports park, which is not only a multifaceted hub blending sports, performing arts, business, and leisure but also an ecological, open and diverse city park. The facade design of the hotel building is inspired by the traditional cultural element of Sichuan “Shu Brocade”.  The curved surface with changing transitions is smooth and graceful, combined with the interweaving of the diamond-shaped perforated aluminum plate, creating a unique woven texture. 15-minute drive to Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding. With 5-minute walk to Metro Line 5,30-minute drive to Chengdudong Railway Station and 45-minute drive to Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport. AC Hotels By Marriott Chengdu North Chinas prime’ location that provide travellers with a seamless travel experience.

hotels.descriptionZh: 准备好一起耍出成都姿态！传统与现代、从容又热情、拼搏也耍乐，多维度的巧妙碰撞，成就蜀都耍在当下、纵情享受的潇洒。当你探索这座城市精彩非凡的川剧艺术及远溯至三国时代的人文历史时，你会发现麻辣鲜香的川菜百味更加令人着迷。璀璨的成都在经济及社会的飞跃发展下，庆祝着这种慢生活、快节奏的对比。这座闲适和谐的公园城市同时化身活力十足的动感空间，诠释着会耍且包容的成都姿态。成都W酒店位于繁荣的金融商圈、高新区精彩不夜城，创造集设计、音乐、时尚和活力为一体的新触点。热辣在此吸引所有舞台焦点。快跟随成都W酒店时讯达人感受城市脉搏，游走城市中的隐秘空间，深入了解这个文化大都市更新更潮的生活节奏吧！置身于LIVING ROOM潮堂的日夜场景转换之中，潮人、音乐和互动艺术体验在此混搭出各种场景。在活力随性的ZING型乐餐厅感受本地食材与国际风味擦出的创意火花，多重滋味触发味蕾活力。夜幕降临，沉浸于当地新兴艺术家及名DJ的节奏中，狂欢于SPARK燎屋顶酒吧的舞池中，成为全场瞩目焦点。来FIT有型健身中心为身体充电，荡漾在WET碧波泳池变换多彩的灯光中，或前往AWAY SPA水疗中心体验别具一格的压力释放，无论哪一种方式，都能让你释放活力，焕然一新。酒店颠覆传统设计的297间客房及套房，以机智有趣且突破边界的手法重新诠释成都的摩登现代。随时/随需满足你享受当下的狂热，无论所需、无论何时均可确保。认真耍，慢慢活。在成都W酒店耍出你的都态！
hotels.descriptionEn: W Chengdu is located in the pulsating Gaoxin district. Soak up the pulse of the city and get Insider Access to the newest, eclectic lifestyle that beats through this cultural cosmopolitan. A never-ending flow of the like-minded entangled in music and interactive art will see the Living Room transform from day to night. Ignite your palate with an explosive interplay of Southeast Asian and Sichuan spices at ZING. See and be seen at SPARK while you get lost in the euphoric beats of local emerging artists and reputable DJs. Fuel your body at FIT, ripple through to the infinity of lights at WET and get your glow on at AWAY SPA. Then re-imagine witty interpretations of the endlessly playful Chengdu in one of the 297 rooms and suites. WHATEVER WHENEVER makes sure you have what you want, when you want it. Play hard, live easy. Show your Dutitude and turn up the spice at W Chengdu.

Meeting spaces include a Grand Ballroom, Junior Ballroom and seven additional meeting rooms totaling 1716 square meters of function space. Guests will find relaxation and wellness within a full-floor luxury spa and an indoor swimming pool with underwater music.

Our onsite restaurants celebrate the flavors of China, providing a modern twist on the traditional cuisine found along Chunxi Road, Chengdus busiest street. We feature eight sophisticated venues, including a 10,635 square-foot Grand Ballroom with a pre function foyer, a rooftop JW Garden and space for 800. Rejuvenate body and mind at our well-equipped fitness center, indoor swimming pool or luxury spa. We offer a contemporary setting from which to explore Chengdu, Chinas historic past, with ideal hotel placement near Kuan and Zhai alleys, Wenshu Yuan Monastery, Taikoo Li and IFS. Experience a new definition of luxury at JW Marriott Hotel Chengdu.

hotels.descriptionEn: Set on prestigious Tianfu Avenue near Chengdu Financial City and its metro station, YinTai Centre and government agencies, Chengdu Marriott Hotel Financial Centre promises guests an extraordinary travel experience. This chic, modernistic theme extends to our spacious guest rooms and suites, where large windows frame sweeping views of the city and marble bathrooms exude a sense of calm. Set against the backdrop of the majestic mountain in the ancient city of Emeishan.Our hotel features rooms and suites offering evocative perspectives of the lush green surrounds. All rooms offer contemporary design and amenities including a flat-screen TV, wireless high-speed internet access, a separate bath and a shower with Le Meridien bath amenities. Our signature bed with crisp linens provides an energizing night's rest.Le Méridien Hub is a gathering place for creative minds to converse, debate and exchange. Inspired dining choices are offered in our two hotel dining venues. A hot spring, a fully equipped fitness center and an indoor heated swimming pool offer stimulating options to restore balance after a busy day in Emeishan.Business meetings and social events are smoothly hosted in our 16,285 square feet of versatile function space with integrated service provided.

hotels.descriptionZh: 日赛谷丽思卡尔顿隐世酒店邻近九寨沟联合国教科文组织世界遗产，是一处超凡脱俗的庄园酒店，在这里，每个角落都流露着发自内心的真诚关怀与匠心巧思。酒店坐落在九寨沟群山之中，酒店建筑由 WATG 设计，室内设计由 Jaya Ibrahim 操刀，景观设计由 John Pettigrew 担纲。酒店建筑与周边环境巧妙融合在一起，用材、配色、效果、配件和古玩等选择均能体现当地特色文化。酒店拥有 87 间设计精美的独栋别墅，周边有众多藏族古寨和壮美森林山川，酒店设有多处观景点，供宾客一年四季畅览谷中迷人景色。酒店设有众多水疗设施，为您打造静谧闲适的宜人氛围。
hotels.descriptionEn: Rissai Valley, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, a magnificent rare estate situated in close proximity to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou, at the ends of the earth, protected and unspoiled, where the heartfelt care and craft of individuals is felt at every turn.Nestled amid in the rolling mountains of Jiuzhaigou, the building is designed by WATG while the late Jaya Ibrahim crafted the interior designs and John Pettigrew oversees the landscape design. Blending the architecture into the surrounding environment, the Reserve expresses a strong local connection in the selection of materials, colors, finishes, accessories, antiques etc. Featuring well designed 87 stand-alone villas which are overlooking the surrounding forest mountainous sceneries and steps away from ancient Tibetan villages, the Reserve offers plenty of lookout points for our guest to enjoy the stunning view of four seasons in the valley has to offer. Our extensive SPA facilities provide a serene environment of tranquility.

hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel offers 211 elegant and stylish guest rooms and suites, providing you with an extremely comfortable accommodation experience. The rooms are spacious and bright, equipped with "Sweet Dream Beds", high-definition LCD TVs, high-speed wireless internet, and premium toiletries. The panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows offer a view of the Minjiang River. The hotel also features a gym and a lobby bar, serving coffee, tea, fresh juices, craft beers, and light snacks. The all-day dining restaurant offers both Chinese and Western breakfasts, including local Sichuan snacks, as well as central Sichuan and Cantonese classic dishes and various Western international cuisines, allowing you to enjoy relaxation and happiness and gain a pleasant experience of both body and mind.

hotels.descriptionZh: 宜宾产城竹颂万怡酒店坐落于宜宾市叙州区竹颂生态城，作为率先在川南亮相的万豪国际品牌酒店，将现代美学、巴蜀建筑与当地竹元素进行巧妙组合, 与其时尚而有活力的品牌文化融合，辅以细致周到的服务，为商务和休闲宾客打造理想下榻之选。酒店拥有230间现代风格设计的客房及套房，其精心设计的客房配有舒适的床品和灵活的办公及休闲空间，为宾客打造轻松愉和焕活身心的入住体验。全日餐厅供应环球美馔和本地风味, 约800平米灵动的会议及宴会空间将满足宾客的不同会议及宴会需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard by Marriott Yibin is situated in Zhusong Ecological City, Xuzhou District, Yibin. As the first debut of Marriott International's brand in southern Sichuan, the hotel combines its smart and vibrant brand culture with an ingenious integration of modern aesthetics, Bashu architecture and local bamboo elements. Complemented by meticulous service, it creates an ideal stay for both business and leisure guests. The hotel features 230 modern-style guest rooms and suites, creating a comfortable and natural atmosphere while showcasing the cultural charm of bamboo poetry and the historical transformation of this famous city. The all-day dining restaurant offers a variety of global and local delicacies, and the 800-square-meter meeting space can meet the diverse needs of banquet and conference guests.

hotels.descriptionZh: Four Points by Sheraton Danzhou is located in central business district of Danzhou, a western city in Hainan, that offer comfortable experience through Han and Tang Dynasty style, tasty local culinary and un-complicated service.
hotels.descriptionEn: The Danzhou Four Points by Sheraton Hotel, situated in the commercial and political hub of Danzhou City, and adjacent to the Summer Business Plaza, boasts superior geographical location and convenient transportation. The hotel has 194 comfortable guestrooms, each meticulously designed reflecting the culture of Han and Tang Dynasty, and equipped with Four Points’ comfortable bed and related facilities, to ensure warm and comfortable living experience for you. Three restaurants and bars offer experience of taste buds in various flavors, while the 1800 m2 banquet hall and 11 separate multi-functional meeting rooms are tailored for different types of business meetings and wedding banquets.

hotels.descriptionZh: 海口国际机场福朋喜来登酒店坐落于海口美兰国际机场周边，交通便捷，为商务及休闲旅客提供舒适高效的住宿体验。酒店拥有149间现代简约风格的客房及套房，布局规整，空间明亮，其中高级房型面积约40平方米，配备福朋喜来登品牌特色的舒适睡床、灵活办公区及高速网络，满足差旅与度假的双重需求。酒店临近机场及海口市区主要商圈，兼顾出行便利与城市探索的可能。无论是中转停留，还是深度体验海口的热带风情与滨海活力，这里都以标志性的“简约自在”服务，为宾客打造轻松可靠的旅居选择。
hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Haikou International Airport Hotel is located in the vicinity of Haikou Meilan International Airport, offering convenient transportation and providing comfortable and efficient accommodation experiences for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features 149 guest rooms and suites with a modern and minimalist style, boasting regular layouts and bright spaces. Among them, the superior rooms cover an area of approximately 40 square meters, equipped with Four Points by Sheraton's signature comfortable beds, flexible work areas, and high-speed internet, catering to the dual needs of business trips and vacations.Situated close to the airport and Haikou's main commercial districts, the hotel provides easy access to transportation and urban exploration. Whether for a transit stay or an in-depth experience of Haikou's tropical charm and coastal vibrancy, the hotel delivers its signature "Simple Made Perfect" service, creating a relaxed and reliable stay for guests.

hotels.descriptionZh: 海口丽思卡尔顿酒店位于观澜湖旅游度假园区，毗邻深圳免税海口观澜湖免税城、以及占地350英亩的黑石球场，赫赫有名的观澜湖高尔夫球会环绕四周，建于火山喷发形成的基岩之上，集嶙峋的岩层地貌、丛林植被、广袤的湖泊及大片湿地于一体，以其绚丽多姿的壮美景观著称。酒店共设有190间客房，其中包括16栋别墅及15间套房，下榻海口丽思卡尔顿的客人可在任意一间客房内欣赏窗外的秀美风光，感受大自然的杰作与馈赠。富丽豪华的海口丽思卡尔顿酒店共有占地3,500平方米的宴会场地，可供客人举办会议或庆祝活动。宴会设施包括1座占地1,350平方米的大宴会厅、2座小型宴会厅（各占地275平方米）、7间会议室，以及1间董事会议室。酒店坐拥修剪整齐的草坪球道以及大片绿地，婚礼策划师将在此为客人缔造如梦似幻的活动体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Haikou is located in the volcanic region of Haikou city on the exotic Hainan Island of China. The 190-room, 16-villa and 15-suite hotel enjoy year-round tropical sunshine for perfect days on the legendary 350-acre Blackstone Course that weaves its way around the world-renowned Mission Hills Golf Club. Built on top of a bedrock of ancient lava from extinct volcanoes, the dramatic landscape features rocky outcrops with striking variations of jungle vegetation, expansive lakes and wetlands which can be viewed from every room. The luxury golf resort features 3,500 sqm of banquet facilities for conferences and celebrations. Spaces include a 1,350 sqm Grand Ballroom, two Junior Ballrooms (275 sqm each), seven Meeting Rooms and one Boardroom. With a manicured Fairway Lawn and vast expanses of greenery, The Ritz-Carlton, Haikou wedding specialists can create a memorable experience to perfection.

hotels.descriptionZh: 海口美兰万豪万枫酒店交通便捷，地理位置优越，地处美兰区政务中心和国兴CBD，紧邻省委省政府，省博物馆，省歌剧院，省图书馆，日月广场免税中心，步行10分钟至桫椤湾艺术风情街，雅乐里商业街；驱车约25分钟至海口美兰国际机场，20分钟至海口高铁东站，20分钟至秀英港渡轮码头。距离海南岛大河流南渡江约1.5公里，南渡江设有步道和骑行道，是海口上佳的骑行和徒步路线。周边五公里内有著名景点五公祠，海口骑楼老街，海瑞故居，琼台书院。酒店兼具奢华与质感，独栋建筑的安排让您能享受舒适与安静，仿若置身世外桃源；酒店105间精致客房，均配备65寸全高清可投屏电视、TOTO马桶、Moen恒温卫浴、Nirvae洗护产品和环保级客用品，为客户提供安心奢享的入住体验；酒店健身设备采用国际一线品牌Matrix，提供理想的健身体验。酒店设有145平多功能会议室和西餐厅满足专业、高效的商务需求。无论您是旅途劳顿，还是商务出行，海口美兰万豪万枫酒店都将为您提供便捷且舒适的住宿体验。万千枫景无限好，我们在海口等您！
hotels.descriptionEn: Fairfield by Marriott Haikou Meilan hotel is located in the government affairs center of Haikou Meilan District, with convenient transportation, about 13 km from Haikou Meilan International Airport, about 5.5 km from Haikou East Railway Station, about 5 km from Shophouse Old Street, about 2 km from Riyue Square Duty Free Shop, Suoluo Art Style Street business Circle is just 10 mintutes by feet; The residents' life  is rich,  original and simple ,Dady tea, Coconut chicken, the endless coconut forest , as traveling indifferent time and space. The quality of the hotel shows luxury and texture. The hall reprints the classic in the modern fusion, luxury stone and geometric simplicity collision;  The hotel's 105 exquisite rooms are equipped with 65-inch LEDTV, TOTO toilet, Moen thermostatic bathroom,  eco-friendly guest products, providing guests  a quiet and luxurious stay experience. All the partners of Hotel will accompany you to spend an unforgettable trip with sincere service.  Welcome to Hainan!

hotels.descriptionZh: 海口万豪酒店位于海口市美丽的西海岸，紧邻海南国际会展中心、五源河体育场、海口国际免税城、远大购物中心、海口火车站、新海港码头、五源河湿地公园、海南长影奇幻乐园及假日海滩，坐拥非凡的地理位置，凭海临风，拥有不同凡响的人文气韵。180°全海景超大阳台客房，可饱览海天一色迷人风景。东方韵味的海岸行宫，8栋中式宫殿式建筑组成，气魄恢宏，格调高迈，三进式大堂挑高20米，诠释中国传统文化沉淀之美。入住即可尊享国风旅拍，带您探究属于东方古典美学。大型生态泳池，成人泳池和儿童泳池、漂流河道兼具，6眼天然温泉采自1000米深层地下温泉水，另配备干湿蒸房、按摩池、健身房、水疗中心、棋牌室，为宾客提供多重休闲服务。酒店专为儿童开放室内儿童俱乐部和室外宠物喂养体验。椰叶编织、赶海捕蟹、自然美育、披萨制作等每日多项自然森活亲子活动等你解锁。酒店拥有完备的会议和宴会设施，大气磅礴的室内宴会厅和美丽优雅的户外草坪，总使用面积可达近4000平米。无论千人盛宴、大型会议和小型会议，亦或梦幻婚宴，均可满足需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Escape to a relaxing haven where azure waters and warm sandy beaches await your arrival at Haikou Marriott Hotel in China. Situated on a scenic shoreline, our spectacular hotel offers everything you can imagine in a beachfront getaway. Spend your days lounging on sun-soaked beaches, swim in one of our pools or indulge in spa treatments while your kids play in the Kids’ Club or swim in the dedicated children's pool. Or, explore Haikou's natural attractions and entertaining destinations located within minutes of our luxurious hotel. In the evening, dine in one of our delicious restaurants or retreat to spacious guest rooms with ocean views. If planning business events or social gatherings, take advantage of our hotel's stylish venue spaces and expansive seaside lawn. Business travelers will love our business facilities just steps away from the Hainan International Exhibition Center. Whatever your reason for visiting, we look forward to welcoming you to a memorable vacation at Haikou Marriott Hotel.

hotels.descriptionZh: 海南高尔夫酒店-海口万丽酒店,地理位置优越，环境优雅舒适，风格别致而富有创意妙趣。酒店拥有 283 间风格典雅的客房与套房，配备现代化设施及大理石浴室，点缀精致的设计元素，铺陈蓬松柔软的寝具，让您悠享时尚休闲时光。酒店餐厅环境宜人，全天供应当地精选美味佳肴，以及各式国际风味经典美食。酒店比邻众多热门打卡点，如电影公社、深圳免税海口观澜湖免税城。在波光粼粼的泳池中清爽畅游，或在优雅的逸庭酒吧 (R Bar) 享用手工调制的鸡尾酒，让轻松休闲的度假生活更添意趣。于热带海岛之上，邻观澜湖高尔夫球场而居，宁静悠然的氛围、经典风格及高雅品味交相互融，舒适惬意的度假村体验尽在此间。
hotels.descriptionEn: Where distinctive style flirts with touches of whimsy, Renaissance Haikou Hotel offers sophisticated comfort in a coveted location. Find a stylish respite at Renaissance golf resort, featuring 283 elegant rooms and suites, appointed with contemporary amenities, marble bathrooms, refined design elements and plush bedding. Ignite your senses with an all day selection of local tastes and treats, along with distinctive global favorites at our inviting hotel restaurants. Explore the area's compelling attractions including TIMESDF Haikou Mission Hills Duty Free Complex, Movie Town. Punctuate a relaxing day with a refreshing swim in our sparkling pool or hand crafted cocktails at our sophisticated R Bar. Located in Hainan, adjacent to Mission Hills Champion Golf Courses, Renaissance Haikou Hotel offers resort-style comfort where serenity intersects with timeless style and sophistication.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店的 291 间现代客房和套房采用舒适设计, 配备特色威斯汀天梦之床和天梦之浴设施, 着力缔造惬意休憩体验。酒店提供多种餐饮和娱乐选择, 供您随心探索。六间非凡的餐厅酒吧为您呈献富有创意的健康美食。宾客可在我们的室外泳池内清爽畅游。到我们的威斯汀 WORKOUT 健身馆挥汗锻炼, 畅享丰富的自由重量器械和有氧运动设备, 尽情焕发身心活力。为您的未来商务会议、婚礼或社交活动寻找灵感启迪。酒店拥有 11 处独立的会议和多功能空间以及一处大型迎宾区。总面积约 2,045 平米的会议区, 刷新您的会议标准。无论您因何旅行, 我们都将热诚欢迎您在海口威斯汀酒店度过难忘的假期。
hotels.descriptionEn: Each of our 291 contemporary guestrooms and suites have been designed with your comfort in mind, and all offer the signature Westin Heavenly Bed and the Heavenly Bath to let you get an amazing night’s rest. Our dining and entertainment options are yours to explore. Five exceptional restaurants and bars presents nourishing and imaginative menu creations. Guests can take a refreshing dip in our outdoor swimming pool. Recharge with a session on our Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio, complete with all your fitness requirements including free weights and cardio equipment. Find inspiration for your next business meeting, conference, wedding or social occasion. We offer eleven individual meeting and function spaces, as well as a large pre-function area. A total meeting area of 2,045 square meters will redefine your standards. Whatever your reason for visiting, we look forward to welcoming you to a memorable vacation at The Westin Haikou.

hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Haikou Hotel, a beachfront retreat 10 minutes from downtown and 40 minutes from the airport, blends convenience with luxury. The hotel features 341 elegantly appointed rooms with spacious work areas. Guests can unwind in natural hot spring pools fed from 700 meters underground, an outdoor pool, or enjoy water sports, a games room, basketball, and a fitness center.Dining options include authentic Cantonese at Jade, international cuisine at Breeze, curated wines at Pinot Noir Lounge, and ocean-view gatherings at &MORE by Sheraton. With over 1,300 sqm of event space including two pillarless ballrooms, it accommodates 10 to 600 guests. Perfectly located on the west coast, it’s an ideal choice for both leisure and business stays.

hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled in a beautiful community on Hainan Island, China, The Westin Blue Bay Resort & Spa is your gateway to a tropical-style paradise in Sanya. Hotel guests are steps from beachside activities, watersports and Jian Lake Blue Bay Golf Course, as well as minutes from the famous Nanwan Monkey Island and Lingshui railway station. Recharge in spacious hotel rooms and suites which feature Heavenly® Beds, rainforest showers, LCD TVs, large desks and free Wi-Fi. Every accommodation enjoys a balcony with an outdoor sofa and impressive views of the South China Sea. Take the plunge in our hotel's infinity pool, surf in the wave pool, work out in our gym or walk on our private beach. Get a healing massage at our Heavenly Spa by Westin™, sip cocktails at sunset on the terrace of the Lobby Lounge or savor the delicious cuisine at our three popular restaurants. Event planners will appreciate our sophisticated indoor venues and vibrantly green lawns. We look forward to welcoming you to The Westin Blue Bay Resort & Spa.

The Upper Room Restaurant & Bar, with elegant style, combines infinity sea views, food and live music.There are 10 multi-functional meeting spaces (total 2,700㎡) and an 8,800㎡ outdoor lawn, perfectly meeting the needs of team meetings and events.

hotels.descriptionEn: Discover incredible sunsets, spectacular tropical landscaping and pristine beaches at Renaissance Sanya Haitang Bay Resort a sophisticated hotel located at Haitang Bay on the South China Sea. Guest rooms offer breathtaking views, air conditioning, an inroom safe, an iPod docking system and deluxe bedding. From International and Chinese dining to seafood and burgers our restaurants provide the ideal atmosphere for meeting up with family or friends. Other amenities include a fitness center, a lagoon pool, a kids pool with slide, a kids club and recreational activities such as a bowling alley. Our event facilities are highlighted by an exquisite grand ballroom that accommodates more than 900 guests. Visit the world's largest duty free mall in Haitang Bay only a 10 minute drive away. When planning a family holiday, honeymoon or conference, our hotel will exceed your every expectation.

hotels.descriptionEn: Experience effortless service and smart solutions at Sheraton Sanya Haitang Bay Resort. Located on the beachfront at Haitang Bay, Sanya, our family-friendly resort provides a variety of hotel rooms and suites, all with private balconies or terraces, offering stunning garden or ocean views. All rooms feature stylish finishing touches to help you stay connected, such as flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. For those wishing to host a meeting or special event, our hotel has an array of inspiring spaces complete with smart technology and bespoke planning services to ensure a successful day.

hotels.descriptionZh: 三亚绿发山海天酒店·傲途格精选位于有中国“东方夏威夷”之称的海南岛大东海。大东海水清沙幼、风光秀丽，是紧邻市中心的热带天堂。酒店有着迷人以及别具一格前卫的设计，为宾客呈献一场别具特色的时尚创意盛宴。 靠近三亚市中心，位于宁静的海边，客人可在约60分钟内抵达大部分风景区。酒店拥有齐全，品质代表的设施，可满足各年龄段宾客的需求:户外泳池、The SPA Collection 水疗中心、健身中心 、儿童俱乐部和商务中心。客房由泰国知名设计事务所P49 Design & Associates担纲设计，以非凡时尚为灵感，借鉴当地知名设计师们常用的别具一格色调，荟萃意式优雅、法式时尚、英式华丽和美式经典四款鲜明风格，彰显四大设计之都的划时代美学。酒店设有199间客房和17间套房，面积从62平方米到348平方米不等，共有8种房型可供选择。房内浴室设有在窗边的浴缸并配有APPELLES卫浴套装；室内设有迷你酒吧。酒店设有礁、居、映、廊、聚五个用餐地点。酒店提供的服务设施包括：有线/无线高速上网的视听设备、专业的宴会/会议服务人员，以及婚礼策划专家团队。无论是商务之旅或休闲旅行，酒店都是您的理想下榻之选，让您尽享舒适、旅获精彩。
hotels.descriptionEn: Treat yourself to a stay on the stunning shores of the China Hawaii of the East at The Shanhaitian Resort Sanya Autograph Collection. Located on Hainan island our oceanfront hotel boasts views of pristine white sands, crystal clear waters and stunning tropical vistas from every window. Take just steps from our upscale accommodations to relax under the sun on Dadonghai Bay beach or drive just 5 minutes to entertaining attractions, fine dining and shopping in Sanyas city center. If relaxing at our hotel take the time to explore our deluxe amenities including a fitness center, multiple pools and full service spa. Dine in our popular hotel restaurants featuring freshly prepared cuisine or retire for the evening in modern guest rooms with sleek decor, plush bedding and complimentary WiFi. If planning events, you will appreciate our sophisticated venue spaces with state of the art technology and premium services. We look forward to welcoming you at The Shanhaitian Resort Sanya Autograph Collection.

hotels.descriptionZh: 三亚绿发山海天JW万豪酒店周边群山环绕，热带植物郁郁葱葱，坐拥壮丽的山峦和海洋美景,更可欣赏到唯美的日出景观。酒店地理位置得天独厚，驱车约10分钟即可达市中心，驱车约35分钟即可达三亚凤凰国际机场。酒店设有435间宽敞舒适的客房及套间。酒店会议设施设备齐全，会议区域面积达4,000平方米，其中包括一个916平方米的大宴会厅、1000平方米的海滨草坪、婚礼堂及多个小型会议厅和多功能厅。酒店拥有包括中餐、西餐及韩日式餐厅在内的三间餐厅，包含行政酒廊在内的四间酒吧酒廊及一间烘焙店，可为宾客提供丰富的餐饮体验。24小时开放的海景健身房、台球室、JW万豪水疗中心等为宾客提供舒适的休闲娱乐体验。此外酒店还设有2个室外泳池及室外面积达2850平方米的小龖人儿童乐园和室内面积700平方米的星奇宝贝儿童俱乐部令全家尽享各种乐趣。无论是休闲或商务之旅，酒店都是您的理想下榻之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Experience 5-star luxury in a prime Sanya location at JW Marriott Hotel Sanya Dadonghai Bay. Surrounded by lush tropical mountains and the ocean on Hainan Island, our resort offers spectacular sunrise and views, just moments from downtown shopping, dining and nightlife. Maritime Coral Reefs Natural Reserve adjoins our hotel. Settle into one of 435 modern hotel rooms in our West or East Tower, many with ocean views. Enjoy memorable dining experiences in JW Kitchen, Man Ho and Smoki Moto restaurants. Relax with express treatments or full-service indulgences in our luxurious Spa by JW. Take a dip in our two outdoor pools or workout in our modern 24-hour fitness center. Host a social or business gathering in our 10 sophisticated venues, including the largest ballroom in Dadonghai Bay. When you are ready to explore Sanya, visit Lu Hui Tou Mountain and Lu Hui Tou Park, or shop at City Center Mall and the China Duty-Free Shop nearby. An unrivaled resort destination experience awaits you at our 5-star Sanya hotel.

hotels.descriptionZh: 全家一起入住三亚喜来登度假酒店，尊享宁静的海岛逍遥游体验。这家尊尚度假酒店位于热门的海滨城市三亚，可俯瞰美丽的亚龙湾，服务体贴周到，让您尽情体验充实而清新的海岛之旅。客房宽敞舒适，提供豪华睡床、现代化的浴室和娱乐系统，可欣赏酒店及大海美景。从正宗的当地菜和粤菜到丰富多彩的国际及泛亚美食，这家位于三亚的尊尚度假酒店为家庭用餐提供理想的精致餐饮体验。设有两座恒温泳池、24 小时健身中心和私人度假酒店水疗中心，尽享休闲放松体验。我们的三亚酒店还提供一系列非凡的活动场地，从优雅的大宴会厅到美丽的荷园和僻静的海滩均一应俱全，是举办婚礼与私人聚会的理想之所。无论您到访三亚是为了浪漫逍遥游还是家庭度假，欢迎预订住宿三亚喜来登度假酒店，尊享超凡体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Enjoy a serene island getaway with the whole family at Sheraton Sanya Resort. Located in the popular seaside city of Sanya and overlooking gorgeous Yalong Bay, our 5 star resort offers all you need for a fulfilling, refreshing island visit. Spacious, comfortable accommodations offer plush beddings, modern bathrooms and entertainment systems and beautiful views of our hotel property and the sea. Choose from exquisite family-friendly dining options at our 5 star Sanya resort from authentic local and Cantonese fare, to dynamic international and pan Asian cuisines. Relax and unwind with our two heated pools, 24 hour fitness center and private resort spa. Our Sanya hotel also offers an extraordinary array of event venues ideal for weddings and private gatherings from our elegant Grand Ballroom venue to our lovely Lotus Garden and secluded beaches. Whether you're visiting Sanya for a romantic escape or a family vacation, reserve your stay at Sheraton Sanya Resort for an experience that goes beyond the ordinary.

hotels.descriptionZh: 在三亚亚龙湾瑞吉度假酒店，凝望波光粼粼的碧蓝海水、郁郁葱葱的棕榈树以及线条柔和的山丘，您很快便会发现自己置身于一片天堂之地。三亚位于海南岛南端，素有“东方夏威夷”之美誉。位于亚龙湾的瑞吉度假酒店被原始红树林保护区所环绕着，具有浓厚自然气息的迷人环境。宁静的海滩上设有多座泳池和一间酒廊，是您休闲放松的好去处。四间餐厅和一间酒吧，风味正宗，氛围休闲。酒店设有 396 间客房，其中包括 37 间套房和 28 座俯瞰亚龙湾的海滩别墅。铱瑞水疗中心雅致非凡，提供定制护理体验。瑞吉管家将为您提供完善的个性化服务，悉心为您解答所有疑问，竭力满足您在三亚期间的各种需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Gazing upon glistening blue waters, lush green palms and gentle mountainsides, you will soon discover that you have found a little piece of paradise at The St. Regis Sanya Yalong Bay Resort. As Hainan’s most southern tip, Sanya is often referred to as the “Hawaii of the East”. A marina and a protected mangrove forest surround the hotel, immersing you in natural beauty. Enjoy a dip in one of the pools.Culinary experiences await you in each of our three restaurants and two bars, with authentic flavors and relaxing ambiences. The hotel's 396 rooms include 38 suites and 28 beach villas overlooking Yalong Bay. Iridium Spa offers distinctive elegance, delivering customized experiences. St. Regis Butlers provide flawless, personalized attention during your stay in Sanya - offering one point of contact to answer all of your questions and meet all of your needs.

hotels.descriptionZh: 三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店于2020年年底焕新，坐落于亚龙湾延绵约7公里长的海岸线上，这里海清沙幼、椰影婆娑，生长着众多奇花异草和原始热带植被，酒店拥有452间豪华舒适的客房，辅以先进的空气净化处理技术保障宾客安心入住。在时尚简约的客房内，您可将亚龙湾的美景尽收眼底。您可徜徉于我们的洁白海滩，或漫步于10公顷的热带花园，任海风轻抚。三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店距离三亚凤凰国际机场约30分钟车程，距离亚龙湾火车站仅约10分钟车程；二个锦标赛级标准高尔夫球场与酒店仅是几步之遥。无论是在备受认可的日本料理餐厅享用地道美食还是在百幕大草坪散步，三亚亚龙湾万豪度假酒店定能让您收获精彩旅程。
hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled on a pristine sweeping crescent of white sand beach, encircled by rainforest and caressed by calm and crystal-clear waters, newly renovated in 2020, the Sanya Marriott Yalong Bay Resort and Spa offers 452 spacious, modern rooms and suites equipped with advanced air-purifier with elevated amenities and commanding views of the famous Yalong Bay, the mountains or the tropical gardens. Once in a lifetime memories happen at the elegant Ocean Front Wedding Chapel and meetings accommodating up to 900 attendees have every advantage for success. Numerous activities abound for families from our dedicated Kids Club, that newly renovated in July 2023, to beach days, multiple pools and more. Book a spa treatment to instill a sense of tranquility and restore balance. Dine onsite at our all-day restaurant or have a gourmet experience at Edogin. When you are seeking a true resort experience in China, the 5-star Sanya Marriott Yalong Bay Resort and Spa is the preferable choice for a safe and comfy pure beach holiday.

hotels.descriptionEn: Located on the beautiful cove - Festival Beach of Hainan’s Shenzhou Peninsula, our resort features a comfortable subtropical climate year-round. The hotel sits by the mountains and borders on the coastline, only steps away from the PGA Level golf course – The Dunes, designed by internationally-renowned Tom Weiskopf. Nearby, Shenzhou Beach Club, a one-stop premium water sport. They provide our guests with a comfortable resort with never-ending recreation and sports activities. Plus the fully equipped Kids Club ensures that children also have their fair share of good fun at the beach resorts. The Four Points by Sheraton resort in Greater China, Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhou Peninsula combines tropical gardens and integrates funky and contemporary styles to the architecture.

hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled on a 3-kilometer golden sandy beach, our resort welcomes guests to share a memorable vacation with us. Facing to the South China Sea, it features expansive garden architecture, 306 capacious and comfortable guest rooms and suites, all of which offer Smart TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, spacious bathrooms and private balconies with breathtaking ocean or garden views. With access to restaurants and bars, ranging from casual to fine dining, there are plenty of cuisines to explore. The beauty of our tropical surroundings inspires our indoor and outdoor function space. The hotel has totally over 900 square meters of function space including a 440 square meters Pillar-less Shenzhou Ballroom featuring State-of-the-art deco covers as well as 6 other variable-sized function rooms and a well-equipped Business Center. Moreover, for the fitness enthusiast, the 24-hour Sheraton Fitness programmed has been specially created to meet the guest’s needs for a simple yet effective solution to health and fitness.

hotels.descriptionZh: 探索美丽的石梅湾，尊享五星级酒店体验，欢迎入住石梅湾艾美度假酒店，这所拥有着优美景色的海南酒店位于万宁市东南部的石梅湾，坐拥 182 亩郁郁葱葱、精心修葺的美景，且距波光粼粼的中国南海仅咫尺之遥，毗邻诸多知名景点，是值得探索的海南度假酒店。作为一所五星级的万宁酒店，每间宽敞别墅都经过精心设计，配设可饱览海南风光的阳台，提供各类尊贵的礼遇服务。您可在此尊享五星级度假体验，包括四个餐厅和一个大堂吧、设备齐全的健身中心、标准的网球场、宁谧的水疗中心、两个室外游泳池以及各类丰富有趣的活动。这里不仅可满足您的度假需求，还有专业会议设施和工作人员为您服务，更是您举办海南商务会议和海景婚礼的心仪之地。
hotels.descriptionEn: Allow Le Méridien Shimei Bay Beach Resort & Spa to raise the bar for a 5-star hotel visit. We are ideally situated on Hainan Island, China's breathtaking Shimei Bay, southeast of Wanning. Our resort is set on 30 acres of lush, immaculately maintained landscape, steps away from the sparkling South China Sea and close to many notable attractions. Each of our spacious villas features exquisite design touches, a balcony with outstanding views of Hainan and a wealth of premium perks. You'll be thrilled with our hotel's 5-star amenities, which include private beach access, six first-class restaurant and bar options, a well-stocked fitness center, a tranquil spa, two outdoor pools and a host of exciting family activities and water sports. Select our hotel to host your business meeting or wedding here in Hainan, take advantage of versatile indoor-outdoor venues, an opulent ballroom and knowledgeable planning and catering teams. Discover your own version of paradise at Le Méridien Shimei Bay Beach Resort and Spa.

hotels.descriptionZh: 石梅湾威斯汀度假酒店是探索海南岛风景迷人的原始区域（包括酒店附近的青梅林）的理想下榻地点。酒店位于海南省东南岸万宁市新兴的石梅湾休闲区, 坐落在绵延约 6 公里的天然海滨之上, 地理位置便利。我们酒店是家庭逍遥游的理想下榻之地。您可以体验正宗中式待客之道，各种卓越设施营造出豪华氛围，让您尽情放松身心、恢复活力。酒店拥有 398 间装潢精美的客房、套房和 25 套别墅，置身其中，尽享舒适与优雅，忘却纷扰烦忧。
hotels.descriptionEn: The Westin Shimei Bay Resort is an excellent base to explore this fascinating unspoiled area of Hainan, including Vatica Mangachapoi Forest, adjacent to our resort. We are conveniently located on 6 kilometers of pristine beachfront in the emerging leisure area of Shimei Bay, Wanning, on Hainan’s south-east coastline. We are perfect for a family escape! Stay relaxed and revitalized in a luxurious ambiance with upscale amenities and authentic Chinese hospitality. Leave the world behind and surround yourself in the comfort and elegance of one of our 398 beautifully appointed guest rooms, suites and 25 villas.

hotels.descriptionZh: 厦门W酒店位于厦门的东部商圈（思明区）, 是一座非凡精彩的光色声影万花筒, 引领宾客探索“海上花园”的最新动态。286间时尚的客房与套房在W酒店品牌标志性的潮玩风趣性格之中融入福建当地文化, 繁华商圈的活力氛围与您只有咫尺之遥。旅行者可以在设施先进的FIT健身中心释放压力, 或者前往闲适自在的WET®碧波泳池纵情愉悦。1,000平方米的宴会厅为厦门各类隆重活动设定了华美的舞台。三间活力纷呈的餐厅与酒吧供应诱人的创新佳肴和丰富多样的饮品。五魁九里全日餐厅的互动式烹饪台现场烹调国际美食，潮堂悦境在时髦的环境中呈现酷感鸡尾酒和沁爽饮品，而在HEAT特色酒吧, 客人可以躺在热水浴池中品饮香槟, 沉浸在DJ打造的动感节拍之中。如果有任何其他需要, W酒店的“随时/随需®服务”将满足宾客的心愿。
hotels.descriptionEn: A brilliant kaleidoscope of sound and color in the heart of East Business District, W Xiamen celebrates WHAT’S NEW/NEXT in the ‘Garden by the Sea’. Stay close to downtown action at our 286 stylish guest rooms and suites mixing Fujian culture with W Hotels’ iconic tongue-in-cheek touches. Detox in our state-of-the-art FIT, then redox with a dip and sip in WET® the pool. The 1,000-square-meter Great Room sets the stage for epic events in downtown Xiamen. Three vibrant restaurants and bars captivate with innovative fare and eclectic beverage offerings. NINE’s interactive cooking stations serve up fresh international fare, SOUNDSCAPE mixes cool cocktails and refreshing brews in stylish surroundings, while destination bar HEAT serves Champagne in a hot tub and the latest DJ club anthems. For anything else, just ask Whatever/Whenever®.

hotels.descriptionZh: 厦门艾美酒店位于城市中山林公园内，坐落于广阔空间和葱郁植被间，为您打造都市便利和绿意避世的平衡休憩之所。酒店位于湖里区仙岳公园的迷人山坡之上，距厦门国际机场8.6公里以及国际邮轮码头（游客前往鼓浪屿）仅3.7公里，交通便利。酒店比邻海上世界（3.3公里）、屿见闽南（4公里）、东渡山海健康步道（3.8公里），轻松潮玩厦门地标。周末及节假日酒店还提供穿梭巴士服务，送宾客前往中山路、邮轮码头、海上世界等地。酒店四周环绕着茂密的山林及壮观优美的自然景观。在这里您可以回归自然，小憩休闲。在酒店旁的迷人山坡之上，精致典雅的双层别墅将为您带来舒适住宿。345间别致高雅的客房与套房包括13间各类别墅套房，一间一景一阳台，所有的房间都有面向山景或庭景的开放私人阳台。超过2000平方米的宴会及会议场地包含了大宴会厅在内的10个不同的会议室，850平方米的自然采光无立柱大宴会室顶高10米给您足够的空间和高度释放思想。酒店有各式餐厅及酒吧共三间，带您领略及发现非同凡响的各国佳肴。全日制新食谱西餐厅提供早餐、午餐、晚餐和小点，充满动感的现场烹饪台为您提供各国风情美食。时尚气派的中餐厅为您提供原汁原味的粤式精品，12间单独包房让您的用餐更具舒适性。北纬 24 大堂酒吧位于酒店正中央，充满浪漫情调，可在此尽享精致酒品和各式小点。厦门艾美酒店先进的设施设备还包括了艺术感十足的健身房，配备专业健身器械，室内温水游泳池，温水智能按摩池，水疗康体会所，户外儿童乐园，围绕着仙岳公园的慢跑及步道。厦门艾美酒店邀请您来探索！
hotels.descriptionEn: Surrounded by open spaces and lush manicured gardens and walkways, the low-rise hotel is nestled on the slope of Xianyue Hill. 8.6km from the airport and 3.7km from international cruise center. The hotel commands breathtaking views of the city skyline and the natural lush greenery. The hotel offers a wide range of recreational and culinary delights that include a heated indoor pool, steam/sauna, Gym Spa, outdoor kid playground and scenic jogging trails. Food and beverage selections include an International All-Day Dining and Le Mei, a Chinese restaurant serving Cantonese and regional favorites, Latitude 24 offers a vibrant venue to relax during the day and selections of international wines and cocktails. All guest rooms offer private balconies overlooking the Garden Courtyard or hillsides complemented by exclusive semi-detached villas adjacent to the hotel, villa rooms and suites are split level and with private patios and gardens offering extra privacy and space.

hotels.descriptionZh: 厦门集美喜来登大酒店坐落于集美CAZ中央活力区，毗邻海上自行车道，有“城市绿肺”美誉的杏林环湾绿道，是宾客探索集美人文风景的门户。酒店距厦门高崎国际机场或厦门北站约15分钟车程，距集美学村、厦门园林博览苑等景点约10分钟车程。酒店拥有370间设计精雅的客房和套房，临湖而居，可一览集美湾畔景观或城市景观。采用焕新设计的&More by Sheraton咖啡吧，食光全日餐厅，悦厨中餐厅、秘境酒吧，以及超过4,500平方米活动空间包括1,700平方米无柱大宴会厅，是庆祝生活中大小喜事的理想之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Grand Xiamen Jimei is nestled in a residential community and commercial center with stunning parks by the bay and a marine bicycle lane, is your gateway exploring Jimei heritage and attractions. It’s about 15 minutes’ drive from Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport and Xiamen North Railway station, and 10 minutes from Jimei School Village, Tan Kah Kee Memorial Museum and Horticulture Expo Garden. The hotel features 370 exquisitely designed guest rooms and suites with broad views, overlooking either the landscape of Jimei Bay or the cityscape. All guest rooms are equipped with facilities to help guests work conveniently and efficiently. The hotel boasts over 4,500 square meters of event space, including a grand ballroom of 1,700 square meters that can accommodate up to 1,600 people, a 600 square meters ballroom, an 840 square meters sky garden, 8 functional meeting room on the second floor to bring guests an extraordinary conference and event experience.

We know your stay here is more than just a trip—it’s an experience that propels you forward. Every corner of our hotel is designed to support your dynamic lifestyle, enabling you to be your best self.

hotels.descriptionZh: 在厦门泰地万豪酒店，我们的宗旨是让您的每一次商务旅行都轻松愉快，让您的每一次度假都终生难忘。无论因工作或娱乐来此，均可在本酒店获得您所需要的设施及服务，畅享舒适的高质量住宿体验。酒店地理位置优越，地处海沧区中央商务区，位于风景如画的海沧大道沿线，可一览海沧湾和鼓浪屿的优美全景。设施齐全的宽敞客房内均配有平面电视、办公桌和私人浴室齐全设施，更提供免费Wi-Fi，令您大获裨益。酒店内还提供多种餐饮选择，包括每日提供的欧式早餐、自助早餐以及各种当地美味佳肴。在闲暇时间，不妨利用酒店提供的各种设施休闲放松一番，例如健身中心和室内泳池。厦门泰地万豪酒店热诚期待您的光临。
hotels.descriptionEn: At Xiamen Marriott Hotel Haicang its our mission to make every business visit a pleasure and every vacation the trip of a lifetime. Whether you are in China for work or play, you’ll find that our hotel has what you need to facilitate a comfortable and high-quality stay. We are strategically located in the CBD area of Haicang District, along the picturesque promenade of Haicang Avenue, with spectacular views of Haicang Bay and Gulangyu Island. Take advantage of our spacious and amenity-filled guest rooms; each is equipped with a flat-screen TV, a desk, a private bathroom and complimentary WiFi access. We also feature several on-site dining options, including our daily continental and buffet-style breakfasts, which serves up a taste of tantalizing cuisine.  In your down time, you can explore the many facilities our hotel offers, including a fitness center and an indoor pool.  We look forward to your visit at Xiamen Marriott Hotel Haicang.

hotels.descriptionZh: Discover city center from Courtyard Xiamen Haicang. Directly attached to Marriott Hotel Haicang, we boast roomy ocean-view accommodation, a range of great dining options, a stylish lounge and 17,000 square feet of adaptable venue space.
hotels.descriptionEn: No matter your reason for visiting China, Courtyard Xiamen Haicang sets the stage for a memorable experience. Featuring a brand-new, state-of-the-art lobby and intuitive design, our hotel offers many creative spaces for working or relaxing. Unwind in your spacious, modern lodging, which provides helpful amenities like complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi access, a flat-screen TV, plush bedding, a mini-fridge and a well-lit workspace. In addition, most hotel rooms boast magnificent views of Xiamen city center and Haicang Bay. Keep in shape at our 24-hour fitness center, take a swim in our ocean-view infinity pool, sample the flavors of China at our terrific hotel restaurants or reconnect with friends, family or colleagues at our sophisticated lounge. Connected to Marriott Hotel Haicang, we're a superb choice for a business event here in Xiamen, China. Enjoy 17,000 square feet of venue space, a ballroom and on-site planning and catering. Courtyard Xiamen Haicang is committed to delivering an exceptional hotel stay.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎来到位于厦门滨海旅游浪漫线的厦门同安源宿酒店，尽享滨海旖旎风光，步行可达阳光小镇商业购物中心，紧邻BRT（快速公交）东亭站，距离厦门北站、高崎机场约12公里，距离集美学村、陈嘉庚纪念胜地约6.8公里，可便捷到达各大交通枢纽及旅游景点。漫步滨海彩虹跑道，赏绵延数十公里的壮美海岸线愉悦身心；探访集美学村，观闽南风情建筑，感受人文气息浓厚的钟灵毓秀之地；更有闽南古早美味让你大快朵颐。在这里，恣享欢乐时光。厦门同安源宿酒店拥有140间客房，房间内设有特色天梦之床、配备能源之星电器的厨房以及内设雨淋花洒与天然沐浴用品的水疗浴室，让你以活力满满的状态迎接每一天。灵活多变的人性化办公区配有超大办公桌、人体工学座椅以及便捷的电源与数据连接装置，可供你轻松处理商务事宜。此外，你还可观看86英寸纯平宽屏高清电视播放的节目，悠度惬意时光。源宿客房拥有超大空间和充足的自然光线，采用简约的设计风格，营造出活力四射的开放式环境。我们的客房不仅仅是供你进行思考、工作或社交的场所，更是您专享的自我生活空间。
hotels.descriptionEn: Inspired by Westin® Hotels & Resorts, Element Hotels encourages a sense of wellbeing through a nature-influenced environment. Intuitively constructed with an efficient use of space, and with a focus on sustainability, Element helps you stay connected, feel alive and balanced while you're away. Reflecting the smart design of urban residences, the flowing layouts of our guest rooms were created to maximize space and enable you to use the room in multiple ways. Wake up to our signature Rise complimentary breakfast, guests start the morning off right with healthful options including a hot item, fresh granola, whole fruits, premium coffee and more.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店位于福建省，从本土文化传统中汲取灵感，集当地丰厚悠远的茶文化、优雅的白鹭和自然美景等元素于一身。厦门万豪酒店及会议中心坐落于中国福建同安湾，内有众多卓越设施，提供非比寻常的服务，堪称商务休闲两相宜的上佳之选。住宿环境典雅精美，设有阳台，可饱览海景；住宿多样，可选择带有私人泳池和草坪的别墅。酒店餐厅采用周到入微的精致设计，内含私人餐饮空间，更有主厨为客人精心料理的地区菜肴、日式佳肴和国际美食。酒店拥有 4,000 平米左右精致优雅的活动空间，包括宴会厅和贵宾室。度假酒店设施包括健身中心、四个室内外泳池、水疗中心、网球场和保龄球馆。酒店还设有儿童俱乐部，提供众多活动，携带儿童出行的客人可在此尽享欢乐。搭乘附近的高铁和快速公交，轻松开启厦门探索之旅。酒店位于中国厦门，不论您为何而来，我们都期待为您缔造弥久难忘的非凡住宿体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Our hotel in Fujian province draws inspiration from its locale, incorporating elements of the area’s rich tea culture, elegant egrets and natural beauty. Xiamen Marriott Hotel & Conference Centre, set along Tong’an Bay in Fujian, China offers amenities that appeal to business and leisure travelers. Accommodations feature balconies and ocean views and include villas with private pools and lawns. Our hotel restaurants highlight regional, Japanese and international cuisines with an emphasis on private dining and thoughtful design. Our 4,000 square meters of sophisticated event space includes ballrooms and a VIP room. Resort amenities include a fitness center, four swimming pools. Families feel at home with the Kid’s Club, a cheerful space with special activities. Explore Xiamen easily via the nearby high-speed railway and Bus Rapid Transit. No matter what brings you here, we look forward to making your stay at our hotel in Xiamen, China truly memorable.

hotels.descriptionZh: 厦门万丽酒店毗邻厦门环东海域西海岸，坐拥优美迷人的海景、细腻柔软的白色沙滩。酒店的设计充分体现了厦门传统渔村文化的历史渊源。酒店将现代感和亲切感呈现在设计结构之中，并与当地自然环境融为一体。酒店拥有包括7栋豪华别墅在内的207间客房，所有客房均拥有宽敞私人阳台，可以远眺迷人的海景或直接步入环礁泳池。三间餐厅和一个酒吧，为宾客提供创新而丰富的用餐选择，满足宾客的味蕾享受。酒店同时配备会议活动空间和设施，其中包括两间面积分别为810平方米及360平方米的无柱式宴会厅，以及七个多功能会议室。酒店外绵延细软的白沙滩及绿意盎然的草坪，为宾客打造心仪的浪漫婚礼。不仅如此，酒店拥有五个不同主题的室外游池，一个室内恒温游池以及特别设计的儿童乐园，为宾客打造出活力惬意的亲水度假方式，更为亲子出行增添欢乐时光。
hotels.descriptionEn: Overlooking Tongan Bay and set along the Huandong West coastline, the Renaissance Xiamen Hotel honors the local fishing heritage through striking design. Sail-inspired installations, colors and patterns that borrow from the ocean and a playful interaction of light and shadow are reflections of the true source of beauty: the sea itself. The water can be admired from nearly every space in the hotel. Accommodations offer views from private balconies and bathtubs; floor-to-ceiling windows capture diners’ attention at R Bar while Waterfront restaurant places guests right on the shore; and the fitness center inspires guest to push themselves harder with the promise of a refreshing dip in full view. The sea is not the only place for respite: there are six swimming pools including five outdoors with distinct themes. Shopping and a cinema are also nearby. The colorful seafront setting lends itself to weddings and events and the hotel offers nine beautifully designed venues including two pillar-free ballrooms.

hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Xiamen Hotel has a convenient location, at the heart of the citys business, retail and commercial hub makes it the ideal place from which to discover the fascinating surroundings and beyond, no matter what the guest’s agenda. This contemporary hotel is less than a 15 minute drive from Xiamen International Airport and Xiamen Railway Station. The ferry to the charming Gulangyu island is only 20 minutes away. Its proximity to major attractions and transportation links means less time traveling and more time enjoying the sights and sounds of this exciting coastal region. Retreat to the 358 guest rooms, each created for a wonderful night or day in with High Speed Internet Access, direct dialing, wide selection of local and foreign channels, room service and the famous Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. The hotel features a 600 sqm ballroom and five additional meeting rooms. All function rooms are located on the fifth floor.

hotels.descriptionZh: The hotel is located in Jinan, the "City of Springs," and features 218 well-appointed guestrooms with diverse styles. Combined with its distinctive dining services, it offers guests a high-quality hospitality experience.
hotels.descriptionEn: Inspired by the "elegance of the Spring City and the vitality of modernity," the Four Points by Sheraton Jinan High-Tech Zone,dedicated to offering business and leisure travelers a delightful experience that combines humanistic warmth with contemporary style. Nestled in the heart of Jinan’s eastern new urban center, the hotel boasts convenient transportation, with just 30-minute drive to iconic attractions like Baotu Spring and Daming Lake. Its proximity to the Olympic Sports Center and the central business district makes it an ideal starting point for exploring the "mountain-water-spring city."The 218 guest rooms embody the "Ink-Wash Spring Rhyme" design theme, artfully integrating Jinan’s spring water elements with an industrial modern aesthetic. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer stunning views of the high-tech zone’s glittering skyline, while the interplay of wood textures and metallic lines within the rooms echoes the timeless dialogue between the old city’s cobblestone paths and modern skyscrapers.

hotels.descriptionZh: 济南喜来登酒店坐落于济南中央商务区核心地带，地理位置非常优越，步行可达奥体中心，周边配套齐全包括万象城、融创茂、山东博物馆及美术馆，是商务出行与休闲度假的理想之选。酒店拥有410间客房，包括48平方米的宽敞客房与96平方米的豪华套房。每间房均配备甜梦之床、干湿分离卫浴及浴缸，全景落地窗可尽览璀璨灯光秀。您亦可在22楼行政酒廊享受欢乐时光的同时俯瞰“泉城”繁华城景。酒店设有室内外双泳池、24小时健身中心以及一个静谧户外草坪让您畅享休闲时光。更有正宗中餐、豪华自助餐与精致日料等多元餐饮选择。1200平方米无柱大宴会厅及灵活多变的多功能厅，是您举办会议、婚礼及各类活动的优选之地。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Jinan Hotel is located in Jinan’s CBD, within walking distance of the Olympic Sports Center and surrounded by MixC, Sunac Land, Shandong Museum and Art Museum – ideal for both executive retreats and leisure travelers. The hotel offers 410 rooms, including 48 sqm spacious guest rooms and 96 sqm luxuriously appointed suites. All feature the Sweet Sleeper™ bed, a separate wet‑dry bathroom with bathtub, and floor‑to‑ceiling windows showcasing stunning light shows. You can also unwind with happy hour at the 22nd floor Executive' Lounge, overlooking the vibrant cityscape. Unique highlights include indoor and outdoor pools, a 24‑hour fitness center and a tranquil outdoor lawn. Savor an array of culinary delights, including authentic Chinese cuisine, sumptuous buffets and refined Japanese fare. A 1,200 sqm grand ballroom and versatile function rooms make it a premier venue for conferences, weddings and special events in Jinan.

hotels.descriptionZh: 青岛北岸瑞明福朋喜来登酒店坐落于城阳核心区域，以现代工业风融合海洋灵感设计，打造出一处远眺尘嚣、拥抱灵感的理想下榻地。酒店拥有198间舒适雅致的客房，不仅是探索青岛的绝佳起点，更是一家欢迎宠物同住的友好型酒店。客房内特设贴心的宠物设施，确保您与毛茸家人共度温暖舒适的旅居时光。酒店内的「醇饮优享」餐厅是品味啤酒艺术的绝佳空间，提供金黄透亮的黄啤、醇厚丝滑的黑啤、清新爽润的白啤以及品牌特色精酿，每一杯都蕴藏着青岛百年的酿造灵魂。酒店周边体验丰富多元：信步可达的青岛网红吕家庄夜市，灯火流转，人声鼎沸，弥漫着市井的烟火气；毗邻的国学公园清幽宁静，是与爱宠散步嬉戏的理想场所；与家人探访城阳博物馆，可感受千年文脉的沉淀；驱车片刻即可抵达崂山北九水，置身于山水画卷，欣赏碧波映天的自然诗意。夏秋之际，还可前往城阳乡野葡萄园，体验采摘之乐，共赏田园晚照。在这里，啤酒氤氲、宠物随行、人文与自然和谐相融，诚邀您写入一段属于青岛的诗意旅途记忆。
hotels.descriptionEn: The FOUR POINTS BY SHERATON QINGDAO, CHENGYANG EAST is located in the central of Chengyang Distict, which is designed blends modern industrial and nautical that create an ideal place to stay away from the bustle and embrace inspiration.Hotel Features 198 comfortable and elegant guest rooms, a self-service laundry room and a 24-hour fitness center. It is an excellent starting point for exploring Qingdao.The Mesh presents handmade craft beer with its "best brew".The hotel has nearly 1,000 square meters of event space. The pillarless grand ballroom with area of 508 square meters and 3 multi-function rooms can adapt to event needs of different scales. The hotel is also surrounded by a rich and diverse range of destination experiences. Such as Lujiazhuang Night Market, Chinese Culture Park, Chengyang Museum, and Laoshan North Nine Water scenic area.

hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel offers well appointed rooms with air conditioning and a flat screen TV. Guests can unwind with massage treatments, work out at the gym or practice a swing at the tennis court. The property is 100 meters from Qingdao Baolong City Plaza and 600 meters from Century Park. hotels.descriptionZh: 青岛福楼安可·傲途格精选坐落于青岛市崂山区海龙路12号，依循山前海后的自然脉络，以环形围合的楼体，北高南低顺势而筑，在总建筑面积约20000㎡空间里践行全然·无双的美学哲思。步入酒店大堂，跃然而起的鲸尾艺术品打破陆海边界，与流动的音乐设计文化共同谱写空间即兴乐章。135间复古艺术风格的客房将浮山岚色与岛城街景框成四季变化的立体画作，海洋风格与创新布置交相互融散发独特魅力，配备席梦思甜梦系列床垫、马歇尔音响及特色MINIBAR等设施，带给您非同凡响的住宿体验。茂茂餐厅（THE MOSS），展示西方地道经典的多元化食谱，用新鲜风味解锁社交关系。800平方米的舒适灵活会议空间衔接中庭花园，使商务活动亦能沐浴自然光影，重新定义工作与品味生活。Muscle Bay以1200平方米专业空间打造活力健身聚集地：泳池采用水立方同款硅藻土反渗透过滤系统；集结悍马、力健全套进口设备，配备乔山系列器械，以人体工程学设计精准锻造每寸肌肉，独立普拉提私教区引进美国原装设备，优雅私密的健身环境，独立的锻炼区域营造宁静专注氛围，助力您放松身心、重焕活力。青岛福楼安可·傲途格精选以“全然・无双”的哲学静候每一位旅行者书写属于自己的海洋章节。
hotels.descriptionEn: The Hotel occupies an area of around 20,000 square meters and boasts an enclosed and north-to-south-downwards-sloped building inspired by the nature force. The Moss restaurant showcases diverse Western classic recipes, unlocking social relationships with fresh flavors.The thoughtfully designed garden and atrium embody the concept of natural laws. Muscle Bay, with 1,200 square meters of professional space, creates a vibrant fitness gathering place: the swimming pool uses the same water cube silicon dioxide reverse osmosis filtration system; it gathers Hummer and Lifefitness imported equipment, and is equipped with the Johnson series of equipment.The independent Pilates private training area introduces American original equipment, creating an elegant and private fitness environment.Elements of ocean and music are intertwined to evoke an 'Exactly Like Nothing Else' style, creating an ideal open space for visitors and residents to explore, share and interact.

hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled within Qingdao's up and coming business district, just ten minutes away from premier tourist attractions, lies Le Meridien Qingdao, a 5-star destination brimming with style. Sleek and sophisticated, our Shandong hotel offers guests everything they need to enjoy a relaxing, productive and successful visit. Find tranquility in our contemporary accommodations, which boast plush bedding, rainforest showers, high-speed Wi-Fi and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city. Reboot and recharge at our on-site fitness center, replete with a heated indoor swimming pool. For those seeking a rejuvenating massage after a day of travel to Qingdao, visit SPA, our hotel's signature wellness destination. Sip and savor at our chic dining destinations, serving everything from buffet-style fare to authentic Chinese specialties. An ideal events destination in Shandong, our hotel also features an array of unique venues, enhanced by cutting-edge amenities and thoughtful service.

hotels.descriptionEn: Renaissance Qingdao Hotel is a key point on the coastal urban image belt. It's a 25-minute drive from Qingdaobei Railway Station and 40 minutes from Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport. The hotel features 279 guest rooms, the design inspiration is drawn from Qingdao’s unique “city imprints” such as old houses, beer culture, Badaguan, and the architectural complex of various countries. At Food Studio all-day dining restaurant,  enjoy a variety of international cuisine. At Shao Wu Chinese restaurant, become a connoisseur of Cantonese and Shandong cuisine. Join us at "R Bar" to enjoy the Evenings at Renaissance amidst clinking glasses. The Executive Lounge provides a chic nightlife experience the indoor pool, the fitness center, or gaze at the city skyline from the Sky bar viewing terrace.with over 1,200 square meters of the JinMao Grand Ballroom, the 1000 square meters outdoor lawn, provide distinctive venues for  corporate events or fantastic weddings. and an immersive experience to your grand occasions.

It embraces the Element brand's eco-friendly philosophy, creating a natural, organic, comfortable, and vibrant lifestyle for its guests. Inspired by the design stories of the Seed Apocalypse, Life Experience Pavilion, and Midsummer Night's Dream, the hotel offers guests a unique spatial experience. The hotel features 210 rooms, providing well-equipped, comfortable, and natural living spaces, making it an ideal choice for leisure vacations and business trips. Additionally, the E-SPACE, RISE&RELAX-BAR LOUNGE, RISE&RELAX, FUN ORIGINES, and ELEMENT GARDEN offer multifunctional spaces for guests to share experiences with family and friends.

hotels.descriptionEn: The St. Regis Qingdao dwells in the iconic building - Haitian Center, a tower of 369 m in Shinan District, Qingdao. hotels.descriptionZh: 青岛威斯汀酒店是一家注重健康的酒店，地处这座中国高速发展城市的优越位置，提供时尚现代的住宿环境和美味可口的特色佳肴。步入简洁清新的客房和套房，享受充满活力的住宿体验，在耸入云霄的酒店客房内饱览青岛市中心美景。欢迎前往酒店餐厅，乐享风味正宗的健康餐饮体验，从新鲜海鲜和传统中餐，到自助早餐现场烹饪台美食，品类非常丰富。酒店设有室内恒温泳池和威斯汀健身馆，助您在旅途中保持更佳健康状态。作为猫途鹰年度卓越奖入选单位，我们的酒店坐拥市中心优越位置，毗邻青岛海边，距离五四广场和奥帆中心等知名景点仅数分钟路程，提供逾 2000 平米雅致活动场地，是举办婚礼、会议和会展活动的理想之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Rise above the fray and find all you need for an empowering stay in Qingdao China. The Westin Qingdao is a wellness focused hotel with modern accommodations, delicious dining and a convenient location in the urban center of one of China's fast rising cities. Step into intuitive rooms and suites designed to keep you fresh and energized during your stay and inspired by our high-rise hotel's soaring views of the Qingdao city center. Enjoy healthful, authentic dining at our hotel restaurants, from fresh seafood and traditional Chinese to live cooking stations at our breakfast buffet. Enhance your well being in Qingdao, China by visiting our heated indoor pool or WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio. Our hotel, winner of Trip Advisor's Certificate of Excellence, offers over 2,000 square meter of elegant, chic event venues ideal for weddings, meetings or MICE events all with a city center location just minutes from Qingdao sights like May Fourth Square and the Olympic Sailing Center.

hotels.name: 青岛西海岸隆和艾美酒店

hotels.descriptionZh: 青岛西海岸隆和艾美度假酒店拥有217间设计精巧的绝妙客房，套房以及总统套房。 酒店的室内设计风格是以“度假”为导向的，同样也可作为商务酒店来承接各类公司活动及会议，二者相辅相成。无论是对于来此度假的人们而言还是商旅客人和企业高管，成年人还是青少年，外国宾客还是本地旅客，它都是多元化的且舒适的上佳居所。整体设计理念以及灵感源于中国的黄海以及它独具特色的海洋生物。酒店的户外整体设计布局与超凡的地理位置优势相融合-坐拥青岛西海岸国家第九个经济开发区，而呈现了别致的现代建筑风尚格调。酒店的室内设计共由三个主题区域构成，分别为: “海滩” “浅海”以及“深海”。设计灵感除海洋元素外，也充分融合了来自三个文化领域的精湛设计，包含来自东方世界的文化气息，西方的欧式文化设计底蕴以及地道的中东风情，为酒店的宾客们带来一种上岸后即可感受到全世界的文化冲击探索体验。来自东方世界的文化气息由乐美中餐厅的设计陈列以及装饰布局而体现的淋漓尽致，通过整体设计陈列，中国牡丹花卉艺术墙，传统的包房标识式样以及各种各样的东方设计元素而不断的诠释着来自东方世界博大精深的丰厚文化底蕴。 拥有现代西方经典设计的宴会厅和会议室区域充分体现出西方世界的欧式别致风格，通过打造欧式的现代灯光美学，优质的理石花纹地毯以及优雅的现代暖灰色调 ，为宾客们展现出来自西方现代世界的瑰丽文化与魅力艺术。 泳池的精巧设计为您呈现别样的中东风情文化精髓，通过标志性的中东风情亭台以及巧夺天工的异域格调花纹为您揭开神秘的中东文化探索之旅。
hotels.descriptionEn: Situated on one of Qingdao's beaches, Le Méridien Qingdao West Coast Resort is a sea-side sanctuary in a stunning travel destination. Experience a refreshing retreat in stylish hotel accommodations with views of the sparkling sea and majestic mountains and revitalizing amenities such as our signature LMBED, freestanding soaking bathtubs and oversized walk-in showers. Ignite your senses with three distinct dining venues, enhanced by show kitchens and live cooking stations. Elevate your stay in China with thoughtful resort features including direct beach access, a sparkling indoor pool, a well-equipped fitness centre and our Le Méridien Kids Club. Celebrate and succeed in more than 2,900-square-meters of European-inspired function space, including our Grand Ballroom.  Just steps from the beach, near Mt. Dazhu and the two-thousand-year-old Langyatai, Le Méridien Qingdao West Coast Resort is a rejuvenating haven designed for today's creative and inspired traveler.

hotels.descriptionEn: Experience comfort, style and superb service at Four Points By Sheraton Qingdao, West Coast. Ideally located on the outstanding beach of Lingshan Bay, in Qingdao, China, our modern hotel boasts dazzling ocean views and a unique atmosphere. After a long day of work or play, relax in your spacious, meticulously decorated guest room, fully equipped with a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi and more. Whether you are visiting for business or leisure, our Qingdao hotel has what needed to make your stay as comfortable as possible.

hotels.descriptionEn: Located near the beach in the West Coast New Area, The Westin Qingdao West Coast welcomes guests traveling in China with caring service and thoughtful amenities. Recharge in our modern hotel rooms and suites which feature Heavenly® Beds, Heavenly® Showers and Heavenly® Baths. Relax while watching your favorite programming on the flat-screen TV, and stay connected using the ergonomic workstations and complimentary Wi-Fi. Suites enjoy separate living spaces and Club access. Take advantage of our state-of-the-art fitness center, gear lending program and indoor pool. Sample the delicious cuisine in the hotel's innovative restaurants before exploring the lush local scenery and attractions, including Dazhu Mountain and Tangdao Bay. For those planning events, our hotel has more than 56,000 square feet of sophisticated event space, ideal for the MICE market, trade shows and social celebrations. The property sits adjacent to Qingdao World Expo City and is part of the modern convention complex in Qingdao.

Whether you are in China for business or leisure our hotel welcomes you to Qingdaos vibrant west coast with exquisitely appointed, spacious guest rooms, an abundance of premium onsite amenities and a pristine location in Huangdao just a short distance from many celebrated attractions. Each of our 350 hotel rooms and suites provides floor to ceiling windows and picturesque views of the sea as well as a vast range of great perks. Sample the diverse flavors of China at our signature restaurant, or stop by our eclectic international buffet before exploring Qingdao. We also feature a light filled lobby lounge with panoramic sea views, a 24 hour fitness center and a heated indoor pool. Boasting 40,000 square feet of flexible, well designed event space including a pillarless Grand Ballroom, we are an ideal venue for a business meeting or social gathering here in Qingdao China. A sensational stay awaits you at Sheraton Qingdao West Coast.

hotels.descriptionEn: JW Marriott Qufu Luneng is the largest JW Marriott brand resort hotel in China. Upholding its brand values, the JW Marriott Hotel Qufu offers seamless, anticipatory service alongside carefully orchestrated experiences and culturally rooted dining. Accommodations offer outdoor space, Chinese-inspired décor and state-of-the-art bathroom features. Natural light streams over the indoor heated pool through a domed ceiling, and the fitness center and spa services encourage wellness and relaxation. Formal gatherings can be hosted in the private dining rooms at JW Kitchen and Residence, the hotel’s two restaurants, or within the 800 square meters. ballroom featuring a massive HD LED screen, professional spotlights and an adjoining foyer. For casual get-togethers or down time, The Lounge offers an extensive beverage menu and weekly activities, and the Tea Library highlights international teas, tea-inspired beverages and tempting desserts. Next door, explore the World Heritage Confucius Temple and Confucius Mansion.

hotels.descriptionEn: Designed in the chicest style with sophisticated décor, the 5-star Sheraton Yantai Golden Beach Resort showcases stunning ocean-view accommodation, ample conference facilities and world-class cuisine. All of our 350 hotel rooms and suites feature inspiring sea views and intuitive amenities including high-speed internet access and the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience. Our three distinguished restaurants offer Chinese, Japanese and global fare; a lively lounge bar serves craft cocktails and light bites. Additional hotel facilities include a modern fitness center, an indoor heated pool and tennis courts. Seven multi-functional conference rooms and ballrooms provide a memorable backdrop for events of up to 900 guests; business-friendly services include a shuttle to and from the airport. Whether you're in China for business or leisure, you'll find Sheraton Yantai Golden Beach Resort to be the perfect place for your retreat.

hotels.descriptionEn: Located on the coast of Shandong China in the YEDA zone the newly opened Yantai Marriott Hotel offers warm service, stunning views and elegant finishing touches. Our modern hotel offers a variety of accommodation featuring stunning sea or garden views, plush bedding, complimentary amenities and WiFi. Those looking to host a business meeting or special occasion in Yantai China, can hire one of our versatile venues, including large picturesque lawn, meeting rooms and sea-view grand ballroom with floor-to-ceiling windows to enjoy natural lighting. For relaxation unwind in our hotel's 24-hour fitness center, enjoy time in our heated indoor pool or visit some of the nearby sights in Yantai such as Changyu Castle. Visitors have an array of dining options to choose from, including Chinese and international restaurants, as well as room service. Additional hotel facilities include valet dry-cleaning, car rental and foreign exchange.

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Yantai takes "creating a better life" as its goal, is Sophisticated retro, relaxed and comfortable, and is committed to becoming a practitioner and leader in building "a better life". It offers a column-free luxury banquet hall with a spacious high ceiling, suitable for large conferences, high-end weddings, and brand launch events. Various themed restaurants offer a variety of Chinese and Western cuisines to meet diverse dining needs. Leveraging international brand standards and attentive service, the hotel fully caters to business travel, leisure vacations, banquets, and gatherings.

hotels.descriptionZh: 淄博喜来登酒店位于张店市中心，毗邻万象汇购物中心，地理位置优越，交通便利，距淄博火车站约10分钟车程，济南遥墙机场约90分钟车程；邻近主要旅游景点，步行5分钟即可到达八大局市场；距淄博陶瓷博物馆约3公里，距齐盛湖海岱楼钟书阁约12公里，距周村古商城约20公里，距齐文化博物馆约30公里。淄博是齐国故都、陶瓷名城，也是世界足球（蹴鞠）发源地，位于酒店2楼的文化长廊，将齐文化精髓淋漓展现。在这里，您可以欣赏到春秋战国时期的出土文物照片，如西周青铜鼎、春秋时期的人形足铜墩等，也可以领略古代齐都的辉煌，探索追溯齐都3000多年前的历史。酒店二楼盛宴自助餐厅汇聚100多种风味美食，海鲜刺身、中西热菜、手工甜品一应俱全，酒水饮品畅饮不限量，晚餐更配有外籍乐队为现场燃情助兴；二楼采悦轩中餐厅设私密包间，主打传统博山菜，涵盖博山脆皮硬炸肉，精葱烧鲍鱼，宫保虾球等，开放式厨房现点现做、食材新鲜、色香味俱全。酒店高达180米，拥有270间豪华客房及套房，以及超过2,356平方米的大型宴会及多功能会议厅。1,100平方米的无柱式豪华大宴会厅及8个多功能会议厅，配备先进的视听音响设备和无线会议设施，是举办大型婚宴、时尚盛会、商务会议以及婚宴的理想之选。为满足宾客对健身娱乐的需求，酒店配备多样的健身娱乐设施，帮助宾客在一天的高效工作之后放松和恢复元气。酒店设有商务中心、免费停车场等便利设施方便您的商务及私人出行。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Zibo Hotel is located in the city center adjacent to the MixC shopping center , prime location and convenient transportation, 10 minutes drive to Zibo Railway Station，90 minutes to Jinan Yaogiang Airport. About 5-minute walk to the Badaju Market, approximately 3 km from the Zibo Ceramics Museum, about 20 km from Zhoucun Ancient City and 30 km from Qi Heritage Museum, Hotel 2nd floor offering guests easy access to explore Zibo‘s rich historical and cultural attractions. Here you will find a collection of photos featuring unearthed cultural relics like the photo of bronze ding from Wertern Zhou, the photo of Bronze dui from Spring and Autumn Period.Through these images, you can appreciate the glory of the ancient Qi capital and explore the history dating back over 3,000 years ago.

hotels.descriptionZh: 汉中滨江福朋喜来登酒店坐落于汉江之滨，依偎滨江生态景观带，将 “汉家发祥地” 的文化底蕴与福朋喜来登的国际品质巧妙相融，成为衔接城市自然与人文的高端旅居地标。酒店延续品牌标志性的醇饮优选，特别甄选陕南本地精酿啤酒、汉中仙毫等特色茶饮，搭配融合热面皮、褒河鱼鲜、核桃馍等本地风味的精致餐饮，让味蕾沉浸式感受陕南烟火。空间设计萃取汉江流水、汉隶书法等元素，公区陈列的本地非遗手工艺品与客房的舒适配置相得益彰，尽显 “汉风雅致” 的质感美学。全覆盖免费高速 Wi-Fi、灵活多元的会议场地，满足商务出行与休闲度假的双重需求。从酒店出发，便捷可达古汉台、石门栈道、武侯祠等文化地标，步行即可漫步滨江绿道，沉浸式体验 “天府之国” 的自然灵秀与历史厚重。我们以真诚待客之道，将国际标准服务与汉中本地特色深度融合，为每一位旅人打造 “居汉江之畔，品汉家风情” 的高品质旅居体验，成为汉江之滨传递汉风魅力的温暖驿站。
hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西安W酒店以现代设计视角诠释古都新韵，约10万平方米体量成为城市时尚地标。从盛唐文化中提炼灵感，通过先锋艺术手法与西安历史文脉交织，营造充满张力的沉浸式体验。372间客房及套房位于酒店5至26层。细节处皆融合当代美学与长安古韵。大胆的色彩碰撞与定制艺术品编织出充满想象力的旅居叙事。三处独具个性的餐厅与酒吧：全味餐厅、飨艳中餐厅及WOOBAR酒吧，从环球美馔到夜幕降临时分的创意调酒，打造兼具私密性与社交感的味觉之旅。2,330平方米风华厅，1,128平方米风尚厅以及不同规格的会议室，无论是商务活动、品牌发布或婚宴庆典，皆可在此实现精准而富有格调的呈现。AWAY®水疗以五感疗愈重塑身心平衡，WET®碧波泳池化身都市绿洲。配备高端器材的FIT有型健身中心与WIRED商务空间，打造潮奢生活方式。
hotels.descriptionEn: Rising from the edge of the storied Qujiangchi Lake, W Xi’an dares to disrupt the ancient rhythm of the city with a fresh beat of style, energy, and indulgence. Spanning over 100,000 square meters and crowned with a soaring 17-meter-high Living Room, this is where the unexpected comes to play.With 372 stylish guestrooms and suites from the 5th to 26th floor, every room features a spacious private balcony — your personal perch to soak in panoramic views.Fuel your cravings at three dining destinations —— WEI, YEN Chinese Restaurant and WOOBAR®, each serving up bold flavors and vibrant vibes. Then, take the plunge in the indoor/outdoor WET®, push limits at FIT, and surrender to the scene-stealing AWAY® Spa for that glow-up moment.Craving a show-stopping backdrop? From lavish weddings to next-level launches, our Great Room, Mega Room, Studios, and Strategy spaces are anything but business as usual.W Xi’an: live it up lakeside, and let the city’s pulse match yours.

hotels.descriptionEn: Unlock the opportunities that await you at Le Méridien Xi’an Chanba. Conveniently located next to the river in the city's ecological district, our hotel is the ideal choice for curious guests seeking a truly unique experience. Many of Xi'an's noteworthy points of interest are within reach - from Drum Tower Square to Big Wild Goose Pagoda and Xi'an City Wall. Enjoy the many amenities our hotel offers, including an indoor pool, a fitness center and a children’s play center. Comfortable guest rooms and suites feature complimentary Wi-Fi, ultra-plush bedding, premium bath amenities and room service - as well as river views from the bathtub. Sample Chinese, Hot Pot and other global specialties at one of our three restaurants during your stay. Guests who host an event here will be thrilled with our gracefully appointed, light-filled venues and an outdoor lawn boasting scenic river vistas. Whether traveling for business or leisure, Le Méridien Xi'an, Chanba has everything you need to make your stay perfect.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西安蓝海风万怡酒店，作为古城西安万豪旗下万怡品牌，以其睿智活力的品牌文化，现代简约的品质设计，细致周到的人性化服务，为商务人士和城市旅行家提供舒畅的商务旅行新体验。酒店拥有各式豪华客房及套房共262间。每一间豪华客房均拥有明亮的观景落地窗，任宾客饱览城市美景。酒店开放式餐饮将为宾客提供全新美食体验，不论是将设计功能与现代艺术相互融合的酒店大堂吧，还是将国际美食与本地佳肴自如切换的万荟轩，西安蓝海风万怡酒店为商务人士和旅行家们提供一个集城市休闲与商务出行为一体的非凡场所。此外，酒店800平方米无柱式大宴会厅及六个多功能厅将全方位满足客人不同的宴会需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard by Marriott Xi'an North, making the brand’s first hotel in Xi'an, features the brand’s vibrant culture, modern design and personalized service, which provide business and leisure travelers with a truly refreshing experience. The hotel is located on 2nd Fengcheng Road, within a 25-minute drive from Xi'an Xianyang International Airport, a 15-minute drive from Xi’an North Railway Station and Xi’an Railway Station, as well as a short walking distance to the metro station. Guest rooms are modern, both in their décor and their amenities, including free Wi-Fi and a large-screen HDTV. Hotel restaurants offer a mix to match your mood with private dining, international buffets, grab-and-go fare and cocktails. Meeting and event space totals nearly 13,000 sq. ft. and includes a large, pillar-free ballroom ideal for all-day conferences.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西安赛瑞喜来登大酒店（城北），位于西安市未央路迎宾大道32号，地铁2号线龙首原站近在咫尺，乘地铁仅约20分钟至高铁北客站。约5分钟可步行至大明宫国家遗址公园。酒店毗邻西安城北经济技术开发区，距西安咸阳国际机场仅约40分钟车程，乘坐地铁可轻松抵达钟楼、回民街等城市热门景点。酒店拥有487间别具魅力的客房和套房，包括27间服务式复式公寓；3个风格各异的风味餐厅及时尚酒廊将满足客人不同的口味和环境需求；近1800平方米的宴会厅包括一个626平方米的麟德大宴会厅，10个会议室及独立的会议接待区域，可轻松容纳1200人；拥有室内恒温游泳池、健身中心以及炫逸水疗。完善别具一格的客房设施及高品质的服务水平，无论是休闲度假或是商务旅行，这里都将成为你的倾心之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Xi’an North City Hotel, the second Sheraton and modern upscale hotel in this ancient city of China, is located in downtown district, near the municipal administrative region. Our 5-star hotel is within 17 minutes to the main railway station, 20 minutes to the North Station by subway, 40 minutes to the airport, 20 minutes to downtown and walking distance to the beloved Daming Palace National Heritage Park. Our stylish Xi'an hotel features 487 comfortably-appointed guest rooms and suites, three restaurants, bars and lounge, 1,800  square meters of flexible meeting and function space,  a indoor heated swimming pool and a fitness center. We make our guests feel comfortable and relaxed during their stay at our 5-star hotel in Xi'an, China. Sheraton Xi'an North City Hotel is a destination for those seeking relaxing days, colorful nights and exciting business opportunities. At Sheraton, we believe life is better when it's shared.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西安万豪行政公寓坐落于西安古都核心地段，巧妙融合家庭出游的温馨与商务出行的高效，为追求品质的旅客提供理想下榻之选。公寓地理位置优越，步行可达地铁3号线及8号线（环）线延平门站，轻松抵达大雁塔、钟楼等著名景点或重要产业园及各大办公驻地。周边大型购物中心与传统文化街区并存，让家庭观光与商务活动完美衔接。公寓提供从开放式豪华间至三居室套房等多种房型，每间均配有设施齐全的厨房、生活区及洗衣烘干设备。宽敞空间让全家入住从容自在，商务人士亦可享安静办公环境。此外，24小时健身房、会议室，双宜设施，为宾客提供多元的休闲与商务洽谈选择，而位于公寓1层的悦餐厅则是享用美食、给清晨加满活力的好去处。西安万豪行政公寓以“You don't stay here, you live here”为理念，无论是长住还是短憩，致力于让每一位宾客在奔波中尽享家的温馨与从容。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the heart of the ancient city of Xi’an, Executive Apartments the Fairway Place-Xi'an seamlessly blends the warmth of a family-friendly retreat with the efficiency required for business travel, offering an ideal choice for discerning guests. The apartments boast a prime location within walking distance of Yanpingmen Station on Metro Lines 3 and 8 (Loop Line), providing convenient access to iconic landmarks such as the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda and the Bell Tower, as well as key industrial parks and major office complexes. The surrounding area harmoniously combines large shopping malls with traditional cultural blocks, making it easy to balance family sightseeing with business commitments.A variety of room types are available, from deluxe studios to three-bedroom suites, each featuring a fully equipped kitchen, a separate living area, and a washer-dryer. The spacious layouts ensure a comfortable stay for families while offering business travelers a quiet and productive environment.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西安这座古城的悠久历史可追溯到约 3,100 年前，在这里，您有机会透过现代视野，近距离体验中华文化发源地的璀璨光辉。西安五星级商务酒店 - 万丽酒店是社会发现者的真正目的地，既迎合了思维超前旅行者的偏好，又蕴藏着昔日辉煌的足迹。住宿环境现代时尚，功能齐全，中国元素的装饰设计和各种便利设施充分满足商务宾客的需求。餐厅采用了富有创意的现代装饰风格，主打粤菜、川菜、西安菜和新疆菜等中国知名菜系，着力为您提供丰富多彩的用餐体验。其他五星级酒店礼遇包括，提供现场娱乐演出和特色鸡尾酒的全天候 R 酒吧、室内泳池以及行政楼层酒廊。酒店拥有设施先进的会议和活动场地，热情周到的服务传统让您的活动变得分外出彩。酒店位于曲江，毗邻国际会议中心，距离地标秦始皇兵马俑景区约 30 分钟路程。
hotels.descriptionEn: With a history dating back 3,100 years, the ancient city of Xi'an offers the opportunity to experience the birthplace of Chinese culture through a modern lens. Renaissance Xi'an Hotel is an authentic destination for Social Discoverers, addressing the needs and tastes of forward-thinking travelers while shining a light on the past. Accommodations are fashionable and functional, with touches of Chinese-inspired decor and amenities that cater to business travelers. Restaurants feature creative, contemporary decor with menus focused on some of China's noteworthy cuisines, including Cantonese, Sichuan, Xi'an and Xinjiang. Other perks include the day-to-night R Bar, with its live entertainment and specialty cocktails, an indoor swimming pool and a Club Floor lounge. State-of-the-art meeting and event venues are supported by a tradition of warm, attentive service. And our Qujiang hotel location places guests adjacent to the International Conference Center and within 30 minutes of the iconic Terracotta Army.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西安威斯汀大酒店是位于城市核心处的都市休憩之所，为您打造一处精致优雅的休闲秘境。酒店坐落于大唐不夜城内，与拥有约1,300年历史的大雁塔隔街相望，在这座十三朝古都，为您打造一场豪华度假之旅。酒店客房采用大唐风格设计，空间开阔，格调雅致。我们悉心关注您居停体验的每一处核心细节，确保您每一次到访，都能尽享舒适休憩、美味珍馐与贴心呵护。温馨客房和创意餐饮选择，为您打造自在随心的居停体验。下沉花园中的银杏树亭亭如盖，为您打造远离都市喧嚣的静谧休憩天地。欢迎莅临酒店内设的中国艺术博物馆，馆内珍藏2,000余件珍贵文物，邀您沉浸艺术盛宴。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover a sanctuary of refinement at The Westin Xi’an, an urban retreat in the heart of the city. Situated directly opposite the 1,300-year-old Giant Wild Goose Pagoda within the Grand Tang Ever-Bright City, the hotel offers luxury getaway experience in the capital of 13 dynasties in China.The hotel features spacious and stylish rooms in grand Tang dynasty design. Careful attention is paid to the most important elements of your stay to ensure each visit leaves you exceptionally well rested, nourished and cared for. Inviting guest rooms and innovative dining options let you create your own experience. Find tranquility in the Sunken Garden, where Feng-Shui-inspired Ginkgo trees offer a serene escape from the modern bustle. You are invited to explore the on-site Chinese fine arts museum, which houses an extraordinary collection of over 2,000 artifacts.
