hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店坐落于西安大兴医院渭水园院区内，为万豪万枫品牌旗下旅居空间。品牌源起万豪家族万枫庄园，承袭庄园静谧归心、质朴好客的精神内核，以温暖如归的待客之道，延续全球统一品质标准。酒店毗邻渭河生态景观带、西安湖、紫薇湖，自然静谧、景致宜人；与医疗、康养区域零距离联动，精准适配诊疗陪护、康养休养与院内接待需求，便捷安心。酒店设149间品质客房，配套完善、细节贴心；餐厅提供均衡膳食与康养定制餐食，贴心守护家属、康养人士与医护人员。酒店覆盖免费高速WiFi，开业可享万豪旅享家会员权益，将万枫庄园的静谧温情、生态旅居的惬意与医养便捷相融，以品质与温度，为每一位宾客打造归家般的安心居停。
hotels.descriptionEn: Choose Fairfield By Marriott Xi'an Weiyang, and enjoy a peaceful medical and health care time by the Weishui River; Marriott's premium quality accompanies medical living, and the ecological beauty of Weishui hides warmth. Located within Xi'an Daxing Hospital Weishui Park, it is a residential space under Fairfield by Marriott, inheriting the tranquility, peace of mind and hospitality of Marriott's Courtyard Manor and adhering to global quality standards. hotels.descriptionZh: 结束了整日的奔波，当您踏入客房的那一刻便尽是舒心惬意。酒店拥有 125 间明亮轩敞的客房与套房将家的温馨舒适尽数收纳其中，为您妥帖备好旅途所需的一切伴您尽享无忧住宿时光。您可以惬意地陷在福朋酒店特色睡床的柔软怀抱中卸下一身疲惫；也可以随心出门探寻榆林高新区的万般景致，每间客房均配备免费高速无线网络，助您随时与外界畅快相连；每日换新的免费瓶装水，亦为您的旅居增添一份贴心。我们力求化繁为简，为您拂去旅途的琐碎烦扰，让您真正拥有宾至如归的体验。酒店地理位置优越，距榆林榆阳机场仅 25 公里，驱车 30 分钟即可抵达。期待您的莅临，愿与您共度一段舒适惬意、物超所值的美好时光。
hotels.descriptionEn: After a long day, stepping into your guest room is pure relief. Our 125 bright, spacious guest rooms and suites offer all the comforts of home, with everything you need for a seamless stay. Sink into the plush comfort of the Four Points signature bed, or venture out to explore all that Yulin Hi-Tech Zone has to offer. Stay connected effortlessly with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi available in every room, and enjoy daily replenished free bottled water. We keep things simple—leaving travel hassles at the door so you can truly make yourself at home. We look forward to welcoming you for a relaxing, great-value stay. Conveniently located just 25 km from Yulin Yuyang Airport, the hotel is only a 30-minute drive away.

hotels.descriptionZh: Fairfield by Marriott Yulin has 203 spacious, bright quest rooms. It also has a gym, meetingrooms and Fairfield restalirant . Its breakfast offers rich options plusaromatic coffee, satisfying both business and leisure stays.
hotels.descriptionEn: Fairfield by Marriott Yulin is situated in the Yulin Kechuang New City. The hotel is approximately 7 kilometers from Yulin Railway Station and about 20 kilometers from Yulin Yuyang Airport, in proximity to renowned attractions such as Zhenbeitai, Hongshi Gorge, and Hengshan Polo Ancient Fortress. Drawing inspiration from Marriott’s signature “Manor Moment” concept, the hotel incorporates minimalist and balanced design elements, blending the leisurely philosophy of estate living into the modern pace of life. This allows guests to enjoy moments of physical and mental repose amid their busy schedules. The understated yet rustic design reflects the harmonious integration of historical and contemporary charm, embodying the distinctive allure of Yulin as the "Kuwait of the East."

A luxury haven for business and leisure travelers, our Wuhan hotel is the perfect home base for your visit to China.

Our hotel in Wuhan is equipped with 368 exquisite and elegant guest rooms as well as a variety of distinctive restaurants, such as Wuhan Kitchen and Maison Rib-Eye, to lead customers on an incredible culinary journey. In addition, our hotel also features leisure facilities such as our 24-hour fitness center, spa and indoor heated swimming pool. Whether you are venturing to China for a wedding, business meeting or banquet, our hotel boasts a variety of event spaces. This includes a large ballroom that can be divided into 3 parts for any kind of event with a banquet lounge and 6 extra function rooms. An ideal venue for gatherings of all sorts, make Wuhan Marriott Hotel Hankou your home-away-from-home.

The hotel features 217 guest rooms in low-rise buildings, blending Eastern elegance with modern charm and filling the gap for premium hotels in the "Two Dams and One Gorge" area. Rooms overlook the winding river, with select room types equipped with private hot springs. The cantilevered glass infinity pool creates a seamless blend of water and sky. With 4 event venues and over 1,600 sqm of flexible banquet and meeting space, it caters to dining, leisure and business needs. As a premium brand of Marriott International, it embodies the philosophy of "Destination Unlocked", integrating Three Gorges landscapes and local culture to invite guests to "Savour the Good Life".

hotels.descriptionEn: Settle in for a relaxing stay in one of our 313 warm and inviting guest rooms and suites, designed with your comfort in mind and featuring a spacious work desk, ergonomic chair, LED television and the plush, signature Sheraton Sweet Sleeper™ bed, with its crisp white linens, soft duvet and plush down pillows. Stay connected to friends, family and colleagues with high speed wireless internet covered in all rooms and public areas.4 restaurants and bars will create happy memories by sharing a meal with friends or family. Treat yourself to a fresh and tasty buffet and a-la-carte at Feast, a burst of traditional Chinese favorites with authentic Cantonese food, Hunan cuisine and local specialties at YUE Chinese Restaurant, and traditional American comfort food at Someplace Else. Or enjoy a casual coffee break or an after-work cocktail at Lobby Lounge. Featuring twelve spaces totaling nearly 2,600 square meters of space, Sheraton Changde Wuling Hotel is the ideal venue for a memorable gathering.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎下榻宁乡万豪万枫酒店，探寻“青铜之乡、红色故里、温泉胜地”。酒店坐落于长沙宁乡经济开区核心区位，地段优越、畅达全城。距宁乡站约 3公里，驱车 6 分钟即达；距宁乡西站 7 公里，10 分钟轻松抵达，高效适配商务出行与休闲出游，出行换乘便捷无忧。酒店毗邻紫荆广场、宁乡步行街等繁华商圈，车程仅 10 分钟，吃喝玩乐购一站式配齐，解锁多元休闲生活。毗邻关山古镇与长沙方特东方神话，距关山古镇约 12 公里、车程 20 分钟，距长沙方特东方神话约 13 公里、车程 20 分钟，轻松衔接三国古韵与亲子欢乐时光。酒店精心打造 100 间雅致舒适客房，旅居体验匠心尽显。全屋标配丝涟品牌床垫、康乃馨亲肤臻选床品，柔软入眠酣然好梦；搭配 55 英寸智能投屏电视、高速 WiFi，兼顾休闲娱乐与办公需求。客房通透高层落地窗设计，开阔视野舒展身心，卸下旅途疲惫，静享静谧悠然时光。酒店万枫早餐厅融汇中西风味美食，大厨匠心烹制多款营养佳肴，鲜香美味唤醒整日活力，以舌尖美味开启惬意旅途。酒店配备24 小时自助健身房，随时焕活活力，挥洒运动热情；自助洗衣房区域，轻松打理出行衣物，周全细致的配套服务，全方位满足商务差旅、家庭出游等各类出行需求。

It is also close to Guanshan Ancient Town and Changsha Fantawild Oriental Heritage, around 12 kilometers away with a 20-minute driving journey.The hotel features 100 elegant and comfortable guest rooms, all fitted with standard Sealy mattresses and Carees bedding, as well as 55-inch screen-casting TVs and high-speed WiFi.The Fairfield breakfast restaurant offers a rich variety of Chinese and Western cuisines. Guests can enjoy a 24-hour self-service gym and laundry room, perfectly meeting all demands for business trips, family getaways and other travel purposes.

Over 1000m2 of 5 event spaces equipped with cutting-edge conference equipment and world-class audio-visual entertainment facilities, making them ideal for all kinds of meetings and social events. Revitalize mind, body and spirit in the spacious swimming pool, relaxing Spa by JW and well equipped fitness center with a breathtaking view of the city, natu rally integrating the beautiful urban style with the elegant interior design.

hotels.descriptionEn: Choose The Meixi Lake, Changsha Marriott Executive Apartments and enjoy a comfortable, convenient home-like space. Nestled by the scenic Meixi Lake, we are just steps away from the lakeside trail, offering you a tranquil waterfront retreat amid the bustling city while immersing you in the unique charm of Changsha – a city renowned for its "mountains, waters, and islets". With over 80% of our accommodations designed as suites, most guests can enjoy spacious, home-like living. Each suite features a fully equipped kitchen, allowing you to savor the warmth of home cooking. Thoughtfully appointed with built-in refrigerators and separate washer-dryer combos, we deliver a truly hassle‑free "pack and live" experience. To ensure our guests have even more fun, our Kids Club is dedicated to creating a carefree world for your children.We sincerely invite you to embark on an extraordinary journey that blends the vibrant energy of the city with the serene comfort of lakefront living.

hotels.descriptionZh: 作为万豪国际集团旗下于湖南率先开设的酒店，株洲美的万豪酒店地理位置优越，位于株洲高科技工业园中，此处是湖南的两大重点开发区之一。酒店距高铁站仅约十分钟车程，距市中心约十分钟行程，距长沙黄花国际机场约四十五分钟行程。株洲美的时代广场位于酒店附近，是一处购物娱乐综合体。株洲美的万豪酒店拥有 301间宽敞优雅的客房和套房，可欣赏株洲市的非凡美景或宁静的花园景观。位于 24 层的行政酒廊为行政楼层宾客和万豪尊贵会员提供个性化服务和专享礼遇。宴会及会议空间共 1,500 平米左右,包括一间约 1,000 平米的无柱式宴会厅和 5 间多功能厅。欢迎莅临丰富多彩的火车之城株洲。
hotels.descriptionEn: As the first Marriott International Brand Hotel in Hunan province, Zhuzhou Marriott Hotel is strategically located in the Zhuzhou Hi-Tech Park, One of the two national development zones in Hunan. The Hotel is a mere ten minutes drive from the high-speed railway station, ten minutes from the City Center and forty-five minutes form the Changsha Huanghua international airport . There is Midea Time Square nearby, is shopping and entertainment complex. Zhuzhou Marriott Hotel offers 311 elegant and spacious rooms and suites, with distinctive views of Zhuzhou City or serene garden views. The Executive Lounge on the 24th floor extends personalized service and exclusive benefits for Executive floor guests and Marriott Elite members. The total banquet and meeting space covers over 1,500 square meters, including a 1,000-square-meter pillar less ballroom and five function rooms. We looking forward to welcoming you to The Train Dynamic City-Zhuzhou.

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Dali Erhai Lake offers 220 comfortable guestrooms and suites with elegant design. With Erhai Lake in close proximity, Cangshan Mountain across the sea, surrounded by wetland park, unique natural environment, enjoy the tranquility and prosperity of Dali.Most of the hotel rooms face Erhai Lake and have a panoramic view of the lake. The Four Comfort Bed™ in our rooms is true to our service tenet of "simple and happy"; Provide guests with a unique new experience through meticulous and considerate service to meet your needs. The hotel has 3 conference rooms, multi-function rooms, Chinese private rooms, lobby bar with coffee and craft brew in one, 24-hour fitness center and laundromat facilities, whether it is a business trip or a vacation, will bring you convenience, comfort and value.

hotels.descriptionZh: 澜沧江畔，雨林里，凤凰于飞，西双版纳福朋喜来登酒店作为度假型酒店，位于西双版纳景洪市清泉路，周边配套齐全，附近景点林立，交通便捷，且拥有极佳的地理位置，15分钟车程便可到达西双版纳高铁站及市中心，20分钟车程便可到达嘎洒机场，距离告庄西双景、星光夜市车程10分钟。福朋喜来登酒店将高端理念、文化艺术植于空间万象之中，开启以雨林为幕与空间对话的旅程，打造符合时代潮流生活方式的城市地标级艺术空间。酒店拥有198间客房及套房，客房内，现代时尚的设计风格与经典实用的设施巧妙融合，营造出轻松舒适的氛围。每间客房均配备舒适床品、55英寸液晶电视、独立淋浴间，以及免费高速无线网络，满足当代宾客的多元需求。宾客还可通过万豪旅享家手机应用程序（Marriott Bonvoy APP）办理电子房卡、快速入住及退房等多项便捷服务，尽享舒适高效体验。酒店的餐饮设施致力于为宾客的旅途增添地道风味。位于一层的玩啤食社 (THE MESH)全日制餐厅提供一系列西式及亚洲风味自助美食，宾客可以在此品尝环球海鲜及时令美馔、 咖啡、小食以及由品牌标志性的“醇饮优选(Best Brews®)”计划甄选的当地精酿啤酒，尽情享受轻松惬意的休闲时光。
hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 西双版纳云投喜来登大酒店坐落于嘎洒温泉小镇的核心地带，周围环绕着郁郁葱葱的热带花园。门前古寨，门后山河，佛寺与酒店毗邻，可方便抵达各个文化、娱乐和知名景点，如原始森林公园、基诺山寨、野象谷、流沙寨、曼弄枫等自然景观与民族风情两优融合的风景胜地。这里是您惬意感受热带雨林风光，体验傣寨风情的理想之地。酒店距离景洪市中心约11公里, 距离西双版纳国际机场约6公里。酒店拥有326间宽敞的客房和套房，视野开阔，纵览美景。两间餐厅和一间大堂吧提供中外美食及本地饕餮，犒赏食客的味蕾。酒店还设有2,478平米的多功能会议空间，其中包括面积1,070平米的大宴会厅，10个独立的会议室，还有一个婚庆亭，灵活契合会议客户的所有需求。此外，酒店还设有健身中心和室内外游泳池。西双版纳云投喜来登大酒店定能让您收获精彩旅程。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the heart of the Hot Spring district of Gasa Town which is surrounded by lush tropical garden. The Dai ancient village in front of the hotel, the mountains and rivers behind the hotel, the Buddhist temple and the hotel are adjacent, Sheraton Grand Xishuangbanna Hotel provides effortless access to the city’s cultural, entertainment and famous attractions such as the Primitive Forest Park, Kino Village, Wild Elephant Valley, and the scenic spot of Liushazhai, Mannongfeng, where the fusion of natural beauty and ethnic charm is remarkable. It is an ideal place for you to enjoy the tropical rainforest scenery and well experience the charm of the Dai ethnic village. It is about 11 kilometers from downtown Jinghong and approximately 6 kilometers from Xishuangbanna International Airport. Featuring 326 spacious guest rooms and suites, which boasts great views and natural sunlight. Guests can embark on a culinary journey, choosing from 2 restaurants & lobby bar serving authentic Chinese & Foreign cuisines.

hotels.descriptionZh: 昆明城市中心福朋喜来登踞守春城心脉，坐拥金马碧鸡坊地标景观，下楼即达南屏步行街与昆明老街。186间全景客房配备福朋舒适床品及高速网络，客房可俯瞰千年古迹与现代霓虹交织的城市画卷。四维立体的"玩啤食社"重新定义社交场域，将精酿工坊与创意餐厅融为一体，本地鲜酿与环球美食在此碰撞出独特滋味。交通枢纽无缝链接，酒店距离地铁3号线360米，更以15分钟高铁圈、30分钟航空圈编织效率网络，让差旅成为从容的时间艺术，坐享城市动脉的便捷与市井烟火的温度，为商旅客群打造"出则繁华，入则静好"的沉浸式旅居体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Kunming,Downtown Central Kunming occupies a prime location near Jinma Biji Arch, steps from Nanping Pedestrian Street and Kunming Old Town. Its 186 panoramic rooms feature signature bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi, and vistas showcasing the city’s blend of ancient heritage and modernity. The "Brew & Bites Social Hub" innovates hospitality with a craft brewery-creative dining hybrid, where local brews and international flavors offer unique fusion. With seamless transport links, the hotel sits 360m from Metro Line 3 and ensures 15-minute high-speed rail/30-minute airport access, streamlining business travel while connecting guests to urban efficiency and authentic local culture. Tailored for professionals, it balances vibrant city immersion with sanctuary-like serenity-"bustling energy beyond, tranquil refinement within."

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points By Sheraton Hefei BaoHe is the ideal hotel for guests staying in Hefei. Having opened in 2017, the hotel boasts a location convenient to Hefei South Railway Station, Hefei Xinqiao International Airport, southeastern Hefei and many locations popular among both business and leisure travelers. Enjoy our many services, plenty of extras and a great location in Baohe Industrial Park. If you're looking for some stimulating activity, make use of our state-of-the-art fitness center or take a dip in our indoor heated pool. Each of our 261 guest rooms boasts free WiFi, as well as a flat screen TV and a private bathroom with shower/tub combination and rainfall showerhead among other ammenities that are sure you enhance your stay. Take advantage of the two restaurants located on the property, or stay in and call for room service. Our excellent staff are equipped and ready to assist our guests to make their stay here as pleasant and relaxing as possible.

Ideal for both business and leisure travelers our 5 star hotel is located in the city's vibrant business district just a short distance from local subway and railway stations. Notable tourist attractions such as Baohe Park, pedestrian thoroughfares and shopping malls are also close by. Connect with colleagues in the Lobby Lounge or enliven your taste buds at one of our five dining venues. The Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio and Bo SPA help you to move well and keep your mind and body in balance during your stay. Each of our 296 hotel rooms and suites are designed to evoke a better you. Sink into an oasis of comfort with our signature Westin Heavenly Bed, revive your senses in the rain forest shower and discover elevated productivity with complimentary high speed internet access. If you are planning an event in Anhui, we offer a range of adaptable venues as well as delicious catering with SuperFoodsRx ingredients.

With 360 square meters of flexible meeting space to support your business events, come and explore this millennia-old capital rich in history with us.

hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 郑州机场万怡酒店坐落于被誉为华夏文明发源地的河南省，欢迎下榻该酒店，宾客可现场体验酒店所呈现的历史与当下文化的交融。酒店内提供宽敞的客房、免费 Wi-Fi 网络、全天候餐饮服务和 24 小时健身中心等设施，可满足旅客的一切需求。酒店大堂温馨迷人，配备各种休闲的公共设施，吸引了众多宾客前来放松、聚会或办公，而酒店宴会场地设有宽敞的宴会厅，是举办大型和正式活动的理想场地。从酒店可轻松前往河南省知名的旅游景点和风景名胜，如河南少林寺、龙门石窟和河南博物院，对于想探索辉煌中华历史文化的宾客来说，这里是理想下榻之选。酒店可为需要帮助的宾客提供游客咨询服务，帮助制定合适的活动日程或预订风景名胜门票。宾客可轻松前往任何旅游计划中的景点尽情游览。酒店提供24小时接送机服务，为宾客的行程提供方便。
hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard Zhengzhou Airport offers visitors the chance to experience a cross-section of the past and present. Located in Henan province, known as the birthplace of Chinese civilization, our hotel is a memorable destination for business and leisure travel. Enjoy amenities designed to cater to all of your needs, including spacious guest rooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, all-day dining and a 24-hour fitness center. An inviting lobby encourages you to relax, meet or work in a casual, communal setting, while event spaces including an expansive ballroom are well suited to larger, more formal events in Zhengzhou. Those looking to explore China's rich history and culture have easy access to the province’s important sites and attractions, including the Shaolin Temple, Longmen Grottoes and Henan Museum. Our hotel team will be happy to provide assistance to those who need help crafting an ideal itinerary or booking attraction tickets. The hotel provides 24-hour airport pick-up service.

hotels.descriptionEn: Ideally situated in the heart of the Zhengdong Railway Station Business District, Courtyard Zhengzhou East blends the delicate with the refined to offer a modern interpretation of the traditional business hotel. Elegant wooden furnishings, dramatic art and breathtaking textiles create a stylish lobby setting, where The Lounge invites hotel guests to meet and mingle with coffee and cocktails after a fun day in Zhengzhou, China. The same sophistication carries into our guest rooms and suites, which boast a large workspace, high-speed WiFi, room service and a sleek marble bathroom. Book an Executive-level hotel suite to enjoy access to complimentary breakfast and business amenities at our lounge. If you are looking to host a distinctive business meeting or social event here in China, our hotel features eight adaptable venues, a lavish ballroom, private dining at popular Wan Yi Xuan and close proximity to Zhengzhou East Railway Station. A sensational visit to China awaits you at Courtyard Zhengzhou East.

hotels.descriptionZh: 入住郑州建业艾美酒店，发现历史底蕴与现代潮流水乳交融的中国。我们现代化的酒店位于河南省的省会城市郑州，地处市中心的黄金地段，可方便您尽情探索这一洋溢着摩登创想的城市内外。这座典雅精致的门户大厦紧邻郑东新区，邻近一家购物中心和电影院，还靠近古代遗迹和地标。酒店充满活力，设有时尚现代的餐厅，供应中式、日式及欧式特色美食，并设有酒吧、鸡尾酒吧和咖啡厅。宾客可抽空到纯真水疗中心休闲放松，这里是我们的身体与精神的绿洲。酒店活动场地包括大宴会厅，适合筹办会议、社交活动和婚礼。酒店设有 337 间客房和套房，通过一系列拥有质朴触感和简约设计的前沿技术为旅行常客们打造美妙难忘的住宿体验。欢迎莅临下榻我们位于中国郑州的酒店，不论是商务旅行、探险娱乐还是家庭度假，这里均是理想之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover modern and historic China from Le Méridien Zhengzhou. Situated in the forward-thinking capital of Henan Province, our modern hotel in Jinshui District is centrally located for exploring the city and beyond. This sophisticated gateway is adjacent to Zhengzhou Eastern New District, with a shopping center and cinema next door, yet close to ancient ruins and landmarks. Within our vibrant hotel, you'll find Chinese, Japanese and European specialties served in contemporary restaurants, as well as a wine room, cocktail bar and a coffee hub. Take time to relax at Pure Spa, our oasis for body and spirit. Plan meetings, social functions and weddings in our event venues, including our Grand Ballroom. Each of our hotel's 337 guest rooms and suites features an inspired blend of rustic touches with cutting-edge technology in a minimalist design bound to impress the seasoned travelers. Whether traveling for work, adventure or a family vacation, we look forward to welcoming you to our Zhengzhou, China hotel.

hotels.descriptionEn: At the landmark JW Marriott Hotel Zhengzhou, inspiration comes in many forms, from the architectural design that mirrors the 1,500 year-old Songyue Pagoda to amenities that were created with the modern traveler in mind. Set in the heart of Zhengdong New District CBD between the Convention and Exhibition Center and Henan Art Center, this 280 meter-tall luxury hotel is a destination for both domestic and international visitors. Whether looking for a celebratory night out, a weekend away or a meeting or wedding space, this luxury hotel offers the perfect venue. Close a big deal over dinner at The Grill; treat the family to a special meal at Man Ho Cantonese restaurant; or host guests in one of 8 stunning event spaces including the 1,000-square-meter JW Grand Ballroom. After an international flight or an all-day meeting, escape to an elegant room featuring a soothing color palette, spacious bathroom, sumptuous bedding and commanding views over the city skyline and Ruyi Lake.

hotels.descriptionZh: 为您的中国郑州之旅预订理想下榻之处欢迎下榻郑州美盛喜来登大酒店, 乐享宽敞舒适的空间和令人耳目一新的卓越服务。酒店客房时尚大方, 配备豪华床品、免费 Wi-Fi 等一众周到设施, 并可欣赏郑州市中心美景。对更大空间有要求的宾客可升级至宽敞套房, 可额外尊享行政酒廊礼遇。提供先进的休闲设施供宾客休闲放松, 包括 24 小时健身房、室内恒温泳池。宾客可选择各类在售的国际和当地美食, 包括我们的日式料理餐厅和中餐厅的私人餐饮, 并享受 24 小时客房送餐服务。酒店位置便利, 地处郑东新区中心位置, 邻近郑州国际会展中心, 提供鼓舞人心的活动空间, 以及智能技术和定制策划服务, 方便您成功举办商务会议或特殊活动。
hotels.descriptionEn: Refreshing service and elevated spaces await you at Sheraton Grand Zhengzhou Hotel, China. Stylish hotel rooms feature thoughtful amenities, plush bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi and views across downtown Zhengzhou. Those looking for more space can upgrade to a spacious suite with Executive Lounge access for added benefits. Guests can relax with our state-of-the-art leisure facilities, including a 24-hour gym, heated indoor pool and 'Kids Corner' indoor playground. Visitors can select from a variety of international and local food options on offer, including private dining at our Japanese and Chinese restaurants, as well as 24-hour room service. Take advantage of our hotel's central location in the Zhengdong New District, adjacent to Zhengzhou International Conference and Exhibition Center, to host a successful business meeting or special occasion in one of our inspiring event spaces, complete with smart technology and bespoke planning services. Additional hotel services include on-site laundry and parking.

hotels.descriptionEn: Celebrate your style at Aloft Zhengzhou Shangjie, located in the heart inland China's business center. We are a short stroll to endless entertainment options and a quick trip to the Shaolin Temple and the UNESCO World Heritage destination, the Luoyang Longmen Grottoes. Meet & mingle with friends at our w xyzSM bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from re:fuel by AloftSM, our 24 hour pantry or play in our remixSM lounge. Plus you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower, custom amenities by Bliss Spa and more. Our plug and play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to the 42 inch LCD TV to maximize work and play.

hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel lobby has been innovatively designed, featuring spacious and flexible spaces, while offering rich coffee and exquisite snacks, integrating business and social aspects. The hotel's 119 guest rooms combine design and functionality - the interior design is dominated by warm colors, the decoration uses natural style materials, and is complemented by modern furniture; the lighting and color schemes have been meticulously designed and adjusted by professional teams to create a warm and comfortable atmosphere for guests. Each room is equipped with a "Slede" brand mattress and the upgraded Wanfeng soft cotton bedding, creating a sweet dream bed; it also comes with a 55-inch LED TV, free high-speed wireless network, adjustable lighting and various power interfaces, meeting the diverse needs of modern guests.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎莅临廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店，感受北京附近的民族文化。廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店位于蒋谭路，处于潮白新城的商业中心地带。距工业园、住宅办公室、展览中心和休闲设施均只有数分钟行程。距北京首都国际机场 (PEK) 约 45 分钟车程。酒店邻近众多热门运动和休闲场所。位于北京东燕郊经济开发区的燕龙马术俱乐部已举办过多场重要的国内及国际赛事。酒店位于大厂回族自治县，拥有自身的特色文化。距离酒店约 14 公里的北坞清真寺占地约 85 亩左右，是河北省超大的清真寺之一。享受入住廊坊潮白河喜来登酒店的难忘体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Soak up the national culture near Beijing at the Sheraton Langfang Chaobai River Hotel. The Sheraton Langfang Chaobai River Hotel is located on Jiangtan Road, within Chaobai New Citys commercial center. Industrial parks, residential offices, exhibition centers and leisure facilities are all just minutes away.  Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) can be reached by car in approximately 45 minutes. The hotel is close to many renowned sports and leisure venues. Yanlong Equestrian Club, located in the East Beijing Yanjiao Economic Development Zone, has hosted several esteemed local and International events. Dachang Hui Autonomous County, where the hotel is located, has its own special culture. Approximately 14 kilometers from the hotel, Beiwu Mosque is one of Hebei province largest mosques, spanning 14 acres.  Enjoy a stay at Sheraton Langfang Chaobai River Hotel for a memorable experience.

hotels.descriptionZh: 廊坊固安福朋喜来登酒店坐落于固安新城规划的社区之中，是商务和休闲旅客眼中的现代热土。酒店格调时尚的客房设有特色舒适设施，采用精致的设计元素，配有带精选卫浴产品的宽敞私人浴室，称心惬意的轻松休闲体验尽在此间。酒店内设多间别具特色的餐厅，精心料理的特色中式美食为您缔造非凡味蕾盛宴。酒店地理位置优越，久负盛名的商务区和热门旅游景点，以及北京野生动物园和固安中央公园云集四周。距北京大兴国际机场约 30 分钟。酒店的多功能活动空间拥有专业策划员，并配有先进的视听技术设备，提供定制餐饮服务，是成功举办会议、婚礼和社交活动的理想选择。在波光粼粼的室内泳池中畅泳一番恢复活力，或者到设施齐全的健身中心酣畅锻炼，为一天难忘的工作、购物或观光之旅划上完满句号。欢迎莅临下榻我们在廊坊的现代化酒店，发现精彩纷呈的中国河北。
hotels.descriptionEn: Situated amid the planned community of Gu'an New Town, Four Points by Sheraton Langfang, Guan is a contemporary haven for business and leisure travelers. Experience effortless relaxation in sophisticated hotel accommodations with signature comforts, refined design elements and large private bathrooms with premium bath products. Ignite your senses with expertly prepared Chinese cuisine at our distinctive hotel restaurants. Enjoy a coveted location amid prestigious businesses, celebrated tourist attractions, Beijing wildlife park and Guan Central Park. Beijing Daxing International Airport is 30 minutes away. Host successful meetings, weddings and social engagements in versatile event space with expert planners, cutting-edge audiovisual technology and custom catering. Punctuate an unforgettable day of work, shopping or sightseeing with a rejuvenating swim in our sparkling indoor pool or an exhilarating workout in our well-equipped fitness center. Enrich your visit to Hebei, China at our modern hotel in Langfang.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎来到崇礼源宿酒店，探索群山环绕、活力四射的新滑雪胜地。清晨醒来，专注于健康生活方式和探索体验。24 小时外带餐厅是全天候提供营养美味的理想选择。在我们的室内自然咸水泳池尽情畅泳或自由漂浮。特色天梦之床、经“能源之星”认证且设施齐备的厨房、带雨淋花洒和全天然卫浴用品的水疗风格浴室伴您度过精彩每一天。人性化办公区设有超大办公桌、人体工学座椅和简单易用的电源及数据接口，以及一体式扩展坞、42 英寸高清平板电视等娱乐设施。欢迎下榻太舞滑雪度假村崇礼源宿酒店。  在崇礼源宿酒店，我们为您提供更多亲近自然的空间，让您尽情思考、办公、参加社交活动，乐享活力生活体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Discover Chinas newest ski destination at Element Chongli a vibrant ski area surrounded by mountains. Wake up and thrive with focus on the health lifestyles and exploration. 24 hour grab and go pantry is ideal for nourishing and delicious options around the clock. Swim or just float away in our all natural saline indoor pool. Feel your best everyday with the signature Heavenly Bed, a fully equipped kitchen with ENERGY STAR   rated appliances and spa inspired bathrooms with rainfall shower heads and all natural amenities. Enjoy the flexibility of a user friendly work space, featuring an over sized desk, ergonomic chair and easy access to power and data connections and the instant entertainment of all in one connectivity station, flat screen 42 inch HDTV and more. Come to stay at Element Chongli at the Thaiwoo Ski Resort.  At Element Chongli we give you more room to think, work, socialize close to nature, more space to live your energetic life.

hotels.descriptionZh: 北方明珠滨城大连，位于辽东半岛南端，三面环海一面环山，四季分明，气候适宜，有着“时尚浪漫之都”的美誉。在大连东港旅游度假区，大连东港福朋喜来登酒店如同一颗镶嵌在黄海海岸的璀璨明珠优雅亮相，以熠熠光辉点亮城市的滨海天际线。酒店毗邻大连国际会议中心、威尼斯水城、东港音乐喷泉及东港游艇码头俱乐部，举步即达；距时代广场、友谊商城、网红打卡地港东五街、海之韵公园等多元胜地，仅需10分钟车程；距地铁2号线大连会议中心站仅100米，轻松抵达大连周水子国际机场、大连站、大连北站、大连星海广场等地，畅行全城无虞。另外酒店为住宿客人提供免费超大地下停车场，供您自驾停泊，自由出行。入住酒店为您褪去一天的风尘倦意，壮阔海景与璀璨城光奔涌而入，足不出户即可尽览迷人海滨风光与都市夜景的梦幻交融。
hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel is conveniently located near the Dalian International Conference Center, Venice Water Town, Donggang Music Fountain and Donggang Yacht Club, all within walking distance.  The viral check-in spot Gangdong Fifth Street and Haizhiyun Park are just a 10-minute drive away. With the Dalian Conference Center Station (Metro Line 2) only 100 meters away, guests can easily access Dalian Zhoushuizi International Airport, Dalian Railway Station, Dalian North Railway Station and Xinghai Square, ensuring seamless travel throughout the city.

hotels.descriptionEn: Fairfield By Marriott Dalian Jinpu New Area is located in the CBD business district on Jinma Road in Dalian Jinpu New Area, the core area of this vibrant emerging economic engine in Northeast China. The hotel is just a few minutes' drive away from Tongniuling Scenic Area and Daheishan Scenic Area.We understand what you need during your journey: efficiency, reliability, and a moment of tranquility. At Fairfield experience a deep sleep on our imported Serta beds and a thorough clean with our smart toilets. Start your day full of vitality at the Fairfield Restaurant, which offers local - style breakfast. You can also work efficiently in the quiet guest rooms. The multi - functional meeting room with built - in LED can meet different needs of business meetings. The self - service gym and laundry room support your life and work.Fairfield Hotel focuses on your core needs and pays attention to details, ensuring that every stay of yours is efficient and worry free.

hotels.descriptionEn: Aloft Dalian is a bold new hotel in the center of northeast China's most scenic seaport! This hip, modern romantic city is filled with a mixture of business and fashion districts, endless nightlife, entertainment options and intriguing attractions. Meet & mingle with friends at our w xyz(SM) bar, grab a sweet, savory or healthy snack from re:fuel by Aloft(SM), our 24/7 pantry or play in our re:mix(SM) lounge. Plus, you can always stay connected with hotel-wide wired and wireless High Speed Internet Access! Breeze into one of our Aloft rooms, featuring our ultra-comfortable signature bed, walk-in shower, custom amenities by Bliss® Spa and more. Our plug & play connectivity station charges all your electronics and links to the 42” LCD TV to maximize work and play.

We are steps from Xinghai Square and min from Dalians natural marvels, museums and historical sites. To complement our majestic environment we feature a palatial Bavarian castle facade and luxury amenities like a tranquil hotel spa, state of the art fitness center and a sparkling indoor swimming pool. Rejuvenate with ease after your daily adventure in China in our well appointed rooms and suites all lodging showcases premium amenities such as plush bedding and a flat screen TV and sweeping ocean, mountain or city views of Dalian China. Sophistication knows no bounds at The Castle Hotel a Luxury Collection Hotel Dalian.

Utilize our extraordinary meeting rooms by expanding your imagination and creativity for a transformative conference, wedding or business gathering with teleconferencing facilities and multi-dimensional audiovisual equipment. The Le Méridien Shenyang, Heping is the ideal place to stay when visiting or on business in Shenyang.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Renaissance Shenyang West Hotel is next to the city’s political and economic center, home to nearly 2,000 businesses, and Metro Line 1, which carries riders across the city. This buzz of activity is weaved into the hotel experience, where vibrant energy and design are offered alongside familiar comforts and quiet. Meeting amenities cater to the location and include nearly 3,200 square meters of event space and R.E.N. planning experts. Restaurants highlight flavors from the East as well as the diversity of buffet-style dining. Accommodations are beautifully designed with modern, minimalist décor, pops of color, decadent soaking tubs and beds that entice guests to sleep in. Equally stylish are the fitness center and indoor swimming pool, where lounge seating and floor-to-ceiling windows add a residential touch.

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店位于城市中央商务区及休闲区的核心地带。交通便利，毗邻火车站、桃仙机场及地铁站。近邻沈阳故宫、张学良旧居及中街等旅游景点。酒店拥有446间客房、套房及多种不同面积及布局公寓式套房。房内配有65寸液晶电视可实现独立投屏、高速无线网络，可满足商务出行及家庭休闲之旅的客人需求。2间特色餐厅及大堂吧，为您呈现风味各异的特色美食体验。3500平健身区域，专业的健身设备和设施，包括健身房，宽敞的游泳池和篮球及壁球场地等休闲区域，助您精力充沛。多功能宴会厅缔造专属难忘的会议体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel is located in the heart of Shenyang’s CBD and shopping areas, conveniently situated, adjacent to Train Station, Taoxian Airport and Metro Station. It is close to tourist attractions such as Shenyang Imperial Palace, Zhang Xueliang's former residence and Shenyang Zhongjie. The hotel has 446 guest rooms, suites and a variety of residential-style suites of different sizes and layout. The rooms are equipped with 65-inch LCD TVs and high-speed Wi-Fi to meet the needs of guests on business trips and family leisure trips. Two specialty restaurants and lobby bar, presenting you with different flavors of special culinary experiences. 3,500 square meters of recreational and professional fitness equipment and facilities, including gymnasiums, spacious swimming pools, basketball, squash courts and other recreational areas, helping you to be energetic. The multi-functional banquet hall creates an exclusive and unforgettable meeting experience.

hotels.descriptionEn: Conveniently located in the Hunnan New District, the hotel is in the new center of the Administrative and Culture hub of the city. Both Shenyang Taoxian International Airport (SHE) and the Shenyang Olympic Sports Center are only 10 minutes away by car. Unwind in one of our 338 contemporary and elegant guest rooms. All rooms feature the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience bed. A spacious work area, wired and wireless Speed Internet Access are just a few comforts of home. Enjoy some of the freshest and cuisines in our YUE Chinese and Feast Signature Restaurant. With extensive meeting facilities spanning approximately 2,000 square meters, the Sheraton Shenyang South City Hotel is an ideal venue for events. The 1,100-square-meter Grand Ballroom can be divided into three sections. All function spaces are equipped with state-of-the-art technology and backed by a dedicated team of planning and catering professionals.

hotels.descriptionEn: Next to some of Asia's largest skiing resort, The Westin Changbaishan Resort is also nestled into the forest and just ten kilometers from Changbaishan Airport (NBS). The many exciting outdoors activities on Changbai Mountain are all within easy reach. Recharge in our WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio or our serene indoor pool, and re-center in our contemporary Heavenly Spa by Westin™. Find delicious renewal in our three alluring bars and restaurants, offering freshly prepared international, Korean and local fare. All our 262 sleek guest rooms, including 31 suites, feature the Westin Heavenly® Bed and spa-like rain forest shower, plus an iPod docking station, ergonomic work space with high-speed internet access and floor-to-ceiling windows-many with mountain views.

There are more than 20 function and meeting rooms and a combined space encompassing 5,900 square meters. Our 1,730-square meter Grand Ballroom lives up to its lofty billing, featuring soaring 9-meter high adorned ceilings.

hotels.descriptionZh: 大庆富力喜来登酒店是当地率先开设的豪华国际酒店。大庆富力喜来登酒店位于中央商务区，地理位置优越，距离大庆火车站仅 6.2 公里左右，距离大庆萨尔图机场约 17.9 公里。酒店设有 290 间优雅客房，均可欣赏石油城的壮丽景致。酒店内设多间特色餐厅，从地道东北菜到国际佳肴均有供应。无柱式宴会厅面积约 1,187 平米，是您举办各种商务会议和主题宴会的理想选择。无论是豪华婚礼亦或商务聚会，我们的专家活动团队都将竭力为您提供专业的策划与餐饮服务。我们关注每个细节，追求卓越，力求满足每一位宾客的期待。
hotels.descriptionEn: Sheraton Daqing Hotel is the first five-star international hotel in Daqing. Sheraton Daqing Hotel is well-placed in the Central Business District, about 6.2 kilometers from the Daqing Railway Station and 17.9 kilometers from Daqing Saertu Airport. This hotel features 290 elegant guestrooms with city views of this petroleum city.  Guests are invited to explore our specialty restaurants, options from native Northeast China to international delicacies. A pillar-less ballroom with a massive 1187 square area perfect for hosting various business meetings and themed banquets. Our expert event team will ensure professional planning and catering services, whether you're organizing a wedding or an business gathering. We focus on every detail, pursue excellence only hope to meet the expectations of every guest.

hotels.name: 哈尔滨 JW 万豪酒店
hotels.nameZh: 哈尔滨 JW 万豪酒店

hotels.address: 松北区创新一路 199 号
hotels.addressZh: 松北区创新一路 199 号
hotels.addressEn: No 199 Chuangxin Yi Road, Songbei District
hotels.descriptionZh: 哈尔滨JW万豪酒店屹立于松花江北畔，紧邻哈尔滨市政府，距哈尔滨冰雪大世界仅需五分钟路程。哈尔滨以冰城夏都而闻名，具有悠久历史的建筑和丰富多元的文化，酒店具有现代典雅风尚。客房和套房均配有宽大的落地窗，松花江及城市全景尽收眼底。夏季自然美韵的一湖三岛绿水盈盈，野趣横生，周边秀美的湿地公园环伺，原生态美景与怡人的爽夏温度，让人流连忘返。如需用餐，酒店内设两间间风格迥异的美食餐厅，提供中式菜肴餐和国际自助。与此同时，酒店还有别具一格的酒廊，为您奉上精酿啤酒、季节性鸡尾酒和下午茶服务。哈尔滨 JW 万豪酒店拥有各类活动场地，宛若一块空白画布，方便量身打造会议和活动，对于在正寻求难忘目的地的活动策划者而言，这里是非常理想的筹办地之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Just five minutes from Harbin Ice and Snow World’s vibrant ice sculpture village, JW Marriott Hotel Harbin River North stands above the majestic Songhua River in the district of Harbin municipal government. Harbin, a landmark ice city with its historic architecture and local culture, inspires the modern elegance of this hotel. Guest rooms and suites feature expansive floor-to-ceiling windows for panoramic views of the river and city. During the winter season, vistas of the city’s illuminated buildings carved from ice light up the night sky with a magical touch. For dining, the hotel brings culinary worlds together with three restaurants offering guests Chinese, authentic local cuisine and international flavors. There are also two distinct lounges featuring light bites, seasonal cocktails and afternoon tea service. For event planners looking for a memorable destination, JW Marriott Hotel Harbin River North offers a variety of venues that provide a blank canvas to customize meetings and events.
hotels.hotelImageAlt: JW Marriott Hotel Harbin River North

hotels.descriptionZh: 酒店坐落于哈尔滨市道里区尚志大街40号，地处美丽的冰城核心商业区域，比邻著名的中央大街，地理位置极为优越。从酒店步行至中央大街仅需约5分钟，交通十分便利：距哈尔滨站约1公里，距哈尔滨西站约9.5公里，距哈尔滨太平国际机场约37公里。酒店正对面即是地铁2号线出入口，周边还有众多公交线路环绕。绝佳的地理位置使住客能轻松享受周边完善的配套设施，无论是休闲娱乐还是医疗资源都一应俱全，为宾客的出行与生活提供了极大便利。酒店将严格按照星级标准精心打造，并深度融合万豪国际集团先进的管理模式与服务理念。酒店拥有144间高级客房和套房，同时配备了多功能会议室、西餐厅、大堂吧、健身中心和洗衣房等设施，旨在全方位满足宾客的商务洽谈、休闲度假与娱乐放松等多方面需求，致力于为每一位宾客带来高品质的入住体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionZh: 哈尔滨富力丽思卡尔顿酒店居于 57 层的哈尔滨地标性建筑富力中心高层，坐拥松花江的迷人景色，冬季可纵览冰雪胜境。酒店融汇豪华住宅区和购物中心，带来超凡卓越的哈尔滨豪华旅居体验，旨在为城市旅客打造新地标，缔造精致豪华的非凡入住体验。酒店环境时尚现代，共设 366 间非凡的江景或城景客房。四间餐厅位于酒店高层，宾客可一边畅享丰富美食，一边欣赏松花江的眩目美景。另设有约 3530 平米的活动空间，才华横溢的酒店活动策划和餐饮团队提供周到服务，为您打造令人陶醉的精彩庆典活动。
hotels.descriptionEn: Perched on the upper levels of the 57-floor Harbin R&F landmark tower, The Ritz-Carlton, Harbin overlooks the stunning view of Songhua River and allows guests to enjoy the winter wonderland. Integrated in the most luxury residential area and shopping mall, it offers an unprecedented luxury experience in the local market, with the aim to be a new landmark destination for travellers seeking the most sophisticated and luxurious urban accommodation. Contemporary accommodations with a total of 366 extraordinary guest rooms offer river and city views. Four outlets located on the upper floor of the building embrace the dazzling view of the Songhua River while offering a variety of experiences. A further 38,000 square feet of event space allows you to revel in endless opportunities to create bold and brilliant celebrations, fully supported by our talented event planning and catering teams.

hotels.descriptionEn: Welcome to the Fairfield by Marriott Datong hotel ！     The hotel is located on the east side of the ancient city of Datong. It takes no more than 15 minutes by car to reach famous tourist attractions such as Huayan Temple and Nine-Dragon Wall. The Yungang Grotto, is 21KM away from the hotel, the Xuankong Temple & Yingxian Wooden Pagoda,  are 59 KM away from the hotel. At the same time, it is 6.5 KM away from the main transportation hub Datong South Station,  The Datong Yungang International Airport is 14 KM away.      The hotel features 135 guest rooms , all equipped with Simmons JW Marriott custom-designed mattress. Meanwhile, you can enjoy a variety of local and fusion cuisines at the  buffet. Additionally, the hotel offers a 24-hour fitness center and self-service laundry, as well as a 24-hour self-service coffee bar and business space at the Fairfield Shop. Whether for leisure or business travel, the Fairfield by Marriott Datong hotel will provide you with a comfortable and worry-free stay experience!

hotels.descriptionEn: Taiyuan JW Marriott Hotel positions prominently on Qinxian North Street, the prosperous commercial hub of the city. Ensuring seamless accessibility, the hotel's prime position places Taiyuan South Railway Station just under 8 kilometers away and Taiyuan Wusu Airport a short 11-kilometer journey. The hotel boasts 308 guest rooms, each adorned with floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the awe-inspiring Taiyuan skyline.  Three signature restaurants and bars present guests with unique dining experiences with different flavors and 2,214㎡ open and flexible banquet and meeting space offers guests  inspired transformative conference, wedding, or business gathering.JW Marriott Hotel Taiyuan sets to deliver transformative experiences and warm hospitality that reflect the Stay in the Moment® spirit, in this beautiful ancient city with extraordinary services to let guests enjoy the moment and find the balance between spirit, body and soul.

hotels.descriptionZh: “一座晋阳城，半部中国史。”下榻于亲贤北街的福朋喜来登，便是入住晋阳古今交融的时空交点。窗外是亲贤不夜天的繁华星河，脚下是承载三千年文明的晋阳故地。我们以现代工业风融入晋文化精髓的设计礼敬历史，让唐风晋韵在每一处细节中隐约可闻。此处兼具都市风尚与人间烟火，亲贤街一站式满足所有需求，毗邻太原广场、天美新天地、茂业天地等繁华地标，夜幕低垂，楼下几步之遥的酒吧与夜市街，霓虹璀璨、烟火缭绕，蕴藏着太原极为鲜活的夜韵。若偏爱静谧，您也可安居客房，独览窗外星河，遥想千年晋阳的盛世风韵。自此，在交通畅通条件下，自驾或打车探柳巷钟楼街约需18分钟车程，去感受千年商脉的繁华变迁；达太原站、太原高铁南站及武宿国际机场亦仅需约15与19分钟车程，助您高效连接世界。酒店全日制餐厅融合晋地风味，多功能宴会厅适配多样需求。于此，您可白日探寻华夏初曦的文明沉淀，夜晚拥揽龙城不夜天的璀璨入怀。福朋常相伴，邀您沉浸于晋阳的日夜风华。愿您在此，尽享龙城的厚重历史与当代繁华。
hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Taiyuan Downtown is in Taiyuan’s core Qinxian Commercial District. A classic mid-scale select-service Marriott hotel, it offers comfortable stays for business, meeting and leisure guests.Adjacent to Maoye World and Wangfujing, it has easy access to Liuxiang Bell Tower Area and Jinyang Lake Exhibition Center, with convenient transport to Taiyuan Wusu Airport and South Railway Station.Surrounded by Jinci Park, Tianlongshan Grottoes, Twin Pagoda Temple and Mengshan Giant Buddha, guests enjoy Jinyang’s history and scenery.The hotel features modern rooms with branded bedding, high-speed internet, smart controls and panoramic windows. Dining blends Shanxi and international flavors, plus a fitness center, 24-hour laundry and meeting rooms.With prime location, full facilities and thoughtful service, it’s an ideal choice for Taiyuan visitors.

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Ji'an is situated in the city's core. It carries forward the timeless charm of Luling through modern hospitality aesthetics, boasting convenient transportation and a prime location. The hotel features 136 comfortable and elegantly decorated guest rooms, along with two fully-equipped multi-functional meeting rooms. Its brand-new "The Mesh" blends the distinctive cuisines of ancient Luling and contemporary Ji'an with locally selected beers, crafting a delightful taste experience tailored just for you. Complimentary Wi-Fi, available throughout the entire hotel, enables easy socializing and efficient online work. The hotel also offers a 24-hour fitness center, a self-service laundry, and convenient parking facilities, including a large ground parking lot, new energy vehicle charging piles, and an underground parking lot. Upholding the brand promise of "Simplicity with Distinction", Four Points by Sheraton Ji'an is your ideal choice for accommodation during your travels!

hotels.descriptionZh: 南昌喜来登酒店位于全新的中央商业区-红谷滩区，毗邻众多金融、商业与政府机构以及零售和休闲娱乐中心，东临赣江与拥有1300年历史的我国古代四大名楼之一的江南名楼“滕王阁”隔江相望。酒店交通便利，可轻松抵达火车站、高铁站和长途汽车站，距离昌北机场仅30分钟左右车程，地铁2号线红谷中大道地铁站2号口设于酒店正门外。酒店设有347间装潢精美且可欣赏壮丽城或江景的客房和套房。喜来登特色睡眠体验是您忙碌一天之余的理想归宿，予您一夜好眠。酒店拥有4个特色餐厅和2个时尚酒吧，从休闲餐饮到国际风味美食，南昌喜来登酒店提供丰富的饮食体验。从早餐到晚餐，美食爱好者可在盛宴标帜餐厅品尝自助美食，在雅•日式料理餐厅臻享地道日式料理,亦可在羲和雅苑尽享地道北京烤鸭及官府菜。南昌喜来登酒店拥有2300平方米灵活多变的多功能会议空间，包括一个内嵌100屏㎡P3高清LED屏幕的1200平方米的无柱式豪华大宴会厅、9个多功能会议室、1间贵宾厅及贵宾休息室，是各类商务会议的理想选择。更有贴心周到的会议服务团队稳妥地跟进所有细节，确保您每一次的活动都取得圆满成功。位于酒店6层的喜来登健身中心配有先进的健身设备以及各种力量训练器械，为您体能、调节和伸展在内的多种健身选择。清晨或夜晚，没有什么比跃入活力泳池中尽情畅游一番更加令人舒心惬意的享受了。无论您是想在泳池中畅游，还是想在宁静氛围中放松身心，六楼的室内恒温泳池都将是您的理想选择。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the center of the Hong Gu Tan district at the Gan riverfront, Sheraton Nanchang Hotel is an ideal choice for business and leisure. The hotel offers 347 beautifully appointed guest rooms and suites with spectacular city or river views. Stay connected with High Speed Internet Access at the spacious work area or with the 42-inch LCD flat screen TV. And the Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience ensures a blissful night’s rest. Totaling 4 signature restaurants and 1 bar in Sheraton Nanchang Hotel, guests can enjoy a wide variety of culinary options, ranging from casual dining to international delicacies. Sheraton Nanchang Hotel is the ideal location for meetings and events of all sizes, with 2,300 square meters of multi-functional conference space, including a 1,200 square meter deluxe grand pillar-less ballroom, 9 multi-purpose function rooms, a VIP room and boardroom.

hotels.descriptionEn: Fairfield by Marriott Shangrao Xinzhou is a select brand under Marriott International. The hotel offers excellent and professional services for both business and leisure guests, ensuring an unforgettable residential experience. It features 125 guestrooms equipped with Sealy mattresses, skin-friendly bedding, 65-inch LCD TVs, high-speed WiFi, USB charging ports, wireless charging for mobile phones, and safes to cater to the diverse needs of guests.The Fairfield Restaurant has 96 seats where guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast with a variety of options. Additionally, snacks and refreshments are available for purchase at the all-day self-service "24/7 Market." The hotel’s 24/7 well-equipped fitness center allows guests to maintain their exercise routines while traveling; the 24/7 self-service laundry also provides guests with more convenience and flexibility.

Sheraton Beihai Resort features 218 guest rooms and suites, two restaurants and one coffee bar, with leisure facilities including Fitness center, Outdoor swimming pool and Kids club, and 1,200 square meters of flexible spaces for banquets and conferences.  Enjoying an unforgettable vacation experience, guests may revel in local delicacies or international gourmets here, and experience a variety of leisure facilities such as side by side family program etc.

hotels.descriptionZh: 1、商务休闲两不误 酒店位于桂林全新的商业及行政区，将为您带来高品质的舒适与便利体验。酒店所在的综合大楼设有一家零售商场，距行政机关和企业办事处也近在咫尺。2、丰富多彩的娱乐选择 您可跃入室内温水泳池尽情畅游，或是前往健身俱乐部为自己的健康充电。来到酒店大堂享受免费无线高速上网接入。还可光临大堂吧，畅饮醇饮优选™计划中的冰爽啤酒，或是品尝一杯新鲜现煮的香浓咖啡，放松身心。在全日制宜客乐餐厅以全套早餐开启美好的一天，然后在聚味中餐厅享用美味可口的午餐或晚餐。酒店拥有总面积超过1,600平米的灵活会议空间，均配有先进超凡的技术设施，是您举办成功商务活动的理想选择。3、 酒店拥有242间房，经过一整天的商务活动或观光之旅后，在舒适宜人的客房中放松休憩，尽情饱览壮观迷人的城市美景。房内的贴心设施包括无线网络、纯平电视和我们的福朋特色的“舒适之床”。
hotels.descriptionEn: Business, Leisure or Both.  The Four Points by Sheraton Guilin, Lingui offers uncomplicated comforts and a convenient location in the heart of Lingui, Guilin’s new business and administrative district.  Our hotel’s complex includes a retail mall with  administrative organization nearby. Plenty of Options. Take a dip in the indoor heated pool or work up a sweat in the health club.  Enjoy wireless High-Speed Internet Access in our lobby.  That’s also where you’ll find our lounge, where you can relax with a freshly-brewed coffee or sample the International beers in our selection of Best Brews™.  Start your day with a full breakfast at the Eatery, our all-day dining restaurant and have a delicious lunch or dinner at China Spice.

hotels.descriptionZh: 桂林喜来登饭店坐落在桂林市中心滨江路漓江畔，步行可达象鼻山、东西巷、逍遥楼、靖江王府、日月双塔等景点。东倚秀丽的漓江，南傍迷人的象鼻山，近览七星公园，北望伏波山、叠彩诸峰，地理位置优越。酒店距火车站仅约4公里，驱车约40分钟可抵达桂林两江国际机场，交通十分便利。酒店焕新客房已闪亮登场，全新客房融入淡雅的桂林山水元素，既拥有轻奢雅致的现代风格，又不失水墨丹青的意境，将给您带来活力焕发的入住体验。酒店曾成功接待外国总统、王子等重要贵宾，并获得了来自客人：“优秀的工作态度以及高尚的职业道德”的高度赞扬。
hotels.descriptionEn: Transform your trip to China with a stay at Sheraton Guilin Hotel, an ideally located hotel in Guilin, on the banks of the Li River close to Zhengyang Walking Street, Elephant Trunk Hill and Fubo Mountain. Our family-friendly hotel boasts 408 newly renovated, well-appointed guest rooms, many of which overlook the beautiful Li River or garden and all offering complimentary Wi-Fi and Sheraton Signature beds for a good night's sleep. Upgrade to one of our spacious suites or Club level rooms to access the Club lounge with complimentary benefits. Guests can relax at our hotel's state-of-the-art leisure gym and outdoor pool, or experience a delicious meal at our restaurants, as well as in-room dining. For those wishing to host a meeting or special event in Guilin, China, our hotel has an array of inspiring spaces complete with smart technology and bespoke planning services to ensure a successful day.

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Guilin Central is situated in the prime downtown core of Guilin, surrounded by renowned cultural attractions, commercial districts and shopping malls. Adjacent to iconic sites including Elephant Trunk Hill, Two Rivers and Four Lakes, and EastWest Lane, the hotel is within walking distance of Zhengyang Pedestrian Street and local food streets. Approximately 3 kilometers from Guilin Railway Station, it offers seamless access to Guilin Liangjiang International Airport. Boasting an unbeatable location, it serves as an ideal starting point for business and leisure travelers to explore Guilin’s natural landscapes and urban charm.Its design blends contemporary light‑luxury aesthetics with Guilin’s natural charm. Embracing minimalist elegance and fluid lines, it balances modern style with comfort, making it ideal for business and leisure stays

hotels.descriptionZh: 桂林中心万怡酒店坐落于桂林市七星区三金广场，是万豪国际酒店集团旗下精心打造的商务与休闲融合型酒店。酒店与著名景点“七星公园”仅数步之遥，距离桂林城徽“象鼻山”仅十分钟车程。周边商业配套成熟，毗邻甲天下会展中心、客世界广场、益华城广场，交通便捷，让您轻松饱览桂林山水与城市风光的双重魅力。酒店拥有133间精致客房，为商旅及度假宾客营造舒适高效的居停空间。餐饮休闲设施一应俱全：设有全日制餐厅，提供汇聚中西的特色美馔；大堂吧则是悠然小憩的理想之选。此外，酒店配备泳池、健身房以及24小时自助洗衣房，让您在旅途中亦能保持活力与便捷。酒店还设有儿童乐园，打造快乐的童趣时光。商务配套200平米的多功能会议室，可满足各类中小型会议、培训的需求，专业设施与服务团队将确保每一场活动圆满举办。选择桂林中心万怡酒店，即是选择国际品牌的安心保障与七星区的便捷地理优势，无论商务出行还是休闲旅游，这里都将成为您探索桂林的理想起点。
hotels.descriptionEn: Courtyard by Marriott Guilin Downtown is located at SanJin Plaza in Qixing District, Guilin. As a meticulously crafted business and leisure hotel under Marriott International, it is just steps away from the renowned Seven Star Park and a ten-minute drive from Elephant Trunk Hill, the iconic symbol of Guilin. Surrounded by mature commercial facilities, it neighbors the Jiatianxia Convention Center, Ke World Plaza, and Yihua City Plaza. With convenient transportation, you can effortlessly experience the dual charm of Guilin's natural landscapes and urban scenery.

Our 242 guest rooms are designed for maximum flexibility, with a minimalism look to ensure travelers of a flawless experience. Begin your morning with an energizing workout in our well-equipped fitness center, and enjoy a buffet breakfast before setting off.

The distinctive Dong culture-themed building, in the center of verdant trees, incorporates 305 comfortable rooms, indoor and outdoor swimming pools and fitness facilities. And natural scenery with Rongjiang River, Xunjiang River and Rongjiang River.Courtyard by Marriott Liuzhou Sanjiang features the immersive “Dong Style  Traveler" Butler Service, which offers considerate customized check-in assistance, delicious new-style Guangxi & Guangdong cuisines, fresh and carefully-cooked Japanese cuisine, international catering experience and rich activities. hotels.descriptionZh: 南宁龙光那莲豪华精选酒店，坐落于南宁市东盟商务区高层地标建筑-龙光世纪A塔，开业于2019年9月6日，设计灵感取自于月妹的故事（深受广西壮族欢迎的传奇故事）。酒店拥有290间客房和套房，3间餐厅和1间酒廊。开阔的空中视野和舒适的天际体验。逾1700平方米的宴会空间，为高端商旅宾客提供卓越的会议服务。酒店毗邻龙光蓝鲸天地，步行五分钟可到达地铁站，驱车五分钟可到达南宁国际会展中心。作为南宁标志性的万豪集团旗下豪华品牌酒店，那莲酒店将邀请旅行家们探索南宁独特璀璨的魅力。
hotels.descriptionEn: Set as the high-rise landmark in the ASEAN Business District in Nanning, opening on 6 September 2019, Na Lotus Hotel offers distinctive Chinese experience with captivating grandeur. The indigenous design of the hotel pays homage to the legend of Zhuang minority – Yuemei. For those in search of luxury and space, Na Lotus Hotel has a wide range of 290 rooms and suites, all of which are elegantly presented with panoramic views.  No Epicurean Journey is complete without a feast inspired by local traditions. Yun Yue serves fresh Cantonese Dim Sum and delicious hot pot. While Na Lian, the Chinese restaurant offers authentic Guangxi and Cantonese cuisine. Spend an evening under the stars at Sky Lounge and enjoy a drink with the transcendent skyline view of Nanning. The Clouds presents a worldly dining venue featuring international cuisine. With over 1,700 square meters of banquet space including one pillar-less Grand Ballroom, the hotel is ideal for guests who are planning a meeting, conference or any special event.

hotels.descriptionZh: 南宁万丽酒店地处五象新区，是前往中国-东盟金融城游览和参加活动期间的理想下榻之选。酒店大堂洋溢着热情的广西壮族文化，并巧妙融入雨季、露台、休闲、集市、民歌等五大引入入胜的主题，生动展现出这座现代都市的迷人风情。雅致迷人的 R Bar，供应咖啡、自制烘焙糕点和手调鸡尾酒。步入时尚的客房和套房，乐享静谧舒适的空间，体验宽敞浴室和众多贴心周到的用品。而在万丽水疗中心，则以同样安静祥和的氛围传递愉悦人心的健康理念。还有超大的泳池和健身中心，让您尽情焕发身心活力。酒店提供丰富多彩的餐饮选择，包括洋溢全球美食灵感的 Commissary Pantry 餐厅、供应美味牛排和薯条的 Maison Ribeye 餐厅、万丽轩中餐厅，客人更可前往装潢精美的 Mill & Co and Floral Studio 餐厅，一边乐享精致下午茶和糕点，一边参与别开生面的插花课程。
hotels.descriptionEn: Set in Wuxiang New District, the new Renaissance Nanning Hotel introduces a journey of discovery and noteworthy events to China-ASEAN Financial Town. The lobby is designed to reflect the modern city that surrounds it, warmed by a sense of the cordial Guangxi Zhuang culture and five evocative local themes – rainy season, terrace, rest, market and folk song. This is where guests can find the R Bar, a refined space to connect and enjoy coffee, home-baked items and crafted cocktails. Modern guest rooms and suites are steeped in serenity and style, with spacious bathrooms and thoughtful appointments. This sense of calm flows to The Spa at Renaissance and its blissful passage to wellness. And to enliven, a large swimming pool and fitness center await. Dining options abound, including the globally-inspired Commissary Pantry Restaurant; Maison Ribeye Restaurant for luscious steaks and fries; Wan Li Xuan Restaurant; and the beautiful Mill & Co and Floral Studio for afternoon tea, pastries and flower arranging class.

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Nanning is located in the China-Asean Pilot Free Trade Zone, Liangqing District Feilong Road No. 6, Line 4 subway station Feilong Road Exit E direct access; Leisure walk to Yongjiang River, Sports center, headquarters base; 10 minutes drive to 5A Qingxiu Mountain Scenic spot; Adjacent to Guangxi Culture and Art Center, the business complex IKEA and Longguang Blue Whale World provide great convenience for guests' business travel and leisure and entertainment.The hotel has 141 rooms, including comfortable queen room, twin room and executive suite, with high-speed Wi-Fi, high-quality bedding and soundproofing system to ensure deep sleep, executive floor minibar, smart appliances and more. The hotel is also equipped with a variety of facilities and services, all-day restaurant, pizza bar, fitness center, laundromat, 600 square meters sky garden, multi-functional ballroom, 120 square meters luxury tea room and pet park, to meet the different needs of guests.

hotels.descriptionZh: 南宁鑫伟万豪酒店位于广西南宁市中心东区，距南宁吴圩国际机场约 35 分钟路程，距南宁火车东站约需15分钟，位于南宁地铁1号线会展中心站，交通便利。南宁鑫伟万豪酒店设于航洋国际城，距南宁市政府和大型购物中心咫尺之遥。酒店斜对面即是南宁国际会展中心，该中心是一年一度的中国-东盟博览会的固定会址。酒店拥有 328 间客房及套房，均能欣赏迷人的城市景观。所有客房的装饰均采用国际标准，配备纯平电视、高速上网接入及其它众多先进设施，融舒适性与功能性于一体。酒店拥有1230平方米的会议活动空间，大宴会厅面积为704平方米，可分割成三个单元，4个多功能会议厅，面积由40平方米至70平方米不等，场地配备全套音频/视频设备，所有会议场地提供高速互联网连接。
hotels.descriptionEn: Nanning Marriott Hotel is ideally located in the eastern area of Nanning City Center in China's Guangxi Region 35 minutes from Nanning Wuxu International Airport and 15 minutes from Nanning East Railway Station. Our hotel is part of Hangyang International Center, within walking distance of Nanning Municipal Government Office and the MixC mall. Nanning International Convention & Exhibition Center, the permanent seat for the annual China ASEAN Expo is just diagonally across from the hotel. Enjoy modern comforts in our 328 rooms and suites, some of which offer spectacular city views. All accommodations are furnished with technology including a flat-screen TV and high-speed internet access as well as a full array of home-like amenities. Savor a meal at one of our two onsite restaurants. With 1,230 square meters of meeting and banquet facilities we offer a space that is just right for any event in downtown Nanning.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Four Points by Sheraton Huangguoshu Hotel is located at No. 230, Boyuan Road, Huangguoshu Tourist Area, Zhenning Buyi and Miao Autonomous County, Anshun City, Guizhou Province. It is adjacent to the Huangguoshu National Scenic Area and only 2 kilometers away from the core scenic area, with convenient transportation. The hotel is surrounded by green trees and mountains. The guest rooms offer views of the karst landform and the sunset. The hotel offers different experiences throughout the four seasons (enjoying flowers in spring, watching waterfalls in summer, tasting fruits in autumn, and enjoying health care in winter). The hotel is surrounded by rich tourism resources. Besides the Huangguoshu Waterfall, it is also convenient to visit the Stone Village Scenic Area, the 1000-year-old Buyi Ancient Village of Gaodang, and Loong Palace.

Sheraton Hotels & Resorts continues its transformation journey with the opening of Sheraton Lanzhou Anning, offering its signature community spaces in the city’s core Anning District. The hotel has an advantaged location, close to metro station, with Yellow River in a very short distance away and Yellow River Tower across the river. Ideally located just 150 meters walk away from the nearest station exit and 5.5 kilometers from the Lanzhouxi Railway Station, the 353-room hotel is in accessible reach for both business and leisure travelers. Guests will also be delighted by the hotel’s signature culinary offerings of &More by Sheraton, a combination of bar, coffee bar, and a market, all-day-dining restaurant Daily Social, Unspoken Bar, Soo Noodles, and Chinese restaurant Yue. Additional facilities include the Sheraton Club for Marriott Bonvoy elite members, a 1,900 square meters of flexible meeting and banquet space, and leisure spaces such as a fitness center and an indoor swimming pool.

hotels.descriptionZh: 从这里去探索阿勒泰如诗如画的风景，阿勒泰市福朋喜来登酒店将永恒经典的设计和当地元素细节相融。酒店位于阿勒泰市区, 将舒适与便利相结合, 是您商务出行或度假旅游的品质之选。酒店毗邻阿禾公路入口，地理位置优越，交通便利，距阿勒泰站20分钟车程，阿勒泰雪都机场16分钟车程。12分钟车程亦可轻松抵达五百里风情街，桦林公园，将军山国际滑雪场等热门旅游打卡目的地。酒店客房均配有智能家居，结合福朋轻奢简约的设计理念，为入住宾客提供都市旅居全新体验。宾客可在酒店玩啤食社享用中西融合佳肴，还有本地特色精选美食，开启满满活力一天。24小时的健身中心和配备先进洗烘设备的洗衣房，满足各类宾客多样需求。酒店一层集美食、咖啡、醇饮优选Best Brews精酿及休闲放松等生活方式于一体的多元社交空间，是旅享家商务休闲、移动办公的个性之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: From found objects collected over time to our Best Brews program, featuring locally sourced craft beers on taps, everything we do shows our respect for great design and a sense of the local. Delicious breakfast to start the day right, casual and modern dining options in the evening, plus free wifi throughout the hotel enable guests to stay in touch both socially and at work. Plus, at Four Points workouts are not confined to just to the gym, we've partnerered with Your Trainer to bring personal training and exclusive workouts right to your smart phone and tablet. Designed with the traveler in mind, Four Points offers all the essentials needed to kick back and relax.

hotels.descriptionEn: The hotel is located in the downtown area of Altay City. It is an 18-minute drive from Altay Xuedu Airport, a 21-minute drive from Altay Railway Station, and a 14-minute drive from the Altay City Ski Resort. It takes approximately 3 hours and 30 minutes to drive to Kanas, Hemu, and Koktokay respectively. The Chinese restaurant features luxurious private dining rooms with distinctive styles. The surrounding area is equipped with comprehensive facilities, including restaurants, bathhouses, and KTVs. The entire hotel staff looks forward to your visit.

The brand’s design philosophy blends contemporary elegance with curated local character—where sleek lines, rich textures, and expressive materials set the tone. Every space features layered storytelling: modern artworks converse with handcrafted decor, and architectural gestures echo the heritage of their surroundings. Guests are not merely accommodated—they are sparked with curiosity, encouraged to pause, look closer, and uncover the unexpected in every detail.

hotels.descriptionZh: 新疆赛里木湖AC酒店位于海拔2073米的“西域净海”-赛里木湖畔，坐落于景区东岸的天境里度假区，举步即达赛湖景区东门入口。天境里购物中心紧邻酒店，轻松悦享购物、娱乐、用餐一站式体验。AC酒店“少即是多”的设计理念于天山湖光中勾勒出“功能与美学共生”的旅居新典范，155间客房均配备55英寸高清液晶电视、步入式淋浴间、空调与暖气及免费高速Wi-Fi等设施。酒店共配备AC餐厅及AC咖啡吧，为宾客打造横跨欧亚风味的独特饮用餐体验。为全球旅行者带来一场“精简于形、细致于心”的沉浸式旅行体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: AC Hotel by Marriott Xinjiang Sayram Lake is located beside the "Western Region's Pure Sea" – Sayram Lake – at an altitude of 2,073 meters. Nestled within the Paradise Town on the eastern shore of the scenic area, it is just steps away from the East Gate entrance of Sayram Lake. Adjacent to the hotel is the Paradise Town, offering effortless access to shopping, entertainment, and dining in a one-stop experience.Embodying AC Hotel's design philosophy of "less is more" amidst the Tianshan mountain and lake scenery, the hotel sketches a new paradigm of hospitality where "functionality and aesthetics coexist." All 155 guest rooms are equipped with 55-inch HD LCD TVs, walk-in showers, air conditioning and heating, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi.The hotel features both an AC Restaurant and AC Cafe, crafting a unique dining and drinking experience with flavors spanning Europe and Asia. It offers global travelers an immersive travel experience that is "The Perfectly Precise Hotel."

hotels.descriptionZh: 拉萨瑞吉度假酒店坐拥古老八廓区亘古不变的繁荣盛景之中，于富有传奇色彩的旅游目的地，缔造一处非凡豪华住宿佳选。酒店可俯瞰西藏的奇妙景观和宏伟的布达拉宫，激动人心的感受带来焕活身心的震撼体验。酒店客房和套房布置时尚、装饰现代，各类豪华设施一应俱全，迷人美景一览无遗，并饰以灵感源自附近色拉寺的特别图案，缔造轻松愉悦的住宿体验。酒店还设有别具特色的餐厅，可在此品尝令人垂涎的中餐和美味可口的国际美食，精彩纷呈的感官盛宴尽在此间。探索闻达四海的景点，包括大昭寺、八廓街和富有传奇色彩的布达拉宫。活动空间典雅高贵、设计脱俗，是欢庆成功会议、高雅婚礼和难忘社交活动的理想之选。一整天繁忙工作和充实观光之余，在我们度假酒店水疗中心惬意享受焕活神采与活力的护理。我们风景优美的酒店位于具有浓厚传奇色彩的“世界屋脊”，是您造访西藏时的理想下榻之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Set amid the timeless splendor of the ancient Barkhor area, The St. Regis Lhasa Resort offers luxury accommodation in a legendary travel destination. Discover a rejuvenating respite overlooking the wondrous Xizang landscape and magnificent Potala Palace. Embrace effortless relaxation in stylishly appointed hotel rooms and suites with contemporary essentials, luxury amenities, stunning views and motifs inspired by the nearby Sera Monastery. Ignite your senses with delectable Chinese cuisine and flavorful international fare in our distinctive restaurants. Explore storied attractions including Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street and the legendary Potala Palace. Celebrate and succeed in sophisticated event space, masterfully designed for flawless meetings, elegant weddings and memorable social engagements. Punctuate a full day of work or sightseeing with a rejuvenating treatment at our resort spa. Situated at the legendary "Roof of the World," our hotel is a scenic haven for your visit to Xizang.

hotels.descriptionZh: 入住豪华的香港 JW 万豪酒店, 追随心之所向, 获享精彩体验。酒店坐落于高雅时尚的香港金钟区太古广场, 与金钟港铁站相连, 可供四线转乘, 无缝接驳中国深圳福田及罗湖口岸。 从酒店出发, 可便利前往香港中环的各大名店、餐厅及办公楼；此外, 酒店还紧邻兰桂坊和太平山。酒店客房温馨雅致, 提供免费 Wi-Fi, 配备豪华寝具和现代设施, 宾客还可在房内饱览维多利亚港、翠绿山峦或璀璨闪耀的天际线景观, 是理想的度假酒店。酒店餐饮选项丰富, 从米其林星級粤菜餐厅、配备现场烹饪站且氛围欢快的全日餐厅, 到海鲜餐厅和时尚酒廊, 您可随心挑选。酒店场地富有特色, 包括无柱式宴会厅、露天场地和现代会议室, 您可在此规划您在香港的下一场会议或社交活动, 获得悦心体验。酒店优越的地理位置可便利前往周边地区, 满足您的探索乐趣。欢迎入住香港五星级酒店 JW 万豪酒店, 悦享尊贵度假体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Revitalize body, mind and spirit when you stay at the 5-star JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong. Located above Pacific Place and connected directly to the Admiralty MTR station with four-line interchanging, our downtown hotel offers easy access to the shops, dining and businesses of Hong Kong Central along with Victoria Peak and Lan Kwai Fong. Warmly designed, sophisticated hotel rooms feature complimentary WiFi, deluxe bedding, modern amenities and views over Victoria Harbour, the scenic mountains or the glittering downtown skyline. Dining venues range from a Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant and an all-day restaurant with live kitchens to an alfresco seafood bar and a stylish lounge. Plan your next meeting or social function in Hong Kong and be delighted with distinctive venues including a pillarless ballroom, outdoor spaces and contemporary conference rooms. If you are interested in exploring, our prime location makes it easy to discover the city. Your 5-star escape awaits at JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong.

hotels.descriptionZh: 香港，繁华的摩天都市，现代化的高楼矗立于迷宫般的大街小巷，都市人穿梭其中，到处都充斥着跃动急速的生活节拍。香港W酒店，其设计呼应着璀璨中别具个性的都市色彩，让宾客犹如置身在魔法森林里。酒店的设计由两位非凡的室内设计师，包括日本Glamorous的Yasumichi Morita和澳洲g+a的Nic Graham一手操办，特意打造W的醉人体验。393间客房皆充满着艺术意味，在这活力都市中，展现生活的时尚。魔法森林里，香港W 酒店非凡闪烁，精彩体验，在这里展开。
hotels.descriptionEn: Go further at W Hong Kong. Our West Kowloon hotel in Hong Kong redefines how you spend your time on the road. With our location near Kowloon Station, you have easy access to Airport Express, mainland China and Hong Kong's best sites and bites. Experience the city center at Tsim Sha Tsui or Central with a short drive or station stop. Connect with trendy destinations such as West Kowloon Cultural District, and when you return to our Kowloon luxury hotel, fuel up at KITCHEN with sumptuous worldwide cuisine or take a sip at our social hub WOOBAR. One of the highest rooftop pools in Hong Kong is our WET Pool and Deck boasting electrifying views of the city and Victoria Harbour. For meetings, weddings and special events with extra punch and pizzazz, book our Great Room. Award-winning Bliss Spa is our five-star amenity waiting to sweep you off your feet, while our rooms and suites do the same but in a different way. Keep it fun for the whole family with a pet-friendly hotel room at W Hong Kong.

hotels.descriptionZh: 位於香港岛铜锣湾繁华的中心地带，柏宁酒店地理位置优越，客人可轻松抵达市内高级购物中心丶餐饮和娱乐胜地。酒店拥有820间舒适丶时尚的客房和套房，适合商务和休闲旅客。客人可尽情享受一系列设施，包括配备齐全的健身中心丶尊贵的行政酒廊以及多样化的餐饮选择，满足各种口味。柏宁酒店以知名的自助餐厅PLAYT而闻名，客人还可在着名的天台酒吧SKYE 或舒适的Ebb & Flow大堂酒廊放松身心，享受美好时光。酒店设有宽敞的会议及活动空间，适合各种场合，是在香港其中一个举办聚会的首选之地。入住柏宁酒店，为您在香港繁忙的城市风景中提供一段难忘的旅程。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the vibrant heart of Causeway Bay on Hong Kong Island, The Park Lane Hong Kong, Autograph Collection offers unparalleled access to the city's top shopping, dining, and entertainment destinations. With 820 guestrooms and suites tailored for both business and leisure travelers, guests can indulge in amenities like a well-equipped fitness center, an exclusive executive lounge, and diverse dining options to satisfy every palate.The Park Lane hotel in Hong Kong Island is home to the popular buffet restaurant PLAYT. Guests can also unwind at the renowned rooftop bar SKYE or the inviting lobby lounge, perfect for relaxation and drinks. The hotel features spacious event spaces suitable for various occasions, making it a prime choice for gatherings in one of Hong Kong's most iconic neighborhoods.Experience luxury and convenience at The Park Lane Hong Kong, where sophistication and comfort blend seamlessly to offer a memorable stay in the heart of Hong Kong's bustling landscape.

hotels.descriptionEn: Find serenity at Four Points by Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung. Ideal for business and leisure travelers, our Lantau Island, HK, hotel offers the local Best Brews craft beer program. Enjoy Tung Chung Kitchen's flavors or quick bites at The Harbor Lounge. Explore Lantau Island's trails, Citygate Outlet Mall, Hong Kong Disneyland and the Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car, Big Buddha and Tai O, all just minutes away. Easy access to Asia World-Expo, Hong Kong International Airport, Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge and Shenzhen Bay simplifies travel even more for business and leisure guests. Rest comfortably in our hotel rooms or suites after a day of adventure. Host memorable events with the help of our meeting planners. Discover travel reinvented at Four Points by Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung. Your unforgettable stay and extraordinary journey is made even more unforgettable and extraordinary when you take advantage of our exclusive hotel in Lantau, Hong Kong, deals and vacation packages.

hotels.descriptionEn: Discover a greener side to Hong Kong on Lantau Island from Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung Hotel. Located in a residential community and commercial hub, our luxury hotel in Hong Kong is perfect for your next business or leisure escape. Lush landscapes await, as our hotel near Hong Kong Disneyland showcases scenic mountain and sea views with renowned trails nearby. With access to the international airport, the China border and the city via MTR, this Hong Kong five-star hotel makes traveling easy. Stay active in our extensive gym, relax on our inviting pool deck and dine on island-inspired fare at our rooftop grill. Other sophisticated restaurants at hotel include a modern Chinese eatery, Sheraton Patisserie and international all-day dining. Business travelers in Hong Kong appreciate our event venues that offer 3,400 sqm of indoor and outdoor space, including one of the area’s largest ballrooms. After a fun day on Lantau Island, return to one of our 218 rooms featuring full-length windows with scenic views.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎下榻香港亲子酒店 - 海洋公园万豪酒店。酒店位于美丽的香港岛南岸，地理位置优越，四周自然风光优美，客房风格优雅，配备一系列令人印象深刻且贴心的设施，是商务与休闲旅行者的理想住宿之选。步入酒店大堂，率先映入眼帘的是约16米高的水族景观，壮观非凡，惹人赞叹。酒店设有简约现代的客房、套房及三个独立主题的房型，入住部分套房更可尊享万豪贵宾廊礼遇。此外，酒店内还设有自助餐餐厅、酒吧、中菜厅以及特色牛排餐厅，酒店设有中央礁湖主题游泳池、氛围宁静的水疗中心以及大型无柱式宴会厅，是举办商务活动或社交聚会的理想选地。酒店距离适合全家畅玩的海洋公园仅数步之遥，且紧邻水上乐园及浅水湾等知名景点。选择香港海洋公园万豪酒店，享受更加卓越的旅行体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Choose Hong Kong Ocean Park Marriott Hotel for your next getaway. Boasting a pristine location on the island's southern coast, our resort hotel in Hong Kong​ treats travelers to impressive sights and amenities. Enjoy bridge access to Ocean Park, free shuttles to Water World and a 50-foot-tall aquarium of island flora and fauna in our hotel lobby. When you're ready to unwind, our Ocean Park hotel in Hong Kong features spacious accommodations with three different room themes and some suites offering M Club Lounge access. Enjoy one of our many on-site restaurants, bistros, lounges or bars, with 24-hour room service also available for all-day dining. Our lagoon-style pool and tranquil spa rethink relaxation, while our pillarless ballroom reinvents meetings, weddings and events. Chic designs and catering make us the right destination for teambuilding exercises, breakout sessions and more. Offering a wide range of services and facilities, Hong Kong Ocean Park Marriott Hotel caters to short and long-stay guests.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Hong Kong stands majestically in Tsim Sha Tsui, within the vibrant West Kowloon District. Perched atop the International Commerce Centre and Elements Shopping Mall, the hotel is just steps from notable cultural landmarks such as M+ and Hong Kong Palace Museum, as well as the Kai Tak Stadium for concerts and world-class events. With convenient access to the High-Speed Railway Station and Airport Express, reaching the airport in just 21 minutes. Occupying floors 106 to 118, all rooms and suites feature breathtaking views of the Hong Kong skyline and Victoria Harbour from 490 meters above sea level. The hotel boasts five dining venues, including Michelin-starred dining experience from authentic Cantonese cuisine at Tin Lung Heen, innovative Italian fine dining at Tosca di Angelo, exquisite lunch and dinner buffet at Café 103, delightful afternoon tea at The Lounge and Bar, and lively nightlife at Ozone on level 118.

hotels.descriptionEn: The Mira Hong Kong is a member of Design Hotels™, a partner hotel of Marriott Bonvoy ®, and a contemporary urban retreat overlooking lush Kowloon Park in the heart of Hong Kong’s shopping, dining and entertainment district, Tsimshatsui. Modern interiors, personalized service, and 492 smoke-free guestrooms with 56 suites bristling with latest tech-friendly features, such as pocket WiFi device for use on the go with unlimited 4G connectivity, sound system and free Wi-Fi across the hotel, define each luxurious stay. Six chic dining concepts with 2 Michelin-recommended restaurants and the award-winning MiraSpa housing 21st century wellness facilities, indoor infinity pool and 24/7 gym, add to the experience.

hotels.descriptionZh: 香港瑞吉酒店反映了香港知名室内设计师傅厚民（André Fu）的愿景，融合瑞吉品牌经典元素与时尚精致格调于一体，巧妙地彰显了香港的多元文化与典雅韵味。酒店共设有 127 间装饰考究的客房与套房，并辅以东西方文化元素，提供理想入住体验；同时，品牌标志性的管家服务精雕细琢每一个细节，悉心照顾客人的需求。香港瑞吉酒店拥有两间米其林星级餐厅 — 由法籍主厨Olivier Elzer执掌的米其林二星L’Envol法国餐厅和洪志光师傅主理的米其林二星「润」中餐厅。 The Drawing Room大堂酒廊供应全天国际美食和别具特色的下午茶，瑞吉酒吧则提供 14 款灵感源自香港和纽约的招牌鸡尾酒。
hotels.descriptionEn: Reflecting the unique vision of St. Regis through the eyes of interior designer André Fu, our hotel on Hong Kong Island is a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai district that masterfully blends creative architecture, diverse cultures and timeless elegance. Our luxury hotel is home to a two-MICHELIN-starred French restaurant helmed by Chef Olivier Elzer and a two-MICHELIN-starred Chinese restaurant headed by Chef Hung Chi-Kwong. The Drawing Room hosts traditional Afternoon Teas with all-day international dining while The St. Regis Bar crafts signature cocktails inspired by a tale of two cities Hong Kong and New York. East meets West in our thoughtfully designed, five-star hotel rooms while panoramic views of the harbor are available to those who upgrade to our select hotel suites. At The St. Regis Hong Kong, discerning expertise and bespoke indulgence provide you with the key to an exquisite stay in Wan Chai district.

hotels.descriptionEn: Situated on the banks of the Shing Mun River, Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong Sha Tin blends modern style with thoughtful design, offering stunning riverside and cityscape views. Just a five-minute walk from Shek Mun MTR Station, the hotel provides seamless connectivity to major destinations—including Kai Tak Stadium and the HK Convention and Exhibition Centre, both reachable in under 30 minutes. Guests enjoy easy access to premier shopping, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and Sha Tin Racecourse. Indulge in exceptional dining, from an international buffet at MoMo Café to refined cuisine and cocktails at LEVELthirty Lounge & Bar. Stay active in our 24-hour gym, relax by the outdoor pool, or play pickleball at the landscaped area. For business travelers, our versatile event venues feature pillar-less ballrooms and advanced audiovisual technology. Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong Sha Tin delivers everything you need for a seamless and memorable stay.

hotels.descriptionEn: Located within SKYCITY on Lantau Island, the Hong Kong SkyCity Marriott Hotel is a premium destination for business and leisure travel. Just five minutes away from the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge (HZMB)-Hong Kong Port, the hotel directly connects to AsiaWorld-Expo. Our spacious room accommodations, starting from 377 sqft, feature modern amenities to enhance your comfort. Savor delectable cuisine at one of our five on-site restaurants, rejuvenate your senses at our Quan Spa, or take a refreshing swim in our heated indoor pool. An ideal setting for events of any scale, the hotel’s 14 versatile meeting venues span over 13,000 sqft. Our prime location allows easy exploration of Lantau’s attractions, including Hong Kong Disneyland, Citygate Outlets, Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car, The Big Buddha, Tai O Fishing Village, and the soon-to-open 11SKIES. For added convenience, complimentary shuttle service to and from the Airport, and Tung Chung MTR Station is provided.

hotels.descriptionEn: Step into Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel where every moment transforms into an extraordinary experience. With a great location in vibrant Wan Chai our hotel places all of Hong Kong Island at your fingertips for a business trip or family holiday. We are also attached to the Convention and Exhibition Centre. Settle into your modern hotel room or suite with a view of either our lush gardens, our shimmering outdoor pool or famous Victoria Harbour. Enjoy thoughtful perks like complimentary WiFi, comfortable bedding, a flat-screen TV and a marble bathroom. You will be delighted by our fantastic hotel amenities such as exquisite cuisine at the award-winning Dynasty restaurant, a tennis court and a 24 hour fitness center. Select our hotel to host your event in Wan Chai and benefit from stately ballroom venue space, seasoned planning and catering teams and an accessible location. Trust Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel to provide you with what you need for a memorable experience.

hotels.descriptionEn: Whether you are visiting Hong Kong for business or pleasure, Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong helps you move forward. Strategically nestled near the bustling Central Business District and the HKU station on the Island Line of the MTR subway, our hotel in Hong Kong, China offers unparalleled convenience. With our complimentary scheduled hotel shuttle bus service and excellent access to various public transportation options, your daily commute becomes effortless. Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) is a mere 40-minute drive away, while the West Kowloon High Speed Rail Station, connecting you to Chinese Mainland, is just 10 minutes away. Intuitively designed, our Sai Ying Pun hotel offers a 12-person event room, Hong Kong travel packages and everything you need to stay ahead in Hong Kong Island, China. Rooms and suites include plush Marriott bedding, flat-screen LCD TVs, marble bathrooms and scenic views of Victoria Harbour. Upgrade to an Executive Level room for exclusive access to an Executive Lounge.
