hotels.descriptionZh: 问月酒店是 Mira 酒店系列旗下的精品酒店，由名家设计师 Wanders & YOO 领衔创意设计。酒店拥有 88 间别具特色的客房和一间顶层套房，提供五种客房类型，以现代形式演绎中国中秋节神话。所有客房配备免费 Wi-Fi、内置 Chromecast 娱乐系统、包含国际标准插座、S-Video 和 HDMI 的多媒体接口、HEPA 过滤空气净化、高清 LED 网络电视、奈斯派索咖啡机和胶囊咖啡。豪华精品问月酒店位于香港岛繁华的铜锣湾中心位置，是充满活力的娱乐区的一部分，附近有时代广场、崇光百货和希慎广场等景点。问月酒店也是香港会展中心步行范围内仅有的一间设计酒店。
hotels.descriptionEn: Mira Moon is a boutique hotel within the Mira Hotel Collection conceived under the creative direction of the famous design guru – Wanders & YOO. Equipped with 88 one-of-a-kind guestrooms and a penthouse suite, all five guestroom types of Mira Moon are the modern rendition of the Chinese Mid-Autumn Festival mythology. All rooms are equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, Built-in Chromecast Entertainment System, Multi-media connectivity includes international plug sockets, S-Video Jack and HDMI, Hepa filter air purification, HD LED IPTV, and Nespresso coffee machine with capsules. Located at the heart of bustling Causeway Bay on Hong Kong Island, the 5-star boutique hotel Mira Moon is part of the vibrant entertainment district with landmarks like Times Square, Sogo and Hysan Place. Mira Moon also boasts as the only Design hotel within a few minutes’ walk from Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

hotels.descriptionEn: Discover the many sides of Kowloon from the refined serenity of Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers. Enviably located in the bustling Tsim Sha Tsui, our Hong Kong hotel in Kowloon is near Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station is steps away from premier public transportation options, such as Express Rail Link and the ferry terminal, as well as Harbour City, K11 Musea and commercial hubs. Make time for yourself in our health club and sauna, including a stunning rooftop pool with views of Victoria Harbour. When hunger strikes, dine in sophisticated restaurants, serving authentic Chinese, Japanese and International fare. Unwind in Kowloon in our thoughtfully designed rooms and suites, each featuring modern technology, designer furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows, or reserve one of our club accommodations to enjoy our Sheraton Club. Enjoy our hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, offers and packages, and whether you are here for work or play, we look forward to hosting you at Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers.

hotels.descriptionZh: 选择澳门 JW 万豪酒店，尽享五星级酒店的豪华体验。酒店客房装饰考究、空间宽敞，五星级豪华酒店设施配备齐全，坐拥澳门银河综合度假城黄金位置，周遭遍布全球知名的购物、餐饮和娱乐设施。客房和套房为您营造时尚现代的卓越环境，惬意体验尽在此间。每个房间均配备品质超凡的精美设计，包括豪华床上用品、纯平电视、大理石浴室、迷你冰箱和免费 Wi-Fi 网络，全景式落地窗可将澳门迷人风光尽收眼底。于此下榻期间，您还可以畅玩让人流连忘返的“天浪淘园”水上乐园。超长空中激流冒险水道刺激非凡，铺有白沙的空中冲浪泳池美轮美奂，园内还有专门的儿童嬉戏区域。其他酒店内设施包括两间精致的餐厅、健身中心和水疗中心。我们的五星级酒店设有 4,552 平米多功能场地空间和一间豪华气派的大宴会厅，是您举办商务会议或社交活动的理想之选。更多精彩，只等您来！
hotels.descriptionEn: Luxury knows no bounds at JW Marriott Hotel Macau. Enjoy tastefully-decorated accommodations, a wealth of 5-star amenities and unbeatable placement within Galaxy Macau™, home to world-class shopping, dining and entertainment. Unwind in 5-star style from our modern Macau hotel rooms or suites; each boasting top-quality amenities like luxury bedding, flat-screen TVs, marble bathrooms, mini-fridges, free Wi-Fi and floor-to-ceiling windows, which provide sweeping panoramic views of Macau. Visit our award-winning hotel's spectacular Grand Resort Deck, where you can enjoy the world's longest Skytop Aquatic Adventure Rapids, a breathtaking white-sand Skytop Wave Pool and a dedicated kid's zone. Additional resources include two exquisite on-site restaurants, a 24-hour fitness center and a spa. Select our 5-star Cotai hotel​ to host your business meeting or social event to make use of 49,000 square feet of versatile venue space and an opulent Grand Ballroom. It's all waiting for you at JW Marriott Hotel Macau.

hotels.descriptionZh: 丽思卡尔顿酒店以卓越服务誉满全球，中国澳门丽思卡尔顿酒店也将继续秉承这一优良传统。酒店位于世界闻名的娱乐和休闲目的地——中国澳门银河的顶层区域，我们的中国澳门豪华酒店让经验丰富的旅行者也一见难忘。230间华美套房，坐拥中国澳门路氹的壮丽景色。住宿期间，欢迎畅享酒店内餐饮、室外泳池和豪华水疗中心等各种贴心便利设备。我们的中国澳门路氹酒店还设有6间活动室，供您举办多达780人的会议或婚礼。中国澳门丽思卡尔顿酒店荣膺《福布斯旅行指南》酒店和水疗中心五星大奖，在餐饮方面更有米其林殊荣加身。我们热切期待您的光临。
hotels.descriptionEn: The Ritz-Carlton, Macau offers the impeccable levels of service for which the brand is famous around the world. Set within the top floors of one of the world’s most spectacular entertainment and leisure destinations, Galaxy Macau, our Macau five star hotel is sure to impress even the most seasoned of travelers. Choose from over 230 grandiose suites that overlook inspiring views of Cotai Macau. During your stay, utilize a variety of thoughtful amenities including on-site dining, an outdoor swimming pool and a luxury spa. Our Cotai hotel in Macau​ also offers 6 event rooms for meeting or weddings of up to 780 guests. The Ritz-Carlton, Macau holds the distinct honor of being rated among Forbes Travel Guide for garnering Five Star awards in hotel and spa and Michelin Star award in dining. We look forward to welcoming you.

hotels.descriptionZh: 伦敦人名汇邀请宾客步入英伦奢华生活的空间。以久负盛名的伦敦梅费尔区为灵感，为旅行者打造兼具奢华气派与贴心细致的住宿体验。伦敦人名汇设有2,405间客房，由知名的Peter Silling & Associates设计事务所担纲设计，重新诠释英伦美学，以强调比例及自然光的玩味个性凸显乔治式建筑的宏伟。精心设计的一系列客房及套房以现代家居装饰和典雅宅邸氛围为特色，是休闲和放松的理想之选。卓越的服务团队让宾客体验更上一层楼。伦敦人名汇设有多座游泳池、24小时健身中心及水疗中心，体贴注重健康的宾客。餐饮选项包括喜公馆。宾客亦可漫步于150 间国际品牌名店，或于表演场地欣赏精彩演出。
hotels.descriptionEn: Londoner Grand welcomes guests into the exclusive world of British luxury living. Inspired by London’s prestigious Mayfair district, it provides the modern traveller with an exceptionally grand and personal stay. Designed by renowned Peter Silling & Associates, the 2,405-key property features a reinterpreted British design aesthetic, evoking Georgian architecture grandeur with playful expressiveness that emphasises proportion and natural light. Its curated collection of rooms and suites are perfect for entertaining and relaxing, with contemporary furnishings and an elegant townhouse ambience. Complemented by our outstanding guest experience team, the A Team. For wellness there are swimming pools, a 24-hour gym and pampering spa. Enticing dining includes The Conservatory. Guests can also enjoy 150 global retailers and world-class entertainment venues.  The possibilities are endless at Londoner Grand.

hotels.descriptionEn: The St. Regis Macao is situated on Macau's Cotai Strip, a centre for entertainment and shopping that boasts more than 850 luxury stores and an array of premier dining options. Sample some of the finest sustainably sourced ingredients from around the world at The Manor restaurant, an ideal venue in which to gather, celebrate and make new memories at our Cotai Strip Macau hotel. Sip on a Maria do Leste, our hotel's unique interpretation of the Bloody Mary at The St. Regis Bar. Find sanctuary at the St. Regis Spa or outdoor pool. Host elegant meetings or social events from our Cotai hotel in Macau with 1,300 square metres of event space, including the Astor Ballroom. Step into one of 400 luxury hotel rooms or suites fitted with traditional Chinese elements, each boasting dramatic views of the Cotai Strip and marble bathrooms with a bespoke amenity collection featuring best-in-class product lines from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN skincare. The St. Regis signature Butler service is available to all hotel guests.

hotels.descriptionZh: 澳门新濠影汇 W 酒店属新濠影汇大型综合度假村的一部分，坐落于路凼金光大道。酒店拥有557间时尚客房，均可饱览迷人的城市景观或繁华的路凼景色。宾客在客房内的W迷你吧调制鸡尾酒之同时，亦可通过蓝牙无线连接配备，于客房内尽情享受自己钟爱的音乐。澳门新濠影汇 W 酒店提供多种餐饮选择，包括提供全日餐饮服务的餐厅、咖啡和鸡尾酒吧，提供现代风味粤菜的特色餐厅，以及紧邻其旁的特色酒吧。位于顶楼层的特色酒吧坐拥路环的迷人景观，其复古的设计结合以地区风情为灵感的鸡尾酒及美食，诠释澳门的特色文化。酒店提供先进的健身设施和一个室内恒温游泳池。WET游泳池营造了温暖又热情的氛围，绚丽多彩的设计打造出轻松又有趣的环境，是酒店内的必到景点。AWAY®水疗中心设有两间提供速效护理服务的房间及五间护理室，您可于此探索感官愉悦，享受独处时光，或享用速效护理服务，放松身心。
hotels.descriptionEn: W Macau - Studio City is part of an integrated resort of Studio City and situated on Cotai Strip, the complex includes a variety of leisure elements such as an outdoor and a newly built indoor waterpark, theatre and more. W Macau - Studio City features 557 stylish guest rooms, each offering charming city views or the bustling Cotai view. The interior design of rooms and suites is inspired by the 1950s films shot in Macau, in which the city was first really shown on the world stage, all aspects and devices of Hollywood and cinema - be it costuming, cameras, theatres, stages, props, etc - to explore, reveal, and interpret the culture of Macau in an exciting contemporary context.

hotels.name: 高雄然一翡世之选酒店

hotels.descriptionZh: 高雄然一翡世之选酒店由御盟集团携手台湾、日本与德国顶尖设计团队匠心打造，秉承豪华精选酒店品牌对在地精神与珍稀体验的追求，旨在演绎极致的旅行体验，并通过建筑与艺术语言，重新定义奢华酒店的无限可能。酒店仅接待十岁以上宾客入住与用餐，是全台首选的艺术奢华酒店，以水为灵感核心，从室内水景的声响到静谧的空间设计，打造出一处融合舒适、疗愈与重生意象的心灵寓所。酒店共设有146间宽敞客房，客房空间自18坪起，全景落地窗引入高雄城景光影。房内备有Mini Bar，细致呵护旅客的每一刻需求。墙面选用安格拉灰大理石，低调的灰韵映衬光影流转，勾勒出沉稳雅致的空间气韵；地坪铺设北美实木，赤足行走间感受质地与自然交织的静好时光。单层仅规划6至10间客房，兼顾隐私与宁静，更提供包层与包栋服务，满足对生活品质有所坚持的品味之选。值得一提的是，高雄然一翡世之选酒店是全台唯一艺术内容由独立策展机构——ALIEN Art Centre 金马宾馆当代美术馆所规划，致力于呈现艺术家的独特视野。 静谧而充满张力的惬意氛围，让旅人在疗愈的场域里感受艺术的自由与活力，展开一段艺术与自我发现的旅程。公共走道铺设时尚大师Giorgio Armani钟爱的瑞典Bolon编织地毯，步履其上轻盈宁静，行李滑行亦从容顺畅。全栋楼层采用25公分厚的隔音墙体设计，隔绝都市喧嚣，只为室内留住一片静谧。
hotels.descriptionEn: Reserved exclusively for guests aged 10 and above, THE AMNIS is Taiwan’s foremost art-inspired luxury hotel, shaped by the essence of water—from the gentle murmur of indoor water features to the tranquil poise of its thoughtfully crafted interiors. As a Kaohsiung hotel, it offers a serene retreat where comfort, renewal, and quiet reflection naturally converge. Uniquely, THE AMNIS is the only Kaohsiung Taiwan hotel with its artistic content curated by contemporary art museum – The ALIEN Art Centre, dedicated to presenting the artist’s unique vision. A serene yet tension-filled atmosphere of ease invites the audience to experience the freedom and vitality of art within a healing space, making it an exceptional hotel in Qianzhen district, where guests embark on a journey of artistic and personal discovery.
hotels.hotelImageAlt: THE AMNIS, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Kaohsiung

hotels.descriptionZh: 高雄万豪酒店耸立于爱河之心旁，傲视北高雄，是市区内一座魅力新地标。酒店地理位置优越，距离高雄国际机场约30分钟车程，与左营高铁站距离约15分钟车程，搭乘捷运也能轻松到达。绿意盎然、幅员辽阔的凹子底森林公园也在步行距离之内，堪称酒店的后花园。酒店拥有 700 间典雅宽敞的客房，为来到这个海洋之都的宾客提供温暖的避风港，安心休憩。选择多样的餐厅利用优质食材，在精致优雅的环境提供珍馐佳肴，一饱口福。全馆会议及宴会空间共 8,518 平方米（约 2,577 坪），设施设备齐全先进，无论是举行国际会议与浪漫婚礼，空间都可依活动需求灵活配置，事半功倍。健身中心配备最新的运动器材，另有室内温水游泳池、水疗池、维琪浴以及顶级 SPA，焕发身心。秉持优质服务，高雄万豪酒店投入了南台湾的热情与友善，为宾客传递如和煦阳光的待客之道。
hotels.descriptionEn: Step into Kaohsiung Marriott Hotel in downtown and start your memorable adventure in the city. Our hotel in Kaohsiung Taiwan​ promises "Wonderful Hospitality. Always®" with 700 amenity-filled rooms, diverse on-site dining options, the largest banquet venues in Taiwan, outdoor wedding halls, a fitness center, a spa and indoor swimming pools. Our iconic venue space with capacity up to 2,000 participants is the largest banquet venue of Taiwan and perfect for business or social events. Guests will find themselves adjacent to the shopping mall, near the Sinshang Elementary School Station of Light Rail Transit (LRT) and Aozihdi MRT station. For those traveling abroad or from other cities, our Kaohsiung hotel is conveniently located just 30 minutes away from Kaohsiung International Airport and 15 minutes from Taiwan High-Speed Rail Zuoying Station. Make memories that will last a lifetime at Kaohsiung Marriott Hotel.

hotels.descriptionEn: Le Méridien Hualien Resort, a luxury urban hot spring resort situated in the heart of Hualien City, introduces distinctive European charm to eastern Taiwan. The resort features 252 guest rooms, two restaurants and two bars, private and public hot springs, and a spa for the ultimate rejuvenation. Situated in a historically rich and culturally vibrant commercial district, yet having uninterrupted views of the ocean and central mountain range, it is truly a serene escape amidst the urban bustle.

hotels.descriptionZh: 鹿港永乐酒店座落鹿港老城区，邻近龙山寺、摸乳巷、意楼、十宜楼、九曲巷，是百年鹿港最繁华的古迹保存区域。我们致力将鹿港丰厚的文化底蕴，转化为深刻且独特的个人体验，您可以悠闲地坐在大厅，啜饮一杯香醇咖啡；亦可到餐厅，细细品味道地鹿港美食，经典滋味一入口，直抵味蕾深处，唤醒记忆中的感动。全馆共62间客房，温润木质设计与柔和光线搭配，营造出舒适静谧氛围。每间客房皆选用台湾顶级特制床垫和柔软寝具，伴您一夜好眠；宽敞的干湿分离卫浴空间，洗涤旅程中的疲惫，带来全面放松的身心体验。在鹿港层层堆叠的历史底蕴中，提供一处现代、静谧且个人化的休憩空间，让您的灵魂和小镇连结，远离尘嚣、重拾自我，充电再出发。
hotels.descriptionEn: Nestled in the heart of Lukang’s old town—home to Longshan Temple, Breast-Touching Lane, Yi Lou, and Nine-Turns Alley—Yong Le Lukang stands amid a century of preserved heritage and timeless charm. Here, hospitality flows gently like the town’s winding alleys. Enjoy a quiet moment with a cup of aromatic coffee or savour authentic Lukang delicacies that awaken cherished memories. Each of our 62 guest rooms, adorned with warm wood tones and soft light, offers a serene sanctuary with premium Taiwanese bedding and spacious bathrooms. Blending history and modern comfort, Yong Le Lukang invites you to slow down, reconnect, and rediscover yourself within the soul of this ancient town.
hotels.hotelImageAlt: Yong Le Lukang, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel

hotels.descriptionEn: Four Points by Sheraton Penghu is an International branded hotel in Penghu. Strategically located Magong and overlooking Magong Harbor #3, the hotel is 15 minutes drive from Magong International Airport. Your breath will be taken away by its sunny skies, blue sea, white sand beaches, glorious sceneries and touching traditional Taiwanese culture. Work or Play. Go for a swim or soak up the sun at our zero-edge swimming pool. Work out in the fitness center, then enjoy a sauna or steam session. Savor fresh local seafood and international cuisines in The Eatery and China Spice, or stop by the lobby lounge for a beer.

hotels.descriptionZh: 入住台北北门世民酒店，轻松探索台北繁华街道、历史景点和购物场所。酒店地理位置便利，约5分钟步程可抵北门地铁站，约8分钟可至台北车站，乘坐出租车短程可至西门町购物区。酒店内的智能客房，堪称集时尚与科技于一体的休憩空间：您可通过客房内平板电脑操控照明、百叶窗与温度，还能借助Chromecast播放个人喜爱的节目。在XL睡床上畅享一夜酣眠，于7天24小时开放的canteenM补充能量，使用免费高速Wi-Fi保持在线。酒店提供无接触式入住服务，设有时尚休闲厅，且整间酒店均以超凡卓越的艺术品装饰点缀。无论是商务出差、观光旅游或两者兼有，世民酒店都将为您打造轻松愉悦的住宿体验。
hotels.descriptionEn: Taipei’s buzzing streets, heritage sights and shopping thrills are all within easy reach when you stay at citizenM Taipei North Gate. Just a 5-minute stroll from Beimen MRT and 8 minutes from Taipei Main Station, the hotel puts you right in the middle of the action – with Ximending’s retail paradise just a short taxi ride away. Inside, your smart room is a sanctuary of style and tech: controls for lighting, blinds and temperature, plus Chromecast for streaming your own shows all through your in-room tablet. Sleep like a boss on the XL bed, refuel 24/7 at canteenM, and stay connected with free high-speed Wi-Fi. There’s contactless check-in, a stylish living room, and world-class art throughout the hotel. Whether you’re in town for business, sightseeing, or a mix of both, citizenM makes every stay refreshingly easy.

hotels.descriptionZh: 台北北投雅乐轩酒店是一处位于台北市中心的别致目的地，提供卓越服务和各类贴心设施。酒店附近有两个捷运站和多处热门温泉。酒店还邻近供应美味小吃的士林夜市和阳明山公园。我们的台北宠物友好酒店拥有别致的都市时尚装饰客房，配备迷你冰箱、即插即用连接面板、平面电视、特色睡床、宽大办公桌，坐拥北投区的优美景色。您可以使用酒店提供的免费 Wi-Fi，与亲朋好友保持顺畅联系。在酒店内的餐厅、自助熟食店和活力酒吧享用各色美食，或者在 24 小时充电：站健身房重焕活力。酒店的活动场地专门提供备餐饮和策划服务，以及先进的视听技术，举办私人婚礼乃至企业活动等均可胜任。欢迎下榻台北北投雅乐轩酒店。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located near Taipei City in the bustling downtown area, Aloft Taipei Beitou is a unique destination with superb service and thoughtful amenities. Our Beitou hotel guests are steps from two MRT stations and popular hot springs. The property is also near the delicious delights of Shilin Night Market and Yangmingshan National Park. Recharge in our pet-friendly hotel in Taipei in rooms that offer a unique urban-chic retreat, sleek decor, mini-refrigerators, plug-and-play connectivity panels, flat-screen TVs, signature beds, ample desks and impressive views of the Beitou District. Stay connected with work, friends and family using our free Wi-Fi. Indulge in the tasty delights of our hotel's restaurant, self-serve gourmet deli and lively bar, or reinvigorate in our 24-hour re:charge gym. Organize anything from an intimate wedding to a corporate event in our venues, expertly supported by catering, planning services and cutting-edge A/V technology. We look forward to welcoming you to Aloft Taipei Beitou.

hotels.descriptionZh: 台北赋乐旅居位于台北中心地带的东区，是Design Hotels™设计酒店成员，也是万豪国际集团的合作伙伴。这间精品酒店由全球闻名的建筑师陈瑞宪倾情设计，以豪华、精致和热情呈现一处新颖的审美空间。与神秘的黑色钢网外观不同，酒店内部采用稳重大气的铜、温暖的木质、纹理皮革和精致面料进行装饰。贴心的管家服务进一步为该空间带来温情，同时“纵情享受！”的品牌理念传递着人们追求美好生活和现代审美的满腔热情。无论何时下榻台北赋乐旅居，美食爱好者都可乘兴而来，满意而归。台北赋乐旅居周边汇集众多非凡场所和美酒佳肴，我们已准备了一场调动五种感官的超凡盛宴，供四海而来的旅客齐聚一堂，分享自己的精彩故事，满足对美好生活的追求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the heart of Taipei’s East District, HOTEL PROVERBS Taipei is a member of Design Hotels™ and a partner of Marriott® International. This boutique hotel was designed by globally renowned architect Ray Chen, with luxury, sophistication and passion that represent a new aesthetic of space. Inside the mysterious black steel mesh exterior, the interior is contrarily constructed with sedate copper, mellow wood, textured leather and delicate fabrics. The delicate butler services furthermore bring warmth into the space, while “Indulge Yourself”, the brand philosophy, conveys the enthusiasm of people to pursue ultimate life and modern aesthetics. And food-lovers will not be disappointed either when they visit HOTEL PROVERBS Taipei.  Surrounded by splendid space and delicious food and wine, HOTEL PROVERBS Taipei has prepared an ultimate feast of all five senses for all travelers to come share their stories and fulfill their pursuits and desires for better lives.

hotels.descriptionZh: 台北国泰万怡酒店位于活力四射的中山区，仅需步行约8分钟即可抵达行天宫地铁站，驱车约10分钟可至台北松山机场。酒店附近的行天宫是当地历史悠久的宗教景点，此外附近还有众多文化景点、商务区和购物街。每间客房均设有浴缸，并可欣赏城景，为您在城市上空营造一处静谧放松空间。MJ Kitchen是酒店的自助餐厅，供应众多国际佳肴和当地风味美食。Drift酒吧位于屋顶，这里景色优美，氛围闲适，是您小酌鸡尾酒的好去处。健身房面向宾客开放。酒店地处中心位置，以简约设计和可靠服务，为商务旅行者和自由探索全城的宾客提供理想下榻之选。
hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the vibrant Zhongshan district, Courtyard Taipei Downtown places guests just an 8-minute walk from Xingtian Temple MRT Station and a 10-minute drive from Taipei Songshan Airport. The hotel is within walking distance of Xingtian Temple, one of Taipei’s most historic religious landmarks, and offers easy access to nearby cultural sites, business areas, and shopping streets.Each guest room includes a bathtub and city views, providing a quiet space to rest above the pace of the city. MJ Kitchen, the hotel’s buffet restaurant, serves a wide range of international dishes and Taiwanese specialties. On the rooftop, Drift Bar offers a relaxed setting for cocktails with a view. A fitness gym is also available for guests.With a central location, simple design, and reliable service, the hotel is well-suited for both business travelers and those looking to explore the city at their own pace.

hotels.descriptionEn: Located in the dynamic central business district, Le Méridien Taipei is an ideal starting point for exploring this intriguing city. Discover nearby cultural attractions from our downtown Taipei hotel, including the impressive Taipei 101 and extensive shopping opportunities. A world of experiences beckons-from inventive Cantonese and Taiwanese cuisine at My Humble House to trendsetting cocktails at Latitude 25. An indoor pool, health club and lobby coffee bar round out the opportunities to unwind and enjoy every turn of our hotel in Taipei Taiwan. 160 spacious guest rooms redefine contemporary luxury and elegance with signature bedding, rain forest showers, large flat screen TVs and compact virtual office hubs. If you're looking to host an event, we offer flexible on-site event rooms with space for up to 800 guests. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, make lasting memories at Le Méridien Taipei.

hotels.descriptionEn: Taipei Marriott Hotel, a premier urban landmark and a top MICE destination, caters to leisure and business travelers alike. Featuring modern guestrooms, five world-class restaurants and a vibrant sky bar, a luxurious spa, a rooftop pool, and advanced banquet and conference facilities, the hotel offers an unmatched blend of sophistication and comfort. Guests can enjoy breathtaking views of Taipei's skyline, including Taipei 101. Located in the heart of the city’s emerging commercial hub, our Taipei hotel is near major business districts, technology parks, and exhibition centers including Taipei International Convention Center and Taipei World Trade Center Nangang. It also provides access to cultural attractions such as the National Palace Museum, Shilin Night Market, and Ximending. The prime location offers convenient access within a short walk to shopping malls, cinemas, bars, golf driving range and diverse entertainment options. A 6-minute walk to the MRT and a 10-minute drive to Taipei Songshan Airport.

hotels.descriptionZh: 欢迎莅临下榻台北W饭店，惬意感受台北风情，留下难忘的回忆。台北W饭店位于台北市政站上方，紧邻地标台北101大厦和台北巨蛋。我们的台北市中心酒店附近汇集众多家庭友好景点、活力不凡的夜生活场所、时尚购物店、非凡餐厅等。欢迎莅临下榻我们酒店，开启精彩纷呈的逍遥之旅。不妨前往我们的YEN特色中餐厅大快朵颐，满足味蕾享受，欣赏迷人城市景观，或者在酒店内的时尚酒吧品饮创意鸡尾酒。在WET室外泳池畅游，抑或在FIT健身馆挥汗锻炼。结束一天充实的台北探索之旅后，您可前往我们惬意的Away水疗中心放松身心，或者留在舒适优雅的客房内静怡休憩，让舒适的W睡床带您进入甜蜜梦乡。若此处提供的信息不够详尽，无需担心，我们的随时随需服务将竭诚满足您的需求。
hotels.descriptionEn: Stay fully in the Taipei scene at W Taipei, the kind of hotel you will never forget. Perched atop Taipei City Hall station next to iconic Taipei 101 and Taipei Dome. At our downtown Taipei City hotel, you will find family-friendly attractions, pulsating nightlife, fashionable shopping, fabulous restaurants and more. Stay at our hotel and you will never run out of things to do. To satisfy your cravings, try our signature YEN Chinese Restaurant with amazing city views or sip creative cocktails at our stylish bars. Get WET® in the pool or workout at FIT. After a long day of exploring Taipei, you can always pamper yourself at our relaxing AWAY® spa, or just stay in your cozy guest room and let your super comfy W bed charm you to sleep. Don’t worry, if we miss mentioning anything you want to know, our Whatever/Whenever® service is always there for you.

hotels.descriptionEn: Soak up the vibrant energy of Taitung City at Sheraton Taitung Hotel. Centrally located in the heart of downtown, Nearby Green Island,connecting history and humanities, ecology and nature. hotels.descriptionZh: 宜兰力丽威斯汀度假酒店位于宜兰的一座日式老建筑内，走进禅式风格的大门之后，即可一窥时尚简约的内部设计。酒店内设水疗中心、桑拿室、烤炉、健身中心和室外泳池，缔造理想下榻体验。优雅别致的设计伴您开启精彩度假之旅。酒店拥有 85 间客房和套房以及 6 栋别墅，设有独立泳池和水疗泳池，且每间客房均提供高速上网接入、50 英寸液晶纯平电视、免费瓶装水、天梦之床以及天梦之浴白茶系列沐浴用品，休闲体验尽此间。Mai 日式餐厅有着宽大的落地窗，柚木和柏树成就设计亮点，除了单人座位之外，亦贴心地设有可容纳 6 至 10 人的私人包房。 Seasonal Tastes 餐厅是一间摩登风尚的全日制餐厅及咖啡厅，是休闲用餐的理想去处
hotels.descriptionEn: Based on the Japanese-style old buildings in Yilan, the Westin Yilan Resort provides one entrance with a Zen-style layout with a modern and simple design. Guests are welcomed to enjoy our SPA facilities, sauna, oven chambers, fitness center, and outdoor swimming pool to experience the best stay with us.With an elegant and unique design, the Westin Yilan Resort makes a perfect getaway. Boasting 85 guest rooms, suites, and even six villas, as well as independent swimming pools and SPA pools, each room is equipped with high speed internet access, 50-inch LCD flat screen TVs, free bottled water, Heavenly® Bed, and white tea Heavenly® Bath amenities, to provide all travelers with a relaxing experience.With large floor-to-ceiling windows, designed with teak and cypress, Mai Japanese Restaurant not only offers individual seating, but also offers separate private rooms from 6 to 10 persons. Modern designed Seasonal Taste all day dining restaurant and Cafe lounge are perfect place to enjoy and relax
